# Whop API v1 (native) — referencia de endpoints

La API versionada de Whop: los endpoints bajo `/api-reference/beta`, que se fijan con el header `Api-Version-Date`. Es la referencia por defecto para integraciones nuevas.

- Versión declarada: `1.0.0`
- `x-api-version-date`: `2026-08-25-2`
- Server: `https://api.whop.com/api/v1` — Production Whop API
- Server: `https://sandbox-api.whop.com/api/v1` — Sandbox Whop API
- Auth `bearerAuth`: http / bearer — An Account API key, account-scoped JWT, App API key, or user OAuth token. Prepend the key or token with `Bearer`, for example `Bearer ***************************`.
- Auth `scopedSessionCookie`: apiKey / cookie `whop-core.scoped-access-token` — The scoped session credential a session-intent verify installs on first-party (whop.com) pages — HttpOnly, so a page never handles it; the browser simply carries it. It names the intent it was minted by, which is what authorizes that intent's own upgrade when no Bearer is presented.
- Spec original: [`./openapi/api-v1-native.json`](./openapi/api-v1-native.json)

## Descripción del proveedor

The Whop REST API. Please see https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/getting-started for more details.

## `GET /accounts`

**List Accounts**

Lists accounts visible to the credential. User tokens return the user's business accounts; Account API keys return the requesting account and its connected accounts. Pass `parent_account_id` to return only that parent account's connected accounts.

`operationId`: `listAccounts` · tags: `Accounts` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **first** (`query`) `integer` — The number of accounts to return (default 10, max 50).
- **after** (`query`) `string` — A cursor; returns accounts after this position.
- **last** (`query`) `integer` — The number of accounts to return from the end of the range.
- **before** (`query`) `string` — A cursor; returns accounts before this position.
- **order** (`query`) `string` — The field to sort accounts by. `volume` requires `stats:read` on the parent account. · valores: `created_at`, `volume` · default: `created_at`
- **direction** (`query`) `string` — Sort direction. · valores: `asc`, `desc` · default: `desc`
- **status** (`query`) `string` — Return only accounts with this status: `active` (includes accounts that have not entered payments review) or `suspended`. · valores: `active`, `suspended`
- **query** (`query`) `string` — Free-text filter on account title or ID. `%` and `_` match literally.
- **created_after** (`query`) `string` — Return only accounts created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **created_before** (`query`) `string` — Return only accounts created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **volume_min** (`query`) `number` — Return only accounts whose lifetime USD volume is at least this value. Requires `stats:read` on the parent account.
- **volume_max** (`query`) `number` — Return only accounts whose lifetime USD volume is at most this value. Requires `stats:read` on the parent account.
- **parent_account_id** (`query`) `string` — For platforms: the parent account ID whose direct connected accounts to return. Requires `payout:account:read` on the parent account.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — accounts listed

- **data** `Account[]` _requerido_

      - `array` de:
        - **balance** `string` _requerido_ — Total amount held in native units, as a decimal string.
        - **breakdown** `AccountBalanceBreakdown` _requerido_ — Balance split into available, pending, and reserve amounts, as native-unit decimal strings, with the days the pending amount is expected to settle. On-chain crypto is entirely available; good_funds and fiat cash can have pending or reserve portions.
          - **available** `string` _requerido_ — Amount you can spend, send, or withdraw now, in native units, as a decimal string.
          - **in_transit** `string` _requerido_ — Amount moving between the account's own destinations, such as a treasury sweep to its crypto wallet or a card top-up. In native units, as a decimal string.
          - **pending** `string` _requerido_ — Amount from recent payments still settling, in native units, as a decimal string.
          - **pending_settlements** `AccountBalanceSettlement[]` _requerido_
            - `array` de:
              - **amount** `string` _requerido_ — Amount expected that day, in native units, as a decimal string.
              - **date** `string` _requerido_ — The day this money is expected to finish settling, as an ISO 8601 date.
          - **reserve** `string` _requerido_ — Amount held back, in native units, as a decimal string. Retrieve the account's reserves for why it is held and when it unlocks.
        - **icon_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Holding icon URL.

        - **symbol** `string` _requerido_ — Holding display symbol, such as `USDT`, `cbBTC`, or `EUR`.
        - **value_usd** `string | null` _requerido_ — Holding USD value, or `null` when no exchange rate is available.

Defaults to `exclusive` when unset; `null` only when the account has no payment connection. · valores: `inclusive`, `exclusive`, `None`

## `POST /accounts`

**Create Account**

Creates an account. User tokens create business accounts; Account API keys create connected accounts. Tax fields (`tax_remitted_by`, `tax_type`, `product_tax_code_id`, `business_address`, `tax_identifiers`) are configured with Update Account, not at creation.

`operationId`: `createAccount` · tags: `Accounts` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **affiliate_code** `string | null` — The username, if any, of the partner who referred this account
- **blueprint_id** `string | null` — The blueprint App ID, prefixed `app_`. Creates a hosted website for the account and queues its deployment asynchronously; the Account response does not report deployment completion.
- **country** `string` — The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where the account's business is located (e.g. `US`). Defaults to the parent account's country for connected accounts.
- **email** `string` — The email address of the account owner. Required for Account API key requests.
- **metadata** `object` — Arbitrary key/value metadata to store on the account.
- **title** `string` — The display name of the account. Defaults to `metadata.external_id` or the owner's email when omitted.

### Respuestas

**`201`** — account created

- **balances** `AccountBalanceToken[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **balance** `string` _requerido_ — Total amount held in native units, as a decimal string.
    - **breakdown** `AccountBalanceBreakdown` _requerido_ — Balance split into available, pending, and reserve amounts, as native-unit decimal strings, with the days the pending amount is expected to settle. On-chain crypto is entirely available; good_funds and fiat cash can have pending or reserve portions.
      - **available** `string` _requerido_ — Amount you can spend, send, or withdraw now, in native units, as a decimal string.
      - **in_transit** `string` _requerido_ — Amount moving between the account's own destinations, such as a treasury sweep to its crypto wallet or a card top-up. In native units, as a decimal string.
      - **pending** `string` _requerido_ — Amount from recent payments still settling, in native units, as a decimal string.
      - **pending_settlements** `AccountBalanceSettlement[]` _requerido_
        - `array` de:
          - **amount** `string` _requerido_ — Amount expected that day, in native units, as a decimal string.
          - **date** `string` _requerido_ — The day this money is expected to finish settling, as an ISO 8601 date.
      - **reserve** `string` _requerido_ — Amount held back, in native units, as a decimal string. Retrieve the account's reserves for why it is held and when it unlocks.
    - **icon_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Holding icon URL.
    - **name** `string` _requerido_ — The holding's display name
    - **price_usd** `number | null` _requerido_ — USD price per unit, or `null` when no exchange rate is available.
    - **symbol** `string` _requerido_ — Holding display symbol, such as `USDT`, `cbBTC`, or `EUR`.
    - **value_usd** `string | null` _requerido_ — Holding USD value, or `null` when no exchange rate is available.
- **banner_image_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Account banner image URL.
- **business_address** `object | null` _requerido_ — Account business address used to calculate tax, with `line1`, `line2`, `city`, `state`, `postal_code`, and `country`. `null` when no address is set.
- **business_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The account's legal business name used with its tax address.
- **business_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — High-level business category for the account. See the [business types and industries glossary](/api-reference/beta/accounts/account#business-types-and-industries-glossary) for valid values. · valores: `education_program`, `coaching`, `software`, `paid_group`, `newsletter`, `agency`, `physical_products`, `brick_and_mortar`, `events`, `coaching_and_courses`, `other`, `services`, `gig_economy`, `marketplace`, `telehealth`, `class_action_settlement`, `physical_product`, `saas`, `course`, `community`, `None`
- **can_transfer_pending_balance_to_children** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether pending funds may be transferred from this platform account to its connected accounts.
- **capabilities** `AccountCapabilities | null` _requerido_ — Payment rails enabled for this account, each `active`, `inactive`, or `pending` (onboarding or review in progress). Computed only on `retrieve` and `me` for callers with `company:balance:read` scope; `null` otherwise.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AccountCapabilities**
      - **accept_bank_payments** `string` _requerido_ — Bank payins: debits, transfers, and local bank rails · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **accept_bnpl_payments** `string` _requerido_ — Buy-now-pay-later payins; requires approval · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **accept_card_payments** `string` _requerido_ — Card payins, including Apple Pay and Google Pay · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **bank_deposit** `string` _requerido_ — Deposits by bank wire or ACH to the account's virtual bank account · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **card_deposit** `string` _requerido_ — Balance top-ups by charging a stored payment method · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **card_issuing** `string` _requerido_ — Issuing Whop cards; requires card application approval · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **crypto_deposit** `string` _requerido_ — On-chain deposits to the account's crypto wallet · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **crypto_payout** `string` _requerido_ — On-chain payouts to a crypto wallet · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **instant_payout** `string` _requerido_ — Instant payouts to an eligible payout destination · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **run_ads** `string` _requerido_ — Launching ad campaigns through Whop Ads. `inactive` while a requested ads services agreement is awaiting the account's signature. · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **standard_payout** `string` _requerido_ — Standard payouts to an external payout destination · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **transfer** `string` _requerido_ — Transfers to other accounts · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
    - **null**
- **cards** `AccountCards | null` _requerido_ — Whop Cards application details for the account. Computed only on `retrieve` and `me` for callers with `company:balance:read` scope; `null` otherwise, or when the account has no card application.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AccountCards**
      - **kind** `string | null` _requerido_ — Whether the card application verifies a business (`business`, KYB) or a person (`individual`, consumer identity). `null` when the application is not yet linked to a verification. · valores: `individual`, `business`, `None`
      - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Where the card application stands. `approved` means cards can be issued. `needs_verification` means the applicant has not completed identity verification yet; `needs_information` means they did, but the documents were rejected for a fixable reason and must be resubmitted. `pending` and `manual_review` are in flight. `denied`, `locked`, and `canceled` are terminal. · valores: `approved`, `pending`, `manual_review`, `denied`, `locked`, `canceled`, `needs_verification`, `needs_information`
    - **null**
- **collect_vat_id** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether checkout shows a VAT/tax ID field for buyers to optionally enter. Does not require a VAT ID to purchase.
- **company_formation** `AccountCompanyFormation` _requerido_ — Company formation state for the account, managed through [Form Company](/api-reference/beta/accounts/form-company). A `draft` `status` until the formation checkout is paid, then filing progress with downloadable documents and signatures awaiting action. Empty when the formation state is temporarily unavailable.
  - **documents** `AccountCompanyFormationDocument[]`
    - `array` de:
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Document ID, prefixed `file_`.
      - **name** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable document name, such as `Articles of Organization`.
      - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Document category: `articles_of_organization`, `operating_agreement`, `ein_letter`, `signed_ss4`, `signed_form8821`, or `mail` for postal correspondence received on the company's behalf.
      - **url** `string` _requerido_ — CDN URL for downloading the document.
  - **ein_registered** `boolean` — Whether the company's EIN has been issued by the IRS. Present once `status` leaves `draft`.
  - **legal_name** `string | null` — Registered company name including the entity ending, for example `Acme, LLC`. Present once `status` leaves `draft`.
  - **signatures** `AccountCompanyFormationSignatures` — IRS forms still awaiting a founder's signature, each with a hosted signing URL. Present once `status` leaves `draft`; empty when nothing needs signing.
    - **form8821** `AccountCompanyFormationSignatureRequest` — Signature state for IRS Form 8821, the tax information authorization. Present only while the form still needs the founder's action.
      - **expires_at** `string` — When the signing URL expires, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Present while `status` is `pending`.
      - **status** `string` _requerido_ — `pending` when a signing session is ready for the founder; `unknown` when the signature state could not be determined. · valores: `pending`, `unknown`
      - **url** `string` — Hosted signing URL where the founder completes the form. Present while `status` is `pending`.
    - **ss4** `AccountCompanyFormationSignatureRequest` — Signature state for IRS Form SS-4, the EIN application. Present only while the form still needs the founder's action.

      - **status** `string` _requerido_ — `pending` when a signing session is ready for the founder; `unknown` when the signature state could not be determined. · valores: `pending`, `unknown`
      - **url** `string` — Hosted signing URL where the founder completes the form. Present while `status` is `pending`.
  - **state_registered** `boolean` — Whether the state formation filing is complete. Present once `status` leaves `draft`.
  - **status** `string` · valores: `draft`, `processing`, `filed`, `rejected`, `completed`
- **country** `string | null` _requerido_ — Country where the account is located.
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the account was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

## `GET /accounts/{account_id}/preferences`

**Retrieve Account Preferences**

Retrieves the account's preferences: a singleton settings document keyed by preference name.

`operationId`: `retrieveAccountPreferences` · tags: `Accounts` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **account_id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — preferences retrieved

- **ads_agreement** `object` _requerido_ — The account's Whop Ads services and payment authorization agreement. While `pending_signature`, campaign launch is blocked; sign by answering `requested_information` via `PATCH /verifications/{id}`.
  - **accepted_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the agreement was signed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` until signed.
  - **agreement_version** `string | null` _requerido_ — The agreement version signed or awaiting signature, as an ISO date. `null` when no signature is required.
  - **printed_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The signer's printed full name. `null` until signed.
  - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Where the account's ads services agreement stands. · valores: `not_required`, `pending_signature`, `signed`
- **ads_payment_methods** `object | null` _requerido_ — How the account pays for Whop Ads spend. `primary` is charged first; `backup` covers the charge when the primary fails. `null` until ads billing has been configured.
  - **backup** `object | null` _requerido_
    - **card_brand** `string | null` — Card brand, present for `card` entries.
    - **exp_month** `integer | null` — Expiration month, present for `card` entries.
    - **exp_year** `integer | null` — Expiration year, present for `card` entries.
    - **icon_url** `string | null` — Balance owner icon URL, present for `platform_balance` entries.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The funding source ID: a Whop balance (`ldgr_`) for `platform_balance`, or a payment method (`payt_`) for `card`.
    - **last4** `string | null` — Last four digits, present for `card` entries.
    - **title** `string | null` — Balance name, present for account `platform_balance` entries (null for a personal balance).
    - **type** `string` _requerido_ — The funding source kind: a Whop balance or a saved card. · valores: `platform_balance`, `card`
  - **primary** `object | null` _requerido_
    - **card_brand** `string | null` — Card brand, present for `card` entries.
    - **exp_month** `integer | null` — Expiration month, present for `card` entries.
    - **exp_year** `integer | null` — Expiration year, present for `card` entries.
    - **icon_url** `string | null` — Balance owner icon URL, present for `platform_balance` entries.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The funding source ID: a Whop balance (`ldgr_`) for `platform_balance`, or a payment method (`payt_`) for `card`.
    - **last4** `string | null` — Last four digits, present for `card` entries.
    - **title** `string | null` — Balance name, present for account `platform_balance` entries (null for a personal balance).
    - **type** `string` _requerido_ — The funding source kind: a Whop balance or a saved card. · valores: `platform_balance`, `card`
- **ads_reporting_currency** `string` _requerido_ — Lowercase ISO currency code, such as `usd` or `eur`, used to display ad spend and stats. Defaults to `usd`.
- **ads_scheduling_timezone** `string` _requerido_ — IANA timezone (e.g. `America/New_York`) used to interpret campaign start/end times and to bucket reports. Defaults to `America/New_York` until explicitly overridden.
- **ads_triple_whale_integration** `object` _requerido_ — The account's Triple Whale integration, which pushes Whop ad spend to Triple Whale's Data-In API so it reports as a `whop` channel.
  - **masked_api_key** `string | null` _requerido_ — The leading characters of the stored Data-In API key, followed by asterisks. The full key is never returned. `null` when no key is stored.
  - **shop_domain** `string | null` _requerido_ — The connected Shopify store domain spend is reported for, such as `acme.myshopify.com`. `null` when no store is connected.
  - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Where the integration stands. `requires_shopify_store` means no Shopify store is connected — Triple Whale keys records by Shopify shop, so no spend is reported until one is. · valores: `connected`, `not_connected`, `requires_shopify_store`
- **cards_auto_top_up** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether incoming funds are automatically moved to the account's cards balance. `false` when the account has no cards balance.
- **dispute_fighter_enabled** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether Whop assembles and files the evidence response when this account's payments are disputed. Off by default; enabling it also opts the account into the success fee charged only on disputes it wins.

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`404`** — Resource not found

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

## `PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/preferences`

**Update Account Preferences**

Updates the account's preferences. Each top-level key present in the body is replaced as a whole; omitted keys are left untouched. `ads_triple_whale_integration` takes the Data-In API key to connect with, or `null` to disconnect. `ads_payment_methods` always requires a `primary` entry. `backup` is optional and any pairing is allowed — two cards, `card`+`platform_balance`, or a single method — so a card-only advertiser can fund ads without a platform balance. The `primary` and `backup` must be different sources. A `platform_balance` entry may omit `id` to use the account's default Whop balance. Configuring a `card` requires a user token; account API keys can set up platform-balance billing only.

`operationId`: `updateAccountPreferences` · tags: `Accounts` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **account_id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **ads_payment_methods** `object` — How the account pays for Whop Ads spend. `primary` is charged first; `backup` covers the charge when the primary fails.
  - **backup** `object` — Optional second method charged if the primary fails. Any pairing is allowed (two cards, card+balance, balance+card); omit it to run on a single method. Must differ from the primary.
    - **id** `string` — The funding source ID: a Whop balance (`ldgr_`) for `platform_balance`, or a payment method (`payt_`) for `card`. Optional for `platform_balance` — defaults to the account's default Whop balance. Required for `card`.
    - **type** `string` _requerido_ — The funding source kind. · valores: `platform_balance`, `card`
  - **primary** `object` _requerido_
    - **id** `string` — The funding source ID: a Whop balance (`ldgr_`) for `platform_balance`, or a payment method (`payt_`) for `card`. Optional for `platform_balance` — defaults to the account's default Whop balance. Required for `card`.
    - **type** `string` _requerido_ — The funding source kind. · valores: `platform_balance`, `card`
- **ads_reporting_currency** `string` — Lowercase ISO currency code, such as `usd` or `eur`, used to display ad spend and stats. Defaults to `usd`.
- **ads_scheduling_timezone** `string` — IANA timezone (e.g. `America/New_York`) used to interpret campaign start/end times and to bucket reports. Cannot be cleared once set — pass a new value to change it.
- **ads_triple_whale_integration** `object` — Connects or disconnects the Triple Whale integration. Requires a connected Shopify store, since Triple Whale keys spend records by Shopify shop.
  - **api_key** `string | null` _requerido_ — A Triple Whale Data-In API key with the `Data-In Write: Ads` scope, validated against Triple Whale before it is stored. Pass `null` to disconnect. Connecting for the first time backfills the account's existing ad spend.
- **cards_auto_top_up** `boolean` — Whether incoming funds are automatically moved to the account's cards balance. Requires a cards balance on the account.
- **dispute_fighter_enabled** `boolean` — Whether Whop assembles and files the evidence response when this account's payments are disputed. Off by default; enabling it also opts the account into the success fee charged only on disputes it wins.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — preferences updated

- **ads_agreement** `object` _requerido_ — The account's Whop Ads services and payment authorization agreement. While `pending_signature`, campaign launch is blocked; sign by answering `requested_information` via `PATCH /verifications/{id}`.
  - **accepted_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the agreement was signed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` until signed.
  - **agreement_version** `string | null` _requerido_ — The agreement version signed or awaiting signature, as an ISO date. `null` when no signature is required.
  - **printed_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The signer's printed full name. `null` until signed.
  - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Where the account's ads services agreement stands. · valores: `not_required`, `pending_signature`, `signed`
- **ads_payment_methods** `object | null` _requerido_ — How the account pays for Whop Ads spend. `primary` is charged first; `backup` covers the charge when the primary fails. `null` until ads billing has been configured.
  - **backup** `object | null` _requerido_
    - **card_brand** `string | null` — Card brand, present for `card` entries.
    - **exp_month** `integer | null` — Expiration month, present for `card` entries.
    - **exp_year** `integer | null` — Expiration year, present for `card` entries.
    - **icon_url** `string | null` — Balance owner icon URL, present for `platform_balance` entries.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The funding source ID: a Whop balance (`ldgr_`) for `platform_balance`, or a payment method (`payt_`) for `card`.
    - **last4** `string | null` — Last four digits, present for `card` entries.
    - **title** `string | null` — Balance name, present for account `platform_balance` entries (null for a personal balance).
    - **type** `string` _requerido_ — The funding source kind: a Whop balance or a saved card. · valores: `platform_balance`, `card`
  - **primary** `object | null` _requerido_
    - **card_brand** `string | null` — Card brand, present for `card` entries.
    - **exp_month** `integer | null` — Expiration month, present for `card` entries.
    - **exp_year** `integer | null` — Expiration year, present for `card` entries.
    - **icon_url** `string | null` — Balance owner icon URL, present for `platform_balance` entries.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The funding source ID: a Whop balance (`ldgr_`) for `platform_balance`, or a payment method (`payt_`) for `card`.
    - **last4** `string | null` — Last four digits, present for `card` entries.
    - **title** `string | null` — Balance name, present for account `platform_balance` entries (null for a personal balance).
    - **type** `string` _requerido_ — The funding source kind: a Whop balance or a saved card. · valores: `platform_balance`, `card`
- **ads_reporting_currency** `string` _requerido_ — Lowercase ISO currency code, such as `usd` or `eur`, used to display ad spend and stats. Defaults to `usd`.
- **ads_scheduling_timezone** `string` _requerido_ — IANA timezone (e.g. `America/New_York`) used to interpret campaign start/end times and to bucket reports. Defaults to `America/New_York` until explicitly overridden.
- **ads_triple_whale_integration** `object` _requerido_ — The account's Triple Whale integration, which pushes Whop ad spend to Triple Whale's Data-In API so it reports as a `whop` channel.
  - **masked_api_key** `string | null` _requerido_ — The leading characters of the stored Data-In API key, followed by asterisks. The full key is never returned. `null` when no key is stored.
  - **shop_domain** `string | null` _requerido_ — The connected Shopify store domain spend is reported for, such as `acme.myshopify.com`. `null` when no store is connected.
  - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Where the integration stands. `requires_shopify_store` means no Shopify store is connected — Triple Whale keys records by Shopify shop, so no spend is reported until one is. · valores: `connected`, `not_connected`, `requires_shopify_store`
- **cards_auto_top_up** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether incoming funds are automatically moved to the account's cards balance. `false` when the account has no cards balance.
- **dispute_fighter_enabled** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether Whop assembles and files the evidence response when this account's payments are disputed. Off by default; enabling it also opts the account into the success fee charged only on disputes it wins.

## `GET /accounts/{account_id}/reserves`

**List Account Reserves**

Lists what the account's held balance is made of, one entry per currency: the total held, why each part is held, and the days it unlocks.

`operationId`: `listAccountReserves` · tags: `Accounts` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **account_id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — empty when nothing is held

- **data** `AccountReserve[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **amount** `string` _requerido_ — Total held in this currency, in native units, as a decimal string. `usd` and `usdt` are reported as one `usd` entry, matching how the balance row groups them.
    - **by_type** `AccountReserveType[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - **amount** `string` _requerido_ — Amount held for this reason, in native units, as a decimal string.
        - **hold_period_days** `integer | null` _requerido_ — Days money is currently held for this reason before it unlocks, or `null` when release depends on something other than time. Money already held keeps the terms it was taken under.
        - **percentage** `number | null` _requerido_ — Percentage of each incoming payment currently held for this reason, or `null` when the reason is not a percentage of anything. Money already held keeps the release date it was given, which `unlocks_by_date` reflects.
        - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Why this part of the balance is held. `regular` is the account's standing risk reserve; `bnpl` and `sequra` cover buy-now-pay-later settlement; `preshipment_hold` covers a physical order that has not shipped yet; `fraud_hold` is held while activity is reviewed. · valores: `regular`, `bnpl`, `sequra`, `fraud_hold`, `preshipment_hold`
    - **currency** `string` _requerido_ — Lowercase ISO currency code, such as `usd` or `eur`.
    - **unlocks_by_date** `AccountReserveUnlock[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - **amount** `string` _requerido_ — Amount unlocking that day across every reason, in native units, as a decimal string.
        - **date** `string` _requerido_ — The day this money unlocks, as an ISO 8601 date.

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`403`** — Forbidden

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`503`** — Service Unavailable

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

## `GET /accounts/{id}`

**Retrieve Account**

Retrieves a single account by ID or public route when it is visible to the credential, including its crypto wallet. The reserved id `me` retrieves the account associated with the current Account API key; user tokens have no single account, so they must address one by ID or route.

`operationId`: `retrieveAccount` · tags: `Accounts` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`, its public route, or `me` for the account associated with the current API key.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — account settling on stablecoin rails

- **balances** `AccountBalanceToken[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **balance** `string` _requerido_ — Total amount held in native units, as a decimal string.
    - **breakdown** `AccountBalanceBreakdown` _requerido_ — Balance split into available, pending, and reserve amounts, as native-unit decimal strings, with the days the pending amount is expected to settle. On-chain crypto is entirely available; good_funds and fiat cash can have pending or reserve portions.
      - **available** `string` _requerido_ — Amount you can spend, send, or withdraw now, in native units, as a decimal string.
      - **in_transit** `string` _requerido_ — Amount moving between the account's own destinations, such as a treasury sweep to its crypto wallet or a card top-up. In native units, as a decimal string.
      - **pending** `string` _requerido_ — Amount from recent payments still settling, in native units, as a decimal string.
      - **pending_settlements** `AccountBalanceSettlement[]` _requerido_
        - `array` de:
          - **amount** `string` _requerido_ — Amount expected that day, in native units, as a decimal string.
          - **date** `string` _requerido_ — The day this money is expected to finish settling, as an ISO 8601 date.
      - **reserve** `string` _requerido_ — Amount held back, in native units, as a decimal string. Retrieve the account's reserves for why it is held and when it unlocks.
    - **icon_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Holding icon URL.
    - **name** `string` _requerido_ — The holding's display name
    - **price_usd** `number | null` _requerido_ — USD price per unit, or `null` when no exchange rate is available.
    - **symbol** `string` _requerido_ — Holding display symbol, such as `USDT`, `cbBTC`, or `EUR`.
    - **value_usd** `string | null` _requerido_ — Holding USD value, or `null` when no exchange rate is available.
- **banner_image_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Account banner image URL.
- **business_address** `object | null` _requerido_ — Account business address used to calculate tax, with `line1`, `line2`, `city`, `state`, `postal_code`, and `country`. `null` when no address is set.
- **business_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The account's legal business name used with its tax address.
- **business_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — High-level business category for the account. See the [business types and industries glossary](/api-reference/beta/accounts/account#business-types-and-industries-glossary) for valid values. · valores: `education_program`, `coaching`, `software`, `paid_group`, `newsletter`, `agency`, `physical_products`, `brick_and_mortar`, `events`, `coaching_and_courses`, `other`, `services`, `gig_economy`, `marketplace`, `telehealth`, `class_action_settlement`, `physical_product`, `saas`, `course`, `community`, `None`
- **can_transfer_pending_balance_to_children** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether pending funds may be transferred from this platform account to its connected accounts.
- **capabilities** `AccountCapabilities | null` _requerido_ — Payment rails enabled for this account, each `active`, `inactive`, or `pending` (onboarding or review in progress). Computed only on `retrieve` and `me` for callers with `company:balance:read` scope; `null` otherwise.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AccountCapabilities**
      - **accept_bank_payments** `string` _requerido_ — Bank payins: debits, transfers, and local bank rails · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **accept_bnpl_payments** `string` _requerido_ — Buy-now-pay-later payins; requires approval · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **accept_card_payments** `string` _requerido_ — Card payins, including Apple Pay and Google Pay · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **bank_deposit** `string` _requerido_ — Deposits by bank wire or ACH to the account's virtual bank account · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **card_deposit** `string` _requerido_ — Balance top-ups by charging a stored payment method · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **card_issuing** `string` _requerido_ — Issuing Whop cards; requires card application approval · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **crypto_deposit** `string` _requerido_ — On-chain deposits to the account's crypto wallet · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **crypto_payout** `string` _requerido_ — On-chain payouts to a crypto wallet · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **instant_payout** `string` _requerido_ — Instant payouts to an eligible payout destination · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **run_ads** `string` _requerido_ — Launching ad campaigns through Whop Ads. `inactive` while a requested ads services agreement is awaiting the account's signature. · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **standard_payout** `string` _requerido_ — Standard payouts to an external payout destination · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **transfer** `string` _requerido_ — Transfers to other accounts · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
    - **null**
- **cards** `AccountCards | null` _requerido_ — Whop Cards application details for the account. Computed only on `retrieve` and `me` for callers with `company:balance:read` scope; `null` otherwise, or when the account has no card application.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AccountCards**
      - **kind** `string | null` _requerido_ — Whether the card application verifies a business (`business`, KYB) or a person (`individual`, consumer identity). `null` when the application is not yet linked to a verification. · valores: `individual`, `business`, `None`
      - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Where the card application stands. `approved` means cards can be issued. `needs_verification` means the applicant has not completed identity verification yet; `needs_information` means they did, but the documents were rejected for a fixable reason and must be resubmitted. `pending` and `manual_review` are in flight. `denied`, `locked`, and `canceled` are terminal. · valores: `approved`, `pending`, `manual_review`, `denied`, `locked`, `canceled`, `needs_verification`, `needs_information`
    - **null**
- **collect_vat_id** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether checkout shows a VAT/tax ID field for buyers to optionally enter. Does not require a VAT ID to purchase.
- **company_formation** `AccountCompanyFormation` _requerido_ — Company formation state for the account, managed through [Form Company](/api-reference/beta/accounts/form-company). A `draft` `status` until the formation checkout is paid, then filing progress with downloadable documents and signatures awaiting action. Empty when the formation state is temporarily unavailable.
  - **documents** `AccountCompanyFormationDocument[]`
    - `array` de:
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Document ID, prefixed `file_`.
      - **name** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable document name, such as `Articles of Organization`.
      - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Document category: `articles_of_organization`, `operating_agreement`, `ein_letter`, `signed_ss4`, `signed_form8821`, or `mail` for postal correspondence received on the company's behalf.
      - **url** `string` _requerido_ — CDN URL for downloading the document.
  - **ein_registered** `boolean` — Whether the company's EIN has been issued by the IRS. Present once `status` leaves `draft`.
  - **legal_name** `string | null` — Registered company name including the entity ending, for example `Acme, LLC`. Present once `status` leaves `draft`.
  - **signatures** `AccountCompanyFormationSignatures` — IRS forms still awaiting a founder's signature, each with a hosted signing URL. Present once `status` leaves `draft`; empty when nothing needs signing.
    - **form8821** `AccountCompanyFormationSignatureRequest` — Signature state for IRS Form 8821, the tax information authorization. Present only while the form still needs the founder's action.
      - **expires_at** `string` — When the signing URL expires, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Present while `status` is `pending`.
      - **status** `string` _requerido_ — `pending` when a signing session is ready for the founder; `unknown` when the signature state could not be determined. · valores: `pending`, `unknown`
      - **url** `string` — Hosted signing URL where the founder completes the form. Present while `status` is `pending`.
    - **ss4** `AccountCompanyFormationSignatureRequest` — Signature state for IRS Form SS-4, the EIN application. Present only while the form still needs the founder's action.
      - **expires_at** `string` — When the signing URL expires, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Present while `status` is `pending`.
      - **status** `string` _requerido_ — `pending` when a signing session is ready for the founder; `unknown` when the signature state could not be determined. · valores: `pending`, `unknown`
      - **url** `string` — Hosted signing URL where the founder completes the form. Present while `status` is `pending`.
  - **state_registered** `boolean` — Whether the state formation filing is complete. Present once `status` leaves `draft`.
  - **status** `string` · valores: `draft`, `processing`, `filed`, `rejected`, `completed`
- **country** `string | null` _requerido_ — Country where the account is located.
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the account was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **description** `string | null` _requerido_ — Account promotional description.
- **email** `string | null` _requerido_ — Account owner email address.
- **eula** `File | null` _requerido_ — The account's end-user license agreement document, or `null` if they have not published one.
  - _uno de:_
    - **File**
      - **content_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — The file's MIME type, e.g. `application/pdf`.
      - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the file was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
      - **filename** `string | null` _requerido_ — The original filename, including its extension.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The file's ID, prefixed `file_`.
      - **multipart_chunk_size** `integer | null` — The byte size each part (except the last) must be. Present only on create, and only for multipart uploads.
      - **multipart_upload_id** `string | null` — The ID of the multipart upload, passed back to `complete`. Present only on create, and only for multipart uploads.
      - **multipart_upload_urls** `array | null`
        - `array` de:
          - **part_number** `integer` _requerido_ — The 1-based index of this part within the multipart upload.
          - **url** `string` _requerido_ — The presigned URL to PUT this part's bytes to.
      - **object** `string` _requerido_ — The type of this object, always `file`.
      - **size** `integer | null` _requerido_ — The file size in bytes. `null` until the upload has finished.
      - **upload_headers** `object` — Headers to send with the upload PUT. Present only on create.
      - **upload_status** `string` _requerido_ — Where the file is in its upload lifecycle. · valores: `pending`, `processing`, `ready`, `failed`
      - **upload_url** `string | null` — Presigned URL to PUT the file's bytes to. Present only on create, and only for single-part uploads.
      - **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — A URL to download the file: a permanent CDN URL for public files, a signed expiring URL for private ones. `null` until the upload has finished.
      - **visibility** `string` _requerido_ — `public` files are served via an unsigned CDN URL; `private` files via a signed, expiring URL. · valores: `public`, `private`
    - **null**
- **home_preferences** `string[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - Public account home page preferences.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.
- **industry_group** `string | null` _requerido_ — Account industry group. See the [business types and industries glossary](/api-reference/beta/accounts/account#business-types-and-industries-glossary) for valid values. · valores: `academic_and_test_prep`, `accessories`, `agriculture_and_farming`, `ai_and_automation_agencies`, `ai_and_automation_software`, `arts_and_crafts`, `automotive`, `b2b_and_professional_marketplaces`, `baby_and_kids`, `bars_and_breweries`, `beauty_and_personal_care`, `beauty_and_wellness`, `business_and_entrepreneurship`, `business_and_money_groups`, `cafes_and_quick_service`, `career_and_professional`, `charity_and_cause_events`, `class_action_settlement`, `clothing_and_apparel`, `communication_and_messaging_software`, `community_and_education_software`, `conference_and_expo_events`, `consulting`, `content_and_clipping_agencies` …

  - _uno de:_
    - **AccountPaymentControls**
      - **dispute_alert_auto_refund** `AccountDisputeAlertAutoRefundControl` _requerido_ — Automatic refund settings for pre-chargeback dispute alerts.
        - **locked** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the account owner is prevented from changing this threshold.
        - **threshold_usd** `number | null` _requerido_ — Maximum dispute alert amount automatically refunded in USD. `null` when automatic refunds are disabled.
      - **dispute_alert_fee_usd** `number | null` _requerido_ — Fee charged for each dispute alert in USD. `null` when unavailable.
      - **enforce_3ds** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether 3-D Secure is forced on every card payment at checkout. The account cannot bypass it while set.
      - **financing_disabled** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether payment health controls explicitly disable financing. This is independent of financing approval in `capabilities.accept_bnpl_payments`.
      - **high_risk_processing_fee_percentage** `number` _requerido_ — Additional processing fee percentage for high-risk processing.
      - **pending_auto_topup_fee_percentage** `number` _requerido_ — Percentage fee charged when pending, not-yet-settled balance is advanced to fund the account's cards balance, where `2` means 2%. `0` when the account is exempt.
      - **pending_balance_delay_days** `integer` _requerido_ — Additional days payments remain pending before becoming available.
      - **reserve** `AccountReserveControl` _requerido_ — Reserve currently applied to incoming payment volume.
        - **hold_period_days** `integer` _requerido_ — Number of days reserved funds are held before release.
        - **percentage** `number | null` _requerido_ — Percentage of incoming payment volume held in reserve. `null` when no reserve is applied.
      - **resolution_center_auto_refund** `AccountResolutionCenterAutoRefundControl` _requerido_ — Automatic refund settings for resolution center cases.
        - **card_threshold_usd** `number | null` _requerido_ — Maximum card-funded resolution center case amount automatically refunded in USD. `null` when automatic refunds are disabled for cards.
        - **financing_threshold_usd** `number | null` _requerido_ — Maximum financing-funded resolution center case amount automatically refunded in USD. `null` when automatic refunds are disabled for financing.
        - **locked** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the account owner is prevented from changing these thresholds.
        - **paypal_threshold_usd** `number | null` _requerido_ — Maximum PayPal-funded resolution center case amount automatically refunded in USD. `null` when automatic refunds are disabled for PayPal.

## `PATCH /accounts/{id}`

**Update Account**

Updates an account. User tokens can update business accounts; Account API keys can update connected accounts. The reserved id `me` — accepted on Retrieve Account — resolves to the requesting account, which an Account API key cannot edit, so updates must name the connected account by its `biz_` id.

`operationId`: `updateAccount` · tags: `Accounts` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **affiliate_application_required** `boolean` — Whether prospective affiliates must submit an application before promoting this account.
- **affiliate_instructions** `string | null` — Guidelines shown to affiliates promoting this account.
- **banner_image** `object | null` — Account banner image, used as the cover photo when creating a Whop-managed Facebook page. Image files up to 10 MB, except `image/gif`. Pass a JSON object containing an `id` from [Create File](/api-reference/files/create-file).
  - **id** `string` — ID of a file from [Create File](/api-reference/files/create-file), prefixed `file_`.
- **business_address** `object` — Account business address used to calculate tax. A complete address in a supported country is required when `tax_remitted_by` is `self`.
  - **city** `string | null` — City name.
  - **country** `string` — Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, for example `US`, `DE`, or `GB`.
  - **line1** `string` — First line of the street address.
  - **line2** `string | null` — Second line of the street address.
  - **postal_code** `string | null` — Postal or ZIP code.
  - **state** `string | null` — State, province, or region code, for example `CA`.
- **business_name** `string | null` — The legal business name used with the account's tax address.
- **business_type** `string | null` — High-level business category for the account. See the [business types and industries glossary](/api-reference/beta/accounts/account#business-types-and-industries-glossary) for valid values. · valores: `education_program`, `coaching`, `software`, `paid_group`, `newsletter`, `agency`, `physical_products`, `brick_and_mortar`, `events`, `coaching_and_courses`, `other`, `services`, `gig_economy`, `marketplace`, `telehealth`, `class_action_settlement`, `physical_product`, `saas`, `course`, `community`, `None`
- **collect_vat_id** `boolean` — Whether checkout shows a VAT/tax ID field for buyers to optionally enter. Does not require a VAT ID to purchase.
- **country** `string | null` — Country where the account is located.
- **description** `string | null` — Account promotional description. When creating a Whop-managed Facebook page, it is truncated to 155 characters and used as the About text.
- **featured_affiliate_product_id** `string | null` — The ID of the product to feature for affiliates. Pass `null` to clear.
- **home_preferences** `string[]` — Public account home page preferences.
  - `array` de:
- **industry_group** `string | null` — Account industry group. See the [business types and industries glossary](/api-reference/beta/accounts/account#business-types-and-industries-glossary) for valid values. · valores: `academic_and_test_prep`, `accessories`, `agriculture_and_farming`, `ai_and_automation_agencies`, `ai_and_automation_software`, `arts_and_crafts`, `automotive`, `b2b_and_professional_marketplaces`, `baby_and_kids`, `bars_and_breweries`, `beauty_and_personal_care`, `beauty_and_wellness`, `business_and_entrepreneurship`, `business_and_money_groups`, `cafes_and_quick_service`, `career_and_professional`, `charity_and_cause_events`, `class_action_settlement`, `clothing_and_apparel`, `communication_and_messaging_software`, `community_and_education_software`, `conference_and_expo_events`, `consulting`, `content_and_clipping_agencies` …
- **industry_type** `string | null` — Specific industry vertical for the account. See the [business types and industries glossary](/api-reference/beta/accounts/account#business-types-and-industries-glossary) for valid values. · valores: `trading`, `sports_betting`, `reselling`, `fitness`, `amazon_fba`, `real_estate`, `kindle_book_publishing`, `dating`, `agencies`, `health_and_wellness`, `social_media`, `sales`, `business`, `ecommerce`, `video_games`, `home_services`, `ai`, `public_speaking`, `personal_finance`, `careers`, `travel`, `clipping`, `spirituality`, `vas` …
- **invoice_prefix** `string | null` — Prefix used for account invoices.
- **logo** `object | null` — Account logo, used as the profile picture when creating a Whop-managed Facebook page. Image files up to 5 MB. Pass a JSON object containing an `id` from [Create File](/api-reference/files/create-file).
  - **id** `string` — ID of a file from [Create File](/api-reference/files/create-file), prefixed `file_`.
- **metadata** `object` — Arbitrary key/value metadata to store on the account.
- **onboarding_type** `string | null` — The type of onboarding the account has completed. · valores: `platform`, `seller`, `None`
- **opengraph_image** `object | null` — Open Graph preview media used when the account is shared. Image and video files up to 5 MB. Pass a JSON object containing an `id` from [Create File](/api-reference/files/create-file).
  - **id** `string` — ID of a file from [Create File](/api-reference/files/create-file), prefixed `file_`.
- **opengraph_image_variant** `string | null` — The account Open Graph image variant. · valores: `white`, `black`, `orange`, `None`
- **other_business_description** `string | null` — The description of the business type when business_type is other.
- **other_industry_description** `string | null` — The description of the industry type when industry_type is other.
- **product_tax_code_id** `string | null` — ID of the tax classification code applied by default to the account's products. See the available [product categories](https://docs.numeral.com/essentials/product-categories).
- **require_2fa** `boolean` — Whether the account requires authorized users to have two-factor authentication enabled.
- **route** `string | null` — The unique URL slug for the account.
- **send_customer_emails** `boolean` — Whether Whop sends transactional emails to customers on behalf of this account.
- **show_joined_whops** `boolean` — Whether the account appears in joined whops on other accounts.
- **show_reviews_dtc** `boolean` — Whether reviews are displayed on direct-to-consumer product pages.
- **show_user_directory** `boolean` — Whether the account shows users in the user directory.
- **social_links** `object[]` — The full list of social links to display for the account.
  - `array` de:
    - `object` de claves libres
- **store_page_config** `object | null` — Account store page display configuration.
  - **accent_color** `string | null` — Accent color used on the account store page. · valores: `ruby`, `tomato`, `red`, `crimson`, `pink`, `plum`, `purple`, `violet`, `iris`, `cyan`, `teal`, `jade`, `green`, `grass`, `brown`, `blue`, `orange`, `indigo`, `sky`, `mint`, `yellow`, `amber`, `lime`, `lemon` …
  - **layout** `string | null` — Layout used on the account store page. · valores: `featured`, `compact`, `None`
  - **profile_variant** `string | null` — Profile presentation used on the account store page. · valores: `personal`, `business`, `None`
  - **whop_affiliate_link** `boolean` — Whether the account store page shows a Whop affiliate link.
- **target_audience** `string | null` — The target audience for this account.
- **tax_collection_enabled_states** `string[]` — US state codes (50 states plus `DC`) where the account collects tax. Replaces the full set on update. Only settable when `tax_remitted_by` is `self`.
  - `array` de:
- **tax_identifiers** `object[]` — Account tax/VAT registrations to add or update. When `tax_remitted_by` is `self`, tax is calculated and collected only in the countries where the account holds a registration.
  - `array` de:
    - **tax_id_type** `string` _requerido_ — Tax ID type, for example `eu_vat`, `gb_vat`, or `us_ein`. · valores: `ad_nrt`, `ao_tin`, `ar_cuit`, `al_tin`, `am_tin`, `aw_tin`, `au_abn`, `au_arn`, `eu_vat`, `az_tin`, `bs_tin`, `bh_vat`, `bd_bin`, `bb_tin`, `by_tin`, `bj_ifu`, `bo_tin`, `ba_tin`, `br_cnpj`, `br_cpf`, `bg_uic`, `bf_ifu`, `kh_tin`, `cm_niu` …
    - **tax_id_value** `string` _requerido_ — Tax ID value, for example `DE123456789`.
- **tax_remitted_by** `string` — Determines whether Whop or the account calculates and remits tax. The account must provide a supported-country business address when it self-remits. · valores: `whop`, `self`, `none`
- **tax_type** `string` — Determines whether tax is included in the listed price or added at checkout. · valores: `inclusive`, `exclusive`
- **three_ds_level** `string | null` — Account-level 3D Secure behavior. Set `mandate_challenge` to require cardholder verification on supported card payments, or `null` to use the standard checkout flow. · valores: `mandate_challenge`
- **title** `string | null` — The display name of the account.
- **use_logo_as_opengraph_image_fallback** `boolean` — Whether the account uses its logo as the fallback Open Graph image.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — account updated

- **balances** `AccountBalanceToken[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **balance** `string` _requerido_ — Total amount held in native units, as a decimal string.
    - **breakdown** `AccountBalanceBreakdown` _requerido_ — Balance split into available, pending, and reserve amounts, as native-unit decimal strings, with the days the pending amount is expected to settle. On-chain crypto is entirely available; good_funds and fiat cash can have pending or reserve portions.
      - **available** `string` _requerido_ — Amount you can spend, send, or withdraw now, in native units, as a decimal string.
      - **in_transit** `string` _requerido_ — Amount moving between the account's own destinations, such as a treasury sweep to its crypto wallet or a card top-up. In native units, as a decimal string.
      - **pending** `string` _requerido_ — Amount from recent payments still settling, in native units, as a decimal string.
      - **pending_settlements** `AccountBalanceSettlement[]` _requerido_
        - `array` de:
          - **amount** `string` _requerido_ — Amount expected that day, in native units, as a decimal string.
          - **date** `string` _requerido_ — The day this money is expected to finish settling, as an ISO 8601 date.
      - **reserve** `string` _requerido_ — Amount held back, in native units, as a decimal string. Retrieve the account's reserves for why it is held and when it unlocks.
    - **icon_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Holding icon URL.
    - **name** `string` _requerido_ — The holding's display name
    - **price_usd** `number | null` _requerido_ — USD price per unit, or `null` when no exchange rate is available.
    - **symbol** `string` _requerido_ — Holding display symbol, such as `USDT`, `cbBTC`, or `EUR`.
    - **value_usd** `string | null` _requerido_ — Holding USD value, or `null` when no exchange rate is available.
- **banner_image_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Account banner image URL.
- **business_address** `object | null` _requerido_ — Account business address used to calculate tax, with `line1`, `line2`, `city`, `state`, `postal_code`, and `country`. `null` when no address is set.
- **business_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The account's legal business name used with its tax address.
- **business_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — High-level business category for the account. See the [business types and industries glossary](/api-reference/beta/accounts/account#business-types-and-industries-glossary) for valid values. · valores: `education_program`, `coaching`, `software`, `paid_group`, `newsletter`, `agency`, `physical_products`, `brick_and_mortar`, `events`, `coaching_and_courses`, `other`, `services`, `gig_economy`, `marketplace`, `telehealth`, `class_action_settlement`, `physical_product`, `saas`, `course`, `community`, `None`
- **can_transfer_pending_balance_to_children** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether pending funds may be transferred from this platform account to its connected accounts.
- **capabilities** `AccountCapabilities | null` _requerido_ — Payment rails enabled for this account, each `active`, `inactive`, or `pending` (onboarding or review in progress). Computed only on `retrieve` and `me` for callers with `company:balance:read` scope; `null` otherwise.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AccountCapabilities**
      - **accept_bank_payments** `string` _requerido_ — Bank payins: debits, transfers, and local bank rails · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **accept_bnpl_payments** `string` _requerido_ — Buy-now-pay-later payins; requires approval · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **accept_card_payments** `string` _requerido_ — Card payins, including Apple Pay and Google Pay · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **bank_deposit** `string` _requerido_ — Deposits by bank wire or ACH to the account's virtual bank account · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **card_deposit** `string` _requerido_ — Balance top-ups by charging a stored payment method · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **card_issuing** `string` _requerido_ — Issuing Whop cards; requires card application approval · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **crypto_deposit** `string` _requerido_ — On-chain deposits to the account's crypto wallet · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **crypto_payout** `string` _requerido_ — On-chain payouts to a crypto wallet · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **instant_payout** `string` _requerido_ — Instant payouts to an eligible payout destination · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **run_ads** `string` _requerido_ — Launching ad campaigns through Whop Ads. `inactive` while a requested ads services agreement is awaiting the account's signature. · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **standard_payout** `string` _requerido_ — Standard payouts to an external payout destination · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
      - **transfer** `string` _requerido_ — Transfers to other accounts · valores: `active`, `inactive`, `pending`
    - **null**
- **cards** `AccountCards | null` _requerido_ — Whop Cards application details for the account. Computed only on `retrieve` and `me` for callers with `company:balance:read` scope; `null` otherwise, or when the account has no card application.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AccountCards**
      - **kind** `string | null` _requerido_ — Whether the card application verifies a business (`business`, KYB) or a person (`individual`, consumer identity). `null` when the application is not yet linked to a verification. · valores: `individual`, `business`, `None`
      - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Where the card application stands. `approved` means cards can be issued. `needs_verification` means the applicant has not completed identity verification yet; `needs_information` means they did, but the documents were rejected for a fixable reason and must be resubmitted. `pending` and `manual_review` are in flight. `denied`, `locked`, and `canceled` are terminal. · valores: `approved`, `pending`, `manual_review`, `denied`, `locked`, `canceled`, `needs_verification`, `needs_information`
    - **null**
- **collect_vat_id** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether checkout shows a VAT/tax ID field for buyers to optionally enter. Does not require a VAT ID to purchase.
- **company_formation** `AccountCompanyFormation` _requerido_ — Company formation state for the account, managed through [Form Company](/api-reference/beta/accounts/form-company). A `draft` `status` until the formation checkout is paid, then filing progress with downloadable documents and signatures awaiting action. Empty when the formation state is temporarily unavailable.
  - **documents** `AccountCompanyFormationDocument[]`
    - `array` de:
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Document ID, prefixed `file_`.
      - **name** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable document name, such as `Articles of Organization`.
      - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Document category: `articles_of_organization`, `operating_agreement`, `ein_letter`, `signed_ss4`, `signed_form8821`, or `mail` for postal correspondence received on the company's behalf.
      - **url** `string` _requerido_ — CDN URL for downloading the document.
  - **ein_registered** `boolean` — Whether the company's EIN has been issued by the IRS. Present once `status` leaves `draft`.
  - **legal_name** `string | null` — Registered company name including the entity ending, for example `Acme, LLC`. Present once `status` leaves `draft`.
  - **signatures** `AccountCompanyFormationSignatures` — IRS forms still awaiting a founder's signature, each with a hosted signing URL. Present once `status` leaves `draft`; empty when nothing needs signing.
    - **form8821** `AccountCompanyFormationSignatureRequest` — Signature state for IRS Form 8821, the tax information authorization. Present only while the form still needs the founder's action.
      - **expires_at** `string` — When the signing URL expires, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Present while `status` is `pending`.
      - **status** `string` _requerido_ — `pending` when a signing session is ready for the founder; `unknown` when the signature state could not be determined. · valores: `pending`, `unknown`
      - **url** `string` — Hosted signing URL where the founder completes the form. Present while `status` is `pending`.
    - **ss4** `AccountCompanyFormationSignatureRequest` — Signature state for IRS Form SS-4, the EIN application. Present only while the form still needs the founder's action.
      - **expires_at** `string` — When the signing URL expires, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Present while `status` is `pending`.
      - **status** `string` _requerido_ — `pending` when a signing session is ready for the founder; `unknown` when the signature state could not be determined. · valores: `pending`, `unknown`
      - **url** `string` — Hosted signing URL where the founder completes the form. Present while `status` is `pending`.
  - **state_registered** `boolean` — Whether the state formation filing is complete. Present once `status` leaves `draft`.
  - **status** `string` · valores: `draft`, `processing`, `filed`, `rejected`, `completed`

    - **tax_id_value** `string` _requerido_ — Tax ID value.
- **tax_remitted_by** `string | null` _requerido_ — Who calculates and remits tax for the account: `whop` (Whop calculates and remits), `self` (Whop calculates; the account collects and remits), or `none` (neither; the account is responsible). `null` until the account enrolls in the Whop tax service. · valores: `whop`, `self`, `none`, `None`
- **tax_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — How tax is applied to the account's prices: `inclusive` (tax included in the listed price) or `exclusive` (tax added on top). Defaults to `exclusive` when unset; `null` only when the account has no payment connection. · valores: `inclusive`, `exclusive`, `None`
- **terms_of_service** `File | null` _requerido_ — The account's terms of service document, or `null` if they have not published one.

## `POST /accounts/{id}/form_company`

**Form Company**

Starts an LLC or C-Corp formation for a business account. Defaults to an LLC; set `entity_type` to `c_corp` to form a C-Corp, which additionally requires `share_structure` and officer `roles` on every founder. On submission, the application is validated and the response returns a hosted checkout URL. Once paid, the filing is submitted. Track progress through the account's [`company_formation`](/api-reference/beta/accounts/retrieve-account) field on Retrieve Account.

`operationId`: `formCompany` · tags: `Accounts` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.
- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **business_address** `object` — Company mailing address. Required unless `use_registered_agent` is `true`.
  - **city** `string` _requerido_
  - **country** `string` _requerido_ — Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, for example `US`.
  - **line1** `string` _requerido_ — First line of the street address.
  - **line2** `string` — Second line of the street address.
  - **postal_code** `string` _requerido_ — Postal or ZIP code.
  - **state** `string` _requerido_ — State or region code, for example `CA`.
- **business_name** `string` _requerido_ — Legal name for the new company.
- **business_phone** `string` — Business phone number in E.164 format, for example `+12125550100`. Required unless `use_registered_agent` is `true`.
- **business_type** `string` _requerido_ — High-level business category, from the Whop business taxonomy. Valid values are listed on [business types and industries glossary](/api-reference/beta/accounts/account#business-types-and-industries-glossary).
- **business_website** `string` — Company website URL.
- **entity_suffix** `string` — Legal entity ending appended to `business_name`. LLC formations accept `LLC`, `L.L.C`, `L.L.C.` or `Limited Liability Company` and default to `LLC`; C-Corp formations accept `Inc`, `Inc.`, `Incorporated`, `Corp.`, `Corporation`, `C Corp`, `C Corporation`, `CCorp` or `Company` and default to `Inc.`. Unrecognized values fall back to the default for the entity type. · valores: `LLC`, `L.L.C`, `L.L.C.`, `Limited Liability Company`, `Inc`, `Inc.`, `Incorporated`, `Corp.`, `Corporation`, `C Corp`, `C Corporation`, `CCorp`, `Company`
- **entity_type** `string` — Legal entity type to form. Defaults to `llc`. · valores: `llc`, `c_corp`
- **expedite_ein** `boolean` — Request expedited EIN processing for an additional fee. Available only when no founder supplies an SSN.
- **formation_state** `string` _requerido_ — Two-letter code of the US state (or `DC`) to form the company in. · valores: `AL`, `AK`, `AZ`, `AR`, `CA`, `CO`, `CT`, `DE`, `DC`, `FL`, `GA`, `HI`, `ID`, `IL`, `IN`, `IA`, `KS`, `KY`, `LA`, `ME`, `MD`, `MA`, `MI`, `MN` …
- **founders** `object[]` _requerido_ — The company's founders. Exactly one must be marked `is_primary` — the responsible party for the filing.
  - `array` de:
    - **address** `object` _requerido_ — Founder's personal address.
      - **city** `string` _requerido_
      - **country** `string` _requerido_ — Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, for example `US`.
      - **line1** `string` _requerido_ — First line of the street address.
      - **line2** `string` — Second line of the street address.
      - **postal_code** `string` _requerido_ — Postal or ZIP code.
      - **state** `string` _requerido_ — State or region code, for example `CA`.
    - **date_of_birth** `string` — Formatted as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
    - **email** `string` _requerido_
    - **first_name** `string` _requerido_
    - **is_primary** `boolean` _requerido_ — Marks the responsible party for the filing. Exactly one founder must be primary.
    - **last_name** `string` _requerido_
    - **ownership_percentage** `number` — The founder's ownership share: greater than `0`, at most `100`. Shares across founders must total `100`. Required when `entity_type` is `llc`; ignored for C-Corps.
    - **phone** `string` _requerido_ — Phone number in E.164 format, for example `+12125550100`.
    - **roles** `string[]` — Officer roles held by the member — one member can hold several. Required (at least one role) for every member when `entity_type` is `c_corp`; ignored for LLCs. Across all members every role must be covered; `president`, `secretary` and `treasurer` may each be held by only one member, while `director` may repeat.
      - `array` de:
    - **ssn** `string` — The founder's US Social Security Number. Leave empty if the founder is not a US resident. Non-US founders can request expedited EIN processing via the `expedite_ein` option.
- **industry_group** `string` _requerido_ — Industry group, from the Whop business taxonomy. Valid values are listed on [business types and industries glossary](/api-reference/beta/accounts/account#business-types-and-industries-glossary).
- **industry_type** `string` _requerido_ — Specific industry vertical, from the Whop business taxonomy. Valid values are listed on [business types and industries glossary](/api-reference/beta/accounts/account#business-types-and-industries-glossary).
- **share_structure** `object` — Authorized share structure. Required when `entity_type` is `c_corp`; ignored for LLCs.
  - **number_of_shares** `integer` _requerido_ — Number of shares the company authorizes. Must be greater than `0`.
  - **value** `number` _requerido_ — Par value per share, in USD. Must be greater than `0`; fractional values like `0.01` are allowed.
- **use_registered_agent** `boolean` — Use the registered agent's address as the company address instead of `business_address`.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — application accepted and checkout created

- **checkout_session_id** `string` _requerido_ — Checkout session ID, prefixed `ch_`.
- **checkout_url** `string` _requerido_ — Hosted checkout URL. Send the buyer here to pay for the formation; the filing is submitted once payment completes.
- **currency** `string` _requerido_ — Always `usd`.
- **total** `integer` _requerido_ — Total due at checkout in USD cents.

**`400`** — Invalid Parameters

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`403`** — Forbidden

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`404`** — Resource not found

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`409`** — Conflict

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.
