## `GET /ad_groups/{id}`

**Retrieve an Ad Group**

Retrieves a single ad group.

`operationId`: `retrieveAdGroup` · tags: `Ad Groups` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The ad group ID.
- **stats_from** (`query`) `string` — Start of the stats window.
- **stats_to** (`query`) `string` — End of the stats window.
- **time_zone** (`query`) `string` — IANA timezone the stats window is interpreted in. Defaults to UTC.
- **attribution_model** (`query`) `string` — Attribution model the conversion stats count under (defaults to last_touch). Under both models a journey with any whop ad touch attributes to whop; the model picks which whop touch credits the entity and which non-whop source wins otherwise. · valores: `last_touch`, `first_touch`

### Respuestas

**`200`** — ad group retrieved

- **ad_campaign** `AdEntityReference` _requerido_ — The ad campaign this ad group belongs to.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The referenced entity's id.
- **added_to_cart_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to add-to-cart events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
- **added_to_carts** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed add-to-cart events, last-click.
- **audiences** `AdGroupAudiences` _requerido_ — Saved audiences this ad group delivers to or excludes.
  - **exclude** `string[]` _requerido_
    - `array` de:
      - IDs of saved audiences excluded from delivery, prefixed `adaud_`.
  - **include** `string[]` _requerido_
    - `array` de:
      - IDs of saved audiences the ad group delivers to, prefixed `adaud_`.
- **bid_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — How delivery bids are set in the ad auction. Target-based strategies use `desired_cost_per_result`. · valores: `minimum_cost`, `average_target`, `maximum_target`, `None`
- **budget_amount** `number | null` _requerido_ — This ad group's budget, in the ad account's currency. `null` when the budget is set on the campaign instead.
- **budget_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — Whether `budget_amount` is spent per day (`daily`) or over the ad group's full run (`lifetime`). · valores: `daily`, `lifetime`, `None`
- **click_through_rate** `number` _requerido_ — Clicks divided by impressions, between 0 and 1.
- **clicks** `number` _requerido_ — The number of clicks.
- **completed_registration_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to complete-registration events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
- **completed_registrations** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed complete-registration events, last-click.
- **contact_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to contact events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
- **contacts** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed contact events, last-click.
- **conversion_event** `ConversionEvent` _requerido_ — The pixel event optimized for. A standard event, or any custom pixel event name.
  - _cualquiera de:_
    - **string**
    - **string**
    - **null**
- **conversion_location** `string | null` — Where the outcome being optimized for occurs, such as a website visit, social-profile visit, messaging conversation, ad interaction, or lead-form submission. · valores: `website`, `profile`, `instagram_and_facebook`, `instagram_profile`, `messaging`, `on_ad`, `instant_forms`, `instant_forms_and_messenger`, `website_and_instant_forms`, `None`
- **cost_per_added_to_cart** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed add-to-cart events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.
- **cost_per_click** `number` _requerido_ — Spend divided by clicks; 0 when there are no clicks.
- **cost_per_completed_registration** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed complete-registration events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.
- **cost_per_contact** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed contact events; null when contacts are not the goal and none are attributed.
- **cost_per_lead** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed leads; null when leads are not a goal and none are attributed.
- **cost_per_mille** `number` _requerido_ — Spend per 1,000 impressions; 0 when there are no impressions.
- **cost_per_purchase** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed purchases; null when purchases are not a goal and none are attributed.
- **cost_per_result** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by Whop pixel-attributed results; null when nothing Whop-attributable is being optimized for.
- **cost_per_schedule** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed schedule events; null when schedules are not the goal and none are attributed.
- **cost_per_submitted_application** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed submit-application events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.
- **cost_per_unique_click** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by unique clicks; null when there are no unique clicks.
- **cost_per_viewed_content** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed view-content events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the ad group was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **custom_conversions** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed custom (merchant-defined) conversion events, last-click, across all custom event names.
- **custom_event_counts** `object` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed custom conversions, keyed by your event name with its last-click count as the value. Empty when no named custom events are attributed. Custom events fired without a name are counted in custom_conversions but omitted here, so these values sum to at most custom_conversions.
- **custom_event_values** `object` _requerido_ — Conversion value attributed to each custom event, keyed by event name like custom_event_counts. Sums the value passed to whop.track, normalized to USD; events fired without a value contribute 0.
- **delivery_status** `string` _requerido_ — Whether ads in this ad group are delivering right now, and if not, why. When several states apply at once, the highest-precedence one is returned. · valores: `all_ads_rejected`, `rejected`, `draft`, `no_ads`, `campaign_paused`, `paused`, `processing`, `issues`, `scheduled`, `completed`, `ads_off`, `learning_limited`, `learning`, `active`
- **demographics** `AdGroupDemographics` _requerido_ — Age, gender, and automatic-audience targeting.
  - **automatic** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether automatic audience targeting is on (Advantage+ on Meta). When `true`, the platform can deliver beyond the ages, genders, and detailed targeting you set, treating them as suggestions.
  - **gender** `string` _requerido_ — Gender targeted. · valores: `all`, `male`, `female`
  - **maximum_age** `number | null` _requerido_ — Oldest age targeted. `null` when no maximum is set.
  - **minimum_age** `number | null` _requerido_ — Youngest age targeted. `null` when no minimum is set.
- **desired_cost_per_result** `number | null` _requerido_ — Cost per result to aim for (`average_target`) or never exceed (`maximum_target`). `null` for `minimum_cost` bidding.
- **detailed_targeting** `AdGroupDetailedTargeting` _requerido_ — Interest, behavior, and demographic targeting, using categories from the ad platform's targeting taxonomy. Entries across interests, behaviors, and demographics are OR'd together (anyone matching any entry is reached), matching Ads Manager's detailed-targeting box. Can't be combined with automatic audience targeting. Special ad category campaigns are limited to approved interests.
  - **behaviors** `AdGroupBehaviorCategory[]` _requerido_
    - `array` de:
      - **behavior_type** `string` — On ad platforms that scope behavior categories, what this one is measured on. Send back the value the targeting_options endpoint returned alongside the id. Absent on platforms that don't scope them. · valores: `video`, `creator`, `hashtag`
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The ad platform's ID for the category in its targeting taxonomy.
      - **name** `string` — Category name, such as `Frequent travelers`.
      - **period** `number` — On ad platforms that scope behavior categories, how many days of activity the category covers. Absent on platforms that don't scope them.
  - **demographics** `AdGroupDemographicCategory[]` _requerido_
    - `array` de:
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The ad platform's ID for the category in its targeting taxonomy.
      - **name** `string` — Category name, such as `Recently moved`.
      - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Kind of demographic the category belongs to. · valores: `life_events`, `industries`, `income`, `family_statuses`, `work_employers`, `work_positions`, `education_schools`, `education_majors`
  - **interests** `AdGroupTargetingCategory[]` _requerido_
    - `array` de:
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The ad platform's ID for the category in its targeting taxonomy.
      - **name** `string` — Category name, such as `Movies`.
- **devices** `AdGroupDevices` _requerido_ — Device platforms and operating systems targeted.
  - **operating_systems** `AdGroupOperatingSystem[]` _requerido_
    - `array` de:
      - **minimum_version** `string` — Lowest OS version targeted, such as `18.0`. Absent when any version qualifies.
      - **os** `string` _requerido_ — Operating system targeted. · valores: `ios`, `android`
  - **platforms** `string[]` _requerido_
    - `array` de:
      - Device types targeted. Empty targets all devices.
- **dynamic_creative** `boolean` — Whether the ad platform automatically mixes and matches this ad group's creatives and copy to find the best-performing combinations.
- **ends_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the ad group stops delivering, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` when it runs until paused.
- **frequency** `number | null` _requerido_ — Platform-reported impressions divided by reach.
- **frequency_cap** `AdGroupFrequencyCap | null` _requerido_ — Cap on how often one person sees ads from this ad group. Only available on campaigns with the `awareness` objective; `null` when uncapped.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AdGroupFrequencyCap**
      - **maximum_impressions** `number` _requerido_ — Most times one person can be shown ads from this ad group within the window.
      - **per_days** `number | null` _requerido_ — Length of the rolling window, in days.
    - **null**
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — Unique identifier for the ad group, prefixed `adgrp_`.
- **impressions** `number` _requerido_ — The number of impressions.
- **issues** `AdPlatformIssue[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Unique identifier for the issue.
    - **message** `string` _requerido_ — A description of what the issue is and how it can be resolved.

- **languages** `string[]` _requerido_

- **placements** `AdGroupPlacement[]` _requerido_

    - **countries** `string[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:

    - **country_groups** `string[]` _requerido_

      - `array` de:
        - **key** `string` _requerido_ — The ad platform's key for the city in its location taxonomy.

      - `array` de:
        - Multi-country groups such as `worldwide` or `europe`.
    - **custom_locations** `AdGroupCustomLocation[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:

        - **latitude** `number` _requerido_ — Latitude of the center point.
        - **longitude** `number` _requerido_ — Longitude of the center point.
        - **name** `string` — Label for the location, such as a city or address. Absent when the location has no label.
        - **radius** `number` _requerido_ — Radius around the center point, in `distance_unit`.
    - **regions** `string[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - US states and DC, as ISO 3166-2 codes such as `US-CA`. US territories (`PR`, `GU`, `VI`, `AS`, `MP`) and everywhere outside the US are targeted through `countries`.
    - **zips** `string[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - ZIP and postal codes, keyed by the ad platform's location taxonomy. Meta keys these `COUNTRY:CODE`, as `US:78756`.
- **result_event** `string | null` _requerido_ — The Whop pixel conversion event whose attributed count represents results — the optimization goal, or the highest-volume attributed event for campaigns that budget per ad group. Null when the goal isn't a Whop-attributed event. · valores: `purchase`, `lead`, `schedule`, `submit_application`, `contact`, `complete_registration`, `view_content`, `add_to_cart`, `custom`, `messaging_conversation`, `None`
- **result_event_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The merchant-defined event name when result_event is custom; null for the standard events.

When a campaign's ad groups optimize different goals there is no single result_event (it is null), and this is instead the sum of each ad group's own attributed results. Null when nothing Whop-attributable is being optimized for.

## `POST /ad_groups/{id}/duplicate`

**Duplicate an Ad Group**

Creates copies of the ad group in `duplicating` status and returns them — into its own campaign, or into target_ad_campaign_id (which must belong to the same account and be compatible with the ad group's targeting and goals); each copy transitions to its final status (matching the source's active/paused state) once duplication completes. Poll each returned ad group until it leaves `duplicating` — a copy that could not be completed is deleted and returns 404.

`operationId`: `duplicateAdGroup` · tags: `Ad Groups` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The ad group ID.
- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

### Request body — `application/json`

- **count** `integer` — Number of copies to create (1-10). Defaults to 1.
- **preserve_engagement** `boolean` — Whether the copied ads keep the original posts' engagement (likes, comments, shares). Defaults to false.
- **target_ad_campaign_id** `string` — Campaign to duplicate into. Defaults to the ad group's own campaign.

**`201`** — ad group duplication started

Entries across interests, behaviors, and demographics are OR'd together (anyone matching any entry is reached), matching Ads Manager's detailed-targeting box.       - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The ad platform's ID for the category in its targeting taxonomy.

  - _uno de:_

    - **null**
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — Unique identifier for the ad group, prefixed `adgrp_`.
- **impressions** `number` _requerido_ — The number of impressions.

  - `array` de:

    - **message** `string` _requerido_ — A description of what the issue is and how it can be resolved.

    - **resource_type** `string` _requerido_ — The type of resource the issue is attached to. · valores: `ad_campaign`, `ad_group`, `ad`

- **link_clicks** `number` _requerido_ — Clicks on links in the ad that lead to your destination, as reported by the ad platform. A subset of clicks, which also counts likes, comments, and other interactions with the ad.

- **placements** `AdGroupPlacement[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **platform** `string` _requerido_ — Publisher platform where the ad is eligible to appear. · valores: `facebook`, `instagram`, `messenger`, `audience_network`, `threads`, `whatsapp`
    - **positions** `string[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - Positions targeted within the platform, such as `feed` or `story`. Empty targets all of the platform's positions.

- **purchases** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed purchases, last-click.
- **reach** `number` _requerido_ — The number of unique people who saw this.
- **regions** `AdGroupRegions` _requerido_ — Locations targeted and excluded.
  - **exclude** `AdGroupGeoLocations` _requerido_ — Locations excluded from targeting. Country groups can't be excluded.
    - **cities** `AdGroupCity[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - **key** `string` _requerido_ — The ad platform's key for the city in its location taxonomy.
        - **name** `string` — City name, such as `Austin`. Absent when the platform doesn't return one.
    - **countries** `string[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - Countries, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes such as `US`.
    - **country_groups** `string[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - Multi-country groups such as `worldwide` or `europe`.
    - **custom_locations** `AdGroupCustomLocation[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - **distance_unit** `string` _requerido_ — Unit for `radius`. · valores: `mile`, `kilometer`
        - **latitude** `number` _requerido_ — Latitude of the center point.
        - **longitude** `number` _requerido_ — Longitude of the center point.
        - **name** `string` — Label for the location, such as a city or address. Absent when the location has no label.
        - **radius** `number` _requerido_ — Radius around the center point, in `distance_unit`.
    - **regions** `string[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - US states and DC, as ISO 3166-2 codes such as `US-CA`. US territories (`PR`, `GU`, `VI`, `AS`, `MP`) and everywhere outside the US are targeted through `countries`.
    - **zips** `string[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - ZIP and postal codes, keyed by the ad platform's location taxonomy. Meta keys these `COUNTRY:CODE`, as `US:78756`.
  - **include** `AdGroupGeoLocations` _requerido_ — Locations the ad group targets.
    - **cities** `AdGroupCity[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - **key** `string` _requerido_ — The ad platform's key for the city in its location taxonomy.

        - **name** `string` — Label for the location, such as a city or address. Absent when the location has no label.
        - **radius** `number` _requerido_ — Radius around the center point, in `distance_unit`.

      - `array` de:

    - **zips** `string[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - ZIP and postal codes, keyed by the ad platform's location taxonomy. Meta keys these `COUNTRY:CODE`, as `US:78756`.
- **result_event** `string | null` _requerido_ — The Whop pixel conversion event whose attributed count represents results — the optimization goal, or the highest-volume attributed event for campaigns that budget per ad group. Null when the goal isn't a Whop-attributed event. · valores: `purchase`, `lead`, `schedule`, `submit_application`, `contact`, `complete_registration`, `view_content`, `add_to_cart`, `custom`, `messaging_conversation`, `None`
- **result_event_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The merchant-defined event name when result_event is custom; null for the standard events.
- **results** `number | null` _requerido_ — The Whop pixel-attributed count behind result_event. When a campaign's ad groups optimize different goals there is no single result_event (it is null), and this is instead the sum of each ad group's own attributed results. Null when nothing Whop-attributable is being optimized for.
- **return_on_ad_spend** `number` _requerido_ — Purchase value divided by spend, both in USD (a currency-neutral ratio); 0 when there is no spend.
- **schedule_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to schedule events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
- **schedules** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed schedule events, last-click.
- **spend** `number` _requerido_ — The amount charged, in spend_currency.
- **spend_currency** `string | null` _requerido_ — The ISO 4217 currency code of all monetary metrics.
- **starts_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the ad group starts delivering, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` when it starts as soon as it's active.
- **status** `string` _requerido_ — Whether the ad group is enabled. `active` and `paused` are set by you; `rejected` means it failed ad review; `duplicating` is a copy still being filled in. · valores: `active`, `paused`, `rejected`, `duplicating`
- **submitted_application_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to submit-application events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
- **submitted_applications** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed submit-application events, last-click.
- **title** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display name of the ad group.
- **unique_click_through_rate** `number | null` _requerido_ — Unique clicks divided by impressions, between 0 and 1.
- **unique_clicks** `number` _requerido_ — People who clicked, reported by the Whop pixel, counted once per person.
- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the ad group was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **viewed_content_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to view-content events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
- **viewed_contents** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed view-content events, last-click.

**`409`** — Conflict

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

## `POST /ad_groups/{id}/unpause`

**Unpause an Ad Group**

Resumes delivery of a paused ad group.

`operationId`: `unpauseAdGroup` · tags: `Ad Groups` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The ad group ID.
- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

**`200`** — ad group unpaused

- **added_to_carts** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed add-to-cart events, last-click.

      - IDs of saved audiences excluded from delivery, prefixed `adaud_`.

      - `array` de:

- **result_event** `string | null` _requerido_ — The Whop pixel conversion event whose attributed count represents results — the optimization goal, or the highest-volume attributed event for campaigns that budget per ad group. Null when the goal isn't a Whop-attributed event. · valores: `purchase`, `lead`, `schedule`, `submit_application`, `contact`, `complete_registration`, `view_content`, `add_to_cart`, `custom`, `messaging_conversation`, `None`
- **result_event_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The merchant-defined event name when result_event is custom; null for the standard events.

When a campaign's ad groups optimize different goals there is no single result_event (it is null), and this is instead the sum of each ad group's own attributed results. Null when nothing Whop-attributable is being optimized for.

- **schedules** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed schedule events, last-click.
- **spend** `number` _requerido_ — The amount charged, in spend_currency.
- **spend_currency** `string | null` _requerido_ — The ISO 4217 currency code of all monetary metrics.
- **starts_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the ad group starts delivering, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` when it starts as soon as it's active.

- **unique_click_through_rate** `number | null` _requerido_ — Unique clicks divided by impressions, between 0 and 1.
- **unique_clicks** `number` _requerido_ — People who clicked, reported by the Whop pixel, counted once per person.
- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the ad group was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **viewed_content_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to view-content events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.

## `GET /ads`

**List Ads**

Lists the ads for an account, with stats over the requested window.

`operationId`: `listAds` · tags: `Ads` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **account_id** (`query`) `string` — The account the ads belong to. Defaults to the account-scoped key's own account.
- **ad_campaign_id** (`query`) `string` — Only return ads in this ad campaign.
- **ad_campaign_ids** (`query`) `string[]` — Only return ads in these ad campaigns (max 100). Repeat the parameter for each id (ad_campaign_ids=a&ad_campaign_ids=b).
- **ad_group_id** (`query`) `string` — Only return ads in this ad group.
- **ad_group_ids** (`query`) `string[]` — Only return ads in these ad groups (max 100). Repeat the parameter for each id (ad_group_ids=a&ad_group_ids=b).
- **status** (`query`) `string` — Only return ads with this status. · valores: `active`, `paused`, `in_review`, `rejected`
- **query** (`query`) `string` — Filter ads by a title or ID substring.
- **order** (`query`) `string` — The field to sort by. Defaults to created_at. Stat columns (spend, impressions, …) rank over the stats_from/stats_to window across the whole list, not just the current page. results, cost_per_result and return_on_ad_spend rank by the same Whop pixel-attributed values the response reports. · valores: `created_at`, `updated_at`, `spend`, `impressions`, `reach`, `clicks`, `link_clicks`, `unique_clicks`, `frequency`, `click_through_rate`, `results`, `cost_per_mille`, `cost_per_click`, `cost_per_result`, `return_on_ad_spend`
- **direction** (`query`) `string` — The sort direction. Defaults to desc. · valores: `asc`, `desc`
- **created_before** (`query`) `string` — Only return ads created before this timestamp.
- **created_after** (`query`) `string` — Only return ads created after this timestamp.
- **stats_from** (`query`) `string` — Start of the stats window. Defaults to all-time.
- **stats_to** (`query`) `string` — End of the stats window. Defaults to now.
- **time_zone** (`query`) `string` — IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York) the stats window is interpreted in. Bare stats_from/stats_to dates resolve to day boundaries on this clock. Defaults to UTC.
- **attribution_model** (`query`) `string` — Attribution model the conversion stats count under (defaults to last_touch). Under both models a journey with any whop ad touch attributes to whop; the model picks which whop touch credits the entity and which non-whop source wins otherwise. · valores: `last_touch`, `first_touch`
- **first** (`query`) `integer` — The number of ads to return. · default: `20`
- **after** (`query`) `string` — Cursor to fetch the page after (from page_info.end_cursor).
- **last** (`query`) `integer` — The number of ads to return from the end of the range.
- **before** (`query`) `string` — Cursor to fetch the page before (from page_info.start_cursor).

## `PATCH /ads/{id}`

**Update an Ad**

Updates an ad's editable fields.

`operationId`: `updateAd` · tags: `Ads` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The ad ID.

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **call_to_action** `string` — The call-to-action button shown on the ad. · valores: `apply_now`, `book_now`, `call_now`, `contact_us`, `download`, `get_directions`, `get_offer`, `get_quote`, `learn_more`, `listen_now`, `message_page`, `no_button`, `open_link`, `order_now`, `request_time`, `see_details`, `see_menu`, `send_updates`, `shop_now`, `sign_up`, `subscribe`, `watch_more`
- **creatives** `object[]` — The ad's creative assets. Each entry is an uploaded file id with an optional format; omit format for the original asset. Replaces a live ad's creative on the platform. Two or more entries with no format replace it with a carousel (2-10 attachments), in order, sharing the ad's copy.
  - `array` de:
    - **crop** `object` — The saved crop window for this creative, in source image pixels. Omit it for the original asset or for a format that has not been cropped.
      - **height** `number`
      - **width** `number`
      - **x** `number`
      - **y** `number`
    - **format** `string` · valores: `square`, `vertical`, `horizontal`
    - **id** `string` — Uploaded file ID, prefixed `file_`.
- **descriptions** `string[]` — The description variants shown on the ad.
  - `array` de:
- **existing_post_id** `string` — Promote a post you already published instead of uploading creatives — a Facebook post or Instagram media id. Mutually exclusive with creatives. Pair with post_source.
- **headlines** `string[]` — The headline variants shown on the ad.
  - `array` de:
- **lead_form** `object` — Instant lead form for the ad. Only allowed when the ad group's conversion_location is an instant-form destination (instant_forms, instant_forms_and_messenger, website_and_instant_forms). Mutually exclusive with lead_form_id.
  - **completion** `object` — Optional completion screen shown after submission; url sets the follow-up website button.
    - **button_text** `string`
    - **description** `string`
    - **headline** `string`
    - **url** `string`
  - **disclaimer** `object` — Optional custom consent disclaimer with checkboxes.
    - **body** `string`
    - **checkboxes** `object[]`
      - `array` de:
        - **checked_by_default** `boolean`
        - **key** `string`
        - **required** `boolean`
        - **text** `string`
    - **title** `string`
  - **form_type** `string` — more_volume (default) is quickest to submit; higher_intent adds a confirmation step. · valores: `more_volume`, `higher_intent`
  - **intro** `object` — Optional intro screen shown before the questions.
    - **description** `string`
    - **headline** `string`
  - **name** `string` — Internal name for the form. Auto-generated if omitted.
  - **phone_verification** `boolean` — Require SMS verification of the phone number (higher_intent forms).
  - **privacy_policy** `object` — Your privacy policy. url is required by the ad platform.
    - **link_text** `string`
    - **url** `string`
  - **questions** `object[]` — The questions on the form. Standard prefill types need only a type; a custom question needs a label and a format (plus options for multiple_choice). Options carry an optional key and answer-routing logic.
    - `array` de:
      - **format** `string` · valores: `short_answer`, `multiple_choice`, `appointment`
      - **label** `string`
      - **options** `object[]`
        - `array` de:
          - **key** `string`
          - **logic** `object`
            - **action** `string` · valores: `go_to_question`, `submit_form`, `close_form`
            - **target_end_page_index** `integer`
            - **target_question_index** `integer`
          - **value** `string`
      - **type** `string` · valores: `email`, `phone`, `full_name`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `city`, `state`, `zip`, `country`, `street_address`, `job_title`, `company_name`, `work_email`, `work_phone_number`, `dob`, `gender`, `marital_status`, `relationship_status`, `military_status`, `date_time`, `custom`
- **lead_form_id** `string` — Use an existing instant form instead of creating one — the form's platform ID, from a form already on the ad's Facebook page. Only allowed when the ad group's conversion_location is an instant-form destination. Mutually exclusive with lead_form. Replaces a stored lead_form.
- **messaging_config** `object` — Click-to-message welcome copy: the greeting (message) and the ice-breaker prompt (keyword).
  - **keyword** `string`
  - **message** `string`
- **multi_advertiser_ads** `boolean` — Whether the ad can appear alongside other advertisers' ads in the same unit. Defaults to true.
- **post_source** `string` — Identifies the network that owns `existing_post_id`. The source is inferred from the ID shape when omitted. · valores: `facebook`, `instagram`
- **primary_texts** `string[]` — The primary text variants shown in the ad body.
  - `array` de:
- **social_accounts** `object[]` — The social accounts the ad runs under — a connected Facebook page and, optionally, an Instagram profile.
  - `array` de:
    - **id** `string` — Social account ID, prefixed `sacc_`.
- **title** `string` — The display name of the ad.
- **url** `string` — The URL the ad links to. Query parameters are merged into url_parameters, so the stored URL is always bare.
- **url_parameters** `object` — Query parameters to append to the destination URL, keyed by parameter name. Merged with any query string on `url`. Whop adds its own click-attribution parameters; those are reserved and rejected if you set them. Which keys are reserved depends on the ad's network — Meta: utm_meta_ad_id, utm_meta_adset_id, utm_meta_campaign_id, utm_source, utm_placement, utm_medium, utm_content, utm_adset, utm_whop, wacid, wasid, waid, tw_source, tw_adid; TikTok: waid, wasid, wacid, ad_id, adset_id, campaign_id, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_placement, utm_whop, tw_source, tw_adid.

- **cost_per_result** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by Whop pixel-attributed results; null when nothing Whop-attributable is being optimized for.
- **cost_per_schedule** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed schedule events; null when schedules are not the goal and none are attributed.
- **cost_per_submitted_application** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed submit-application events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.
- **cost_per_unique_click** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by unique clicks; null when there are no unique clicks.
- **cost_per_viewed_content** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed view-content events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.

Use it to open the live post, or to promote the same post from another ad. `null` until the network has created the post.

- **purchases** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed purchases, last-click.
- **reach** `number` _requerido_ — The number of unique people who saw this.
- **result_event** `string | null` _requerido_ — The Whop pixel conversion event whose attributed count represents results — the optimization goal, or the highest-volume attributed event for campaigns that budget per ad group. Null when the goal isn't a Whop-attributed event. · valores: `purchase`, `lead`, `schedule`, `submit_application`, `contact`, `complete_registration`, `view_content`, `add_to_cart`, `custom`, `messaging_conversation`, `None`
- **result_event_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The merchant-defined event name when result_event is custom; null for the standard events.
- **results** `number | null` _requerido_ — The Whop pixel-attributed count behind result_event. When a campaign's ad groups optimize different goals there is no single result_event (it is null), and this is instead the sum of each ad group's own attributed results. Null when nothing Whop-attributable is being optimized for.
- **return_on_ad_spend** `number` _requerido_ — Purchase value divided by spend, both in USD (a currency-neutral ratio); 0 when there is no spend.
- **schedule_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to schedule events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
- **schedules** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed schedule events, last-click.
- **social_accounts** `AdEntityReference[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The referenced entity's id.
- **spend** `number` _requerido_ — The amount charged, in spend_currency.
- **spend_currency** `string | null` _requerido_ — The ISO 4217 currency code of all monetary metrics.
- **status** `string` _requerido_ — Whether the ad is enabled. `active` and `paused` are set by you; `in_review` and `rejected` come from ad review. · valores: `active`, `paused`, `in_review`, `rejected`
- **submitted_application_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to submit-application events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
- **submitted_applications** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed submit-application events, last-click.
- **title** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display title of the ad.
- **unique_click_through_rate** `number | null` _requerido_ — Unique clicks divided by impressions, between 0 and 1.
- **unique_clicks** `number` _requerido_ — People who clicked, reported by the Whop pixel, counted once per person.
- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the ad was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — The URL the ad links to, without its query string. Parameters belong in `url_parameters`; any you send on `url` are moved there.
- **url_parameters** `object` _requerido_ — Every query parameter appended to the URL, keyed by parameter name — including any you sent on `url` itself. Whop adds its own click-attribution parameters on top; those are reserved and rejected if you set them. Which keys are reserved depends on the ad's network — Meta: utm_meta_ad_id, utm_meta_adset_id, utm_meta_campaign_id, utm_source, utm_placement, utm_medium, utm_content, utm_adset, utm_whop, wacid, wasid, waid, tw_source, tw_adid; TikTok: waid, wasid, wacid, ad_id, adset_id, campaign_id, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_placement, utm_whop, tw_source, tw_adid.
- **viewed_content_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to view-content events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
- **viewed_contents** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed view-content events, last-click.

## `POST /ads/{id}/duplicate`

**Duplicate an Ad**

Copies the ad into its own ad group, or into target_ad_group_id (which must belong to the same account and be compatible with the ad). Copies keep the source ad's active/paused state.

`operationId`: `duplicateAd` · tags: `Ads` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The ad ID.
- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

### Request body — `application/json`

- **count** `integer` — Number of copies to create (1-10). Defaults to 1.
- **preserve_engagement** `boolean` — Whether the copies keep the original post's engagement (likes, comments, shares). Defaults to false.
- **target_ad_group_id** `string` — Ad group to duplicate into. Defaults to the ad's own ad group.

**`201`** — ad duplicated

- **cost_per_purchase** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed purchases; null when purchases are not a goal and none are attributed.
- **cost_per_result** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by Whop pixel-attributed results; null when nothing Whop-attributable is being optimized for.
- **cost_per_schedule** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed schedule events; null when schedules are not the goal and none are attributed.
- **cost_per_submitted_application** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed submit-application events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.
- **cost_per_unique_click** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by unique clicks; null when there are no unique clicks.
- **cost_per_viewed_content** `number | null` _requerido_ — Spend divided by attributed view-content events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the ad was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **creatives** `AdCreative[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **crop** `AdCreativeCrop | null` _requerido_ — The saved crop window for this creative, in source image pixels. Null for the original asset or a format that has not been cropped.
      - _uno de:_
        - **AdCreativeCrop**
          - **height** `number` _requerido_ — Height of the crop window in source pixels.
          - **width** `number` _requerido_ — Width of the crop window in source pixels.
          - **x** `number` _requerido_ — Left edge of the crop window in source pixels.
          - **y** `number` _requerido_ — Top edge of the crop window in source pixels.
        - **null**
    - **format** `string | null` _requerido_ — The placement variant this asset covers, or null for the original asset. · valores: `square`, `vertical`, `horizontal`, `None`
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The creative attachment's file id.
    - **media_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — The kind of asset, image or video.
    - **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — CDN url of the asset.
- **custom_conversions** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed custom (merchant-defined) conversion events, last-click, across all custom event names.
- **custom_event_counts** `object` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed custom conversions, keyed by your event name with its last-click count as the value. Empty when no named custom events are attributed. Custom events fired without a name are counted in custom_conversions but omitted here, so these values sum to at most custom_conversions.
- **custom_event_values** `object` _requerido_ — Conversion value attributed to each custom event, keyed by event name like custom_event_counts. Sums the value passed to whop.track, normalized to USD; events fired without a value contribute 0.
- **delivery_status** `string` _requerido_ — Whether the ad is delivering right now, and if not, why. When several states apply at once, the highest-precedence one is returned. · valores: `rejected`, `in_review`, `draft`, `campaign_paused`, `ad_group_paused`, `paused`, `processing`, `issues`, `scheduled`, `learning_limited`, `learning`, `active`
- **descriptions** `string[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - The description variants shown on the ad.
- **existing_post_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — The post you pointed this ad at, when it promotes one you already published — a Facebook post, Instagram media, or TikTok video ID. `null` when the ad uses uploaded creatives.
- **frequency** `number | null` _requerido_ — Platform-reported impressions divided by reach.
- **headlines** `string[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - The headline variants shown on the ad.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — Unique identifier for the ad, prefixed `ad_`.
- **impressions** `number` _requerido_ — The number of impressions.
- **issues** `AdPlatformIssue[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Unique identifier for the issue.
    - **message** `string` _requerido_ — A description of what the issue is and how it can be resolved.
    - **resource_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — The ID of the campaign, ad group, or ad the issue is attached to.
    - **resource_type** `string` _requerido_ — The type of resource the issue is attached to. · valores: `ad_campaign`, `ad_group`, `ad`
- **lead_form** `AdLeadForm | null` — The instant lead form shown when someone taps this ad. `null` when the ad group's conversion_location is not an instant-form destination.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AdLeadForm**
      - **completion** `AdLeadFormCompletion | null` _requerido_ — Screen shown after the form is submitted. `null` when the form uses the default.
        - _uno de:_
          - **AdLeadFormCompletion**
            - **button_text** `string | null` _requerido_ — Text of the follow-up button.
            - **description** `string | null` _requerido_ — Body text under the headline.
            - **headline** `string | null` _requerido_ — Headline of the completion screen.
            - **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Website the follow-up button opens. `null` when the screen has no button.
          - **null**
      - **disclaimer** `AdLeadFormDisclaimer | null` _requerido_ — Custom consent disclaimer shown before submission. `null` when the form has none.
        - _uno de:_
          - **AdLeadFormDisclaimer**
            - **body** `string | null` _requerido_ — Disclaimer text.
            - **checkboxes** `AdLeadFormDisclaimerCheckbox[]` _requerido_
              - `array` de:
                - **checked_by_default** `boolean | null` _requerido_ — Whether the checkbox starts ticked.
                - **key** `string | null` _requerido_ — Stable identifier consent responses are stored under.
                - **required** `boolean | null` _requerido_ — Whether the checkbox must be ticked to submit the form.
                - **text** `string` _requerido_ — Consent text next to the checkbox.
            - **title** `string | null` _requerido_ — Disclaimer title.
          - **null**
      - **form_type** `string` _requerido_ — `more_volume` is quickest to submit; `higher_intent` adds a confirmation step before submission. · valores: `more_volume`, `higher_intent`
      - **intro** `AdLeadFormIntro | null` _requerido_ — Intro screen shown before the questions. `null` when the form has none.
        - _uno de:_
          - **AdLeadFormIntro**
            - **description** `string | null` _requerido_ — Body text under the headline.
            - **headline** `string | null` _requerido_ — Headline of the intro screen.
          - **null**
      - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Internal name of the form.
      - **phone_verification** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the phone number must be verified by SMS before submitting.
      - **privacy_policy** `AdLeadFormPrivacyPolicy | null` _requerido_ — Your privacy policy, linked from the form. `null` when unset.
        - _uno de:_
          - **AdLeadFormPrivacyPolicy**
            - **link_text** `string | null` _requerido_ — Link text shown for the policy. `null` uses the platform default.
            - **url** `string` _requerido_ — URL of your privacy policy.
          - **null**
      - **questions** `AdLeadFormQuestion[]` _requerido_
        - `array` de:
          - **format** `string` — Answer format for `custom` questions: `short_answer`, `multiple_choice`, or `appointment`. Absent otherwise.
          - **label** `string` — Question text for `custom` questions. Absent for standard prefill questions.
          - **options** `AdLeadFormQuestionOption[]`
            - `array` de:
              - **key** `string | null` — Stable identifier the choice's answers are stored under. Absent for simple choices.
              - **logic** `AdLeadFormOptionLogic` — Where the form goes when this choice is selected. Absent when the form just continues to the next question.
                - **action** `string` _requerido_ — What happens when the choice is selected. · valores: `go_to_question`, `submit_form`, `close_form`
                - **target_end_page_index** `number` — Zero-based index of the ending screen to jump to.
                - **target_question_index** `number` — Zero-based index of the question to jump to, for `go_to_question`.
              - **value** `string` _requerido_ — Choice text shown to the person.
          - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Question type: a standard prefill type such as `email`, `phone`, or `full_name`, or `custom` for your own question.
    - **null**
- **lead_form_id** `string | null` — The ad platform's ID for the instant form the ad uses. Set when the ad references an existing form via `lead_form_id`, or once a form built from `lead_form` has been created on the platform.
- **lead_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to lead events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
- **leads** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed leads, last-click.
- **link_clicks** `number` _requerido_ — Clicks on links in the ad that lead to your destination, as reported by the ad platform. A subset of clicks, which also counts likes, comments, and other interactions with the ad.
- **messaging_config** `AdMessagingConfig | null` — Welcome message for click-to-message ads, shown when the conversation opens. `null` when the ad has none.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AdMessagingConfig**
      - **keyword** `string | null` _requerido_ — Suggested reply the person can tap to start the conversation.
      - **message** `string | null` _requerido_ — Greeting shown when the conversation opens.
    - **null**
- **multi_advertiser_ads** `boolean` — Whether the ad can appear alongside other advertisers' ads in the same unit. Defaults to true.
- **post_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — The post the ad network serves for this ad, as `pageID_postID` on Meta — the post Meta created for an uploaded creative, or the post being promoted. Use it to open the live post, or to promote the same post from another ad. `null` until the network has created the post.
- **post_source** `string | null` _requerido_ — Identifies the network that owns `existing_post_id`; `null` when the ad uses uploaded creatives. · valores: `facebook`, `instagram`, `None`
- **post_thumbnail_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Preview image of the post named by `existing_post_id`. `null` for ads that use uploaded creatives, or until the post's media has been fetched from the network.
- **primary_texts** `string[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - The primary text variants shown in the ad body.
- **purchase_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value of pixel-attributed purchases.
- **purchases** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed purchases, last-click.
- **reach** `number` _requerido_ — The number of unique people who saw this.
- **result_event** `string | null` _requerido_ — The Whop pixel conversion event whose attributed count represents results — the optimization goal, or the highest-volume attributed event for campaigns that budget per ad group. Null when the goal isn't a Whop-attributed event. · valores: `purchase`, `lead`, `schedule`, `submit_application`, `contact`, `complete_registration`, `view_content`, `add_to_cart`, `custom`, `messaging_conversation`, `None`
- **result_event_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The merchant-defined event name when result_event is custom; null for the standard events.
- **results** `number | null` _requerido_ — The Whop pixel-attributed count behind result_event. When a campaign's ad groups optimize different goals there is no single result_event (it is null), and this is instead the sum of each ad group's own attributed results. Null when nothing Whop-attributable is being optimized for.
- **return_on_ad_spend** `number` _requerido_ — Purchase value divided by spend, both in USD (a currency-neutral ratio); 0 when there is no spend.
- **schedule_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to schedule events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
- **schedules** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed schedule events, last-click.
- **social_accounts** `AdEntityReference[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The referenced entity's id.
- **spend** `number` _requerido_ — The amount charged, in spend_currency.
- **spend_currency** `string | null` _requerido_ — The ISO 4217 currency code of all monetary metrics.
- **status** `string` _requerido_ — Whether the ad is enabled. `active` and `paused` are set by you; `in_review` and `rejected` come from ad review. · valores: `active`, `paused`, `in_review`, `rejected`
- **submitted_application_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to submit-application events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
- **submitted_applications** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed submit-application events, last-click.
- **title** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display title of the ad.
- **unique_click_through_rate** `number | null` _requerido_ — Unique clicks divided by impressions, between 0 and 1.
- **unique_clicks** `number` _requerido_ — People who clicked, reported by the Whop pixel, counted once per person.
- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the ad was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — The URL the ad links to, without its query string. Parameters belong in `url_parameters`; any you send on `url` are moved there.
- **url_parameters** `object` _requerido_ — Every query parameter appended to the URL, keyed by parameter name — including any you sent on `url` itself. Whop adds its own click-attribution parameters on top; those are reserved and rejected if you set them. Which keys are reserved depends on the ad's network — Meta: utm_meta_ad_id, utm_meta_adset_id, utm_meta_campaign_id, utm_source, utm_placement, utm_medium, utm_content, utm_adset, utm_whop, wacid, wasid, waid, tw_source, tw_adid; TikTok: waid, wasid, wacid, ad_id, adset_id, campaign_id, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_placement, utm_whop, tw_source, tw_adid.
- **viewed_content_value** `number` _requerido_ — USD value attributed to view-content events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
- **viewed_contents** `number` _requerido_ — Whop pixel-attributed view-content events, last-click.

**`409`** — Conflict

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

## `GET /api_keys`

**List API Keys**

Lists the API keys of an account or app, newest first. Responses never include the full secret — only its obfuscated form.

`operationId`: `listApiKeys` · tags: `API Keys` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **resource_id** (`query`) `string` _requerido_ — The account (`biz_`) or app (`app_`) tag to list API keys for.
- **resource_type** (`query`) `string` _requerido_ — The type of resource that owns the API keys. · valores: `account`, `app`
- **created_before** (`query`) `integer | string` — Only return API keys created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **created_after** (`query`) `integer | string` — Only return API keys created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **first** (`query`) `integer` — The number of API keys to return (default 20, max 100).
- **after** (`query`) `string` — A cursor; returns API keys after this position.
- **last** (`query`) `integer` — The number of API keys to return from the end of the range.
- **before** (`query`) `string` — A cursor; returns API keys before this position.
- **order** (`query`) `string` — The field to sort API keys by. · valores: `created_at` · default: `created_at`
- **direction** (`query`) `string` — Sort direction. · valores: `asc`, `desc` · default: `desc`

### Respuestas

**`200`** — api keys listed

- **data** `ApiKey[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **api_version_date** `string` _requerido_ — Dated API version used when requests authenticated with this key omit the `Api-Version-Date` header. · valores: `2025-01-01`, `2026-06-08`, `2026-06-09`, `2026-06-20`, `2026-07-01`, `2026-07-08`, `2026-07-08-1`, `2026-07-18`, `2026-07-20`, `2026-07-22`, `2026-07-23`, `2026-07-25`, `2026-07-26`, `2026-07-27`, `2026-07-29`, `2026-07-29-1`, `2026-07-31`, `2026-08-03`, `2026-08-05`, `2026-08-05-1`, `2026-08-10`, `2026-08-12`, `2026-08-13`, `2026-08-14` …
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the API key was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **expires_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the API key stops working, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` means it never expires.
    - **grants** `ApiKeyGrant[]`
      - `array` de:
        - **actions** `ApiKeyGrantAction[]` _requerido_
          - `array` de:
            - **action** `string` _requerido_ — The permission action's identifier, for example `company:basic:read`.
            - **granted** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the key holds the action on the grant's resource.
        - **resource_id** `string` _requerido_ — ID of the resource the actions apply to.
        - **resource_type** `string` _requerido_ — The type of resource the actions apply to, such as `account`, `product`, or `app`.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — API key ID, prefixed `apik_`.
    - **ip_allowlist** `array | null` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - IPv4/IPv6 CIDR ranges allowed to use this key. `null` or empty means requests are accepted from any IP.
    - **is_default_for_resource** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether this is the resource's default API key. Default keys cannot be updated or deleted, only rotated.
    - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Human-readable name identifying the API key, or `null` when none was set.
    - **obfuscated_secret_key** `string` _requerido_ — Masked version of the secret key, so the key can be recognized without revealing the full secret.
    - **secret_key** `string` — The full secret used to authenticate requests. Returned only once, on create and rotate responses — store it immediately.
    - **system_role** `string | null` _requerido_ — System role the key inherits its permissions from, or `null` when it uses an explicit permissions policy. Only account API keys can use a system role. · valores: `owner`, `admin`, `moderator`, `sales_manager`, `advertiser`, `None`
    - **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the API key was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **page_info** `object` _requerido_
  - **end_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_
  - **has_next_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **has_previous_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **start_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_

**`400`** — Invalid Parameters

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`403`** — Forbidden

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`404`** — Resource not found

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

## `POST /api_keys`

**Create API Key**

Creates an API key for an account or app. The response is the only place the full `secret_key` is returned — store it immediately. Requires a user session; API keys cannot manage API keys.

`operationId`: `createApiKey` · tags: `API Keys` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **api_version_date** `string` — Dated API version used when requests authenticated with this key omit the `Api-Version-Date` header. New keys default to the latest version. · valores: `2025-01-01`, `2026-06-08`, `2026-06-09`, `2026-06-20`, `2026-07-01`, `2026-07-08`, `2026-07-08-1`, `2026-07-18`, `2026-07-20`, `2026-07-22`, `2026-07-23`, `2026-07-25`, `2026-07-26`, `2026-07-27`, `2026-07-29`, `2026-07-29-1`, `2026-07-31`, `2026-08-03`, `2026-08-05`, `2026-08-05-1`, `2026-08-10`, `2026-08-12`, `2026-08-13`, `2026-08-14` …
- **expires_at** `string | null` — When the API key should stop working, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Omit (or pass `null` on update) for a key that never expires.
- **ip_allowlist** `array | null` — IPv4/IPv6 CIDR ranges allowed to use this key, for example `["203.0.113.0/24"]`. Empty or `null` allows any IP.
  - `array` de:
- **name** `string` _requerido_ — A human-readable name for the API key, such as 'Production API Key'.
- **permissions** `object` _requerido_ — The permissions policy for the API key: explicit permission statements, or a system role to inherit from. Statements without a `resources` array default to the owning account (Account API keys) or every key-addressable resource (App API keys).
  - **statements** `object[]` — Explicit permission statements. Required unless `system_role` is set.
    - `array` de:
      - **actions** `string[]` _requerido_ — Permission actions covered by this statement, for example `company:basic:read`.
        - `array` de:
      - **grant** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the actions are granted (`true`) or denied (`false`).
      - **resources** `string[]` — Resource identifiers the statement applies to, for example `biz_xxx` or `biz_xxx|pass_*`. Defaults to the key's owning resource when omitted.
        - `array` de:
  - **system_role** `string | null` — A system role to inherit permissions from. Only Account API keys can use a system role. · valores: `owner`, `admin`, `moderator`, `sales_manager`, `advertiser`, `None`
- **resource_id** `string` _requerido_ — The account (`biz_`) or app (`app_`) tag to create the API key for.
- **resource_type** `string` _requerido_ — The type of resource that will own this API key. · valores: `account`, `app`

### Respuestas

**`200`** — api key created

- **api_version_date** `string` _requerido_ — Dated API version used when requests authenticated with this key omit the `Api-Version-Date` header. · valores: `2025-01-01`, `2026-06-08`, `2026-06-09`, `2026-06-20`, `2026-07-01`, `2026-07-08`, `2026-07-08-1`, `2026-07-18`, `2026-07-20`, `2026-07-22`, `2026-07-23`, `2026-07-25`, `2026-07-26`, `2026-07-27`, `2026-07-29`, `2026-07-29-1`, `2026-07-31`, `2026-08-03`, `2026-08-05`, `2026-08-05-1`, `2026-08-10`, `2026-08-12`, `2026-08-13`, `2026-08-14` …
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the API key was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **expires_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the API key stops working, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` means it never expires.
- **grants** `ApiKeyGrant[]`
  - `array` de:
    - **actions** `ApiKeyGrantAction[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - **action** `string` _requerido_ — The permission action's identifier, for example `company:basic:read`.
        - **granted** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the key holds the action on the grant's resource.
    - **resource_id** `string` _requerido_ — ID of the resource the actions apply to.
    - **resource_type** `string` _requerido_ — The type of resource the actions apply to, such as `account`, `product`, or `app`.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — API key ID, prefixed `apik_`.
- **ip_allowlist** `array | null` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - IPv4/IPv6 CIDR ranges allowed to use this key. `null` or empty means requests are accepted from any IP.
- **is_default_for_resource** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether this is the resource's default API key. Default keys cannot be updated or deleted, only rotated.
- **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Human-readable name identifying the API key, or `null` when none was set.
- **obfuscated_secret_key** `string` _requerido_ — Masked version of the secret key, so the key can be recognized without revealing the full secret.
- **secret_key** `string` — The full secret used to authenticate requests. Returned only once, on create and rotate responses — store it immediately.
- **system_role** `string | null` _requerido_ — System role the key inherits its permissions from, or `null` when it uses an explicit permissions policy. Only account API keys can use a system role. · valores: `owner`, `admin`, `moderator`, `sales_manager`, `advertiser`, `None`
- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the API key was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

## `GET /api_logs`

**List Api Logs**

Lists the requests served by Whop's API with the account's API keys, newest first — every surface (GraphQL, REST, and native /api/v1), reads and failed requests included.

`operationId`: `listApiLogs` · tags: `Api Logs` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **account_id** (`query`) `string` — The account (biz_*) whose API logs to list. Defaults to the authenticated account.
- **created_after** (`query`) `string` — Only return requests served at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to 7 days before created_before, or 7 days ago.
- **created_before** (`query`) `string` — Only return requests served before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **operation_name** (`query`) `string` — Only return requests for this operation, matched exactly against the operation_name shown on each log row (for example api/v1/products#create).
- **http_method** (`query`) `string` — Only return requests made with this HTTP method. · valores: `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`
- **status** (`query`) `string` — Only return requests that finished with this status. · valores: `success`, `error`
- **api_key_id** (`query`) `string` — Only return requests made with this API key (apik_…).
- **min_duration_ms** (`query`) `integer` — Only return requests that took at least this many milliseconds.
- **max_duration_ms** (`query`) `integer` — Only return requests that took at most this many milliseconds.
- **first** (`query`) `integer` — Number of logs to return. · default: `25`
- **after** (`query`) `string` — Cursor to fetch the page after (from page_info.end_cursor).

**`200`** — api logs listed

    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_

    - **http_method** `string` · valores: `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`, `None`

    - **status** `string` · valores: `success`, `error`, `None`

  - **has_previous_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **start_cursor** `string` _requerido_

## `GET /app_builds`

**List App Builds**

Returns a paginated list of build artifacts for an app, newest first, with optional platform, status, and creation-date filters.

`operationId`: `listAppBuilds` · tags: `App Builds` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **app_id** (`query`) `string` _requerido_ — The app to list builds for, prefixed `app_`.
- **platform** (`query`) `string` — Filter builds by target platform. · valores: `ios`, `android`, `web`
- **status** (`query`) `string` — Filter builds by review status. · valores: `draft`, `pending`, `approved`, `rejected`
- **created_before** (`query`) `integer | string` — Only return builds created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **created_after** (`query`) `integer | string` — Only return builds created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **first** (`query`) `integer` — The number of builds to return (default 20, max 100).
- **after** (`query`) `string` — A cursor; returns builds after this position.
- **last** (`query`) `integer` — The number of builds to return from the end of the range.

## `GET /apps`

**List Apps**

Lists apps on the Whop platform: the app store's live apps, or — with `account_id` and developer access to that account — every app the account owns. Requires authentication except for Whop's public app and website discovery lists. Public website discovery includes built official blueprints (verified apps with a product) and built, live community blueprints that Whop recommends.

`operationId`: `listApps` · tags: `Apps` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **account_id** (`query`) `string` — Only return apps created by this account (`biz_` tag). With developer access to the account this includes its unlisted and hidden apps.
- **app_type** (`query`) `string` — Filter apps by the type of end-user they are built for. Apps of type `website` are left out unless you ask for them by name. · valores: `b2b_app`, `b2c_app`, `company_app`, `component`, `website`
- **view_type** (`query`) `string` — Only return apps supporting this view type, such as `dashboard` or `hub`. · valores: `hub`, `discover`, `dash`, `dashboard`, `analytics`, `skills`, `openapi`
- **verified** (`query`) `boolean` — Only return apps whose Whop verification status matches this value. Omit this filter to include every verification status the caller can see.
- **verified_apps_only** (`query`) `boolean` — Legacy compatibility filter. Use `verified` for field equality. `true` returns verified apps; clients pinned before `2026-08-25-2` retain the earlier public website discovery behavior.
- **recommended** (`query`) `boolean` — Only return apps Whop recommends (or, with `false`, only those it does not), independently of verification status.
- **query** (`query`) `string` — A search string matched against app names.
- **order** (`query`) `string` — The field to sort apps by. Defaults to discoverable_at, showing the most recently published apps first. `template_usage` ranks Whop-verified apps first, then by how many businesses created apps from each app as a template. · valores: `created_at`, `discoverable_at`, `template_usage`, `total_installs_last_30_days`, `total_installs_last_7_days` · default: `discoverable_at`
- **direction** (`query`) `string` — Sort direction. · valores: `asc`, `desc` · default: `desc`
- **first** (`query`) `integer` — The number of apps to return (default 20, max 100).
- **after** (`query`) `string` — A cursor; returns apps after this position.
- **last** (`query`) `integer` — The number of apps to return from the end of the range.
- **before** (`query`) `string` — A cursor; returns apps before this position.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — apps listed

- **data** `AppListItem[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **account** `AccountParent` _requerido_ — The account that owns the app.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.
      - **logo_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Account logo image URL.
      - **route** `string` _requerido_ — Account public route identifier.
      - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Account display name.
    - **app_type** `string` _requerido_ — The type of end-user the app is built for. · valores: `b2b_app`, `b2c_app`, `company_app`, `component`, `website`
    - **banner_image** `AppBannerImage | null` _requerido_ — Banner image from the app's product listing, or `null` when none is uploaded.
      - _uno de:_
        - **AppBannerImage**
          - **url** `string` _requerido_ — Banner image URL, taken from the app's product listing.
        - **null**
    - **base_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — The production base URL where the app is hosted. `null` if no base URL is configured, if the caller lacks the `developer:basic:read` permission on the app's account, or on list responses, which never expose it.
    - **businesses_created_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Number of businesses created from this app as a template.
    - **businesses_created_logo_urls** `string[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - Up to three logo image URLs from businesses created from this app as a template.
    - **creator** `AppCreator` _requerido_ — The user who owns the publishing account.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — User ID, prefixed `user_`.
      - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display name.
      - **username** `string` _requerido_ — Public username.
    - **dashboard_path** `string | null` _requerido_ — URL path for the account dashboard view, or `null` when not configured.
    - **description** `string | null` _requerido_ — Short description shown in listings and search results, or `null` if none has been set.
    - **discover_path** `string | null` _requerido_ — URL path for the discover view, or `null` when not configured.
    - **domain_id** `string` _requerido_ — Subdomain identifier for the app's proxied URL, forming https://{domain_id}.apps.whop.com.
    - **experience_path** `string | null` _requerido_ — URL path for the member-facing hub view, or `null` when not configured.
    - **hosted_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Full URL where the app's hosted web build is served, or `null` if no route is claimed.
    - **icon** `AppIcon` _requerido_ — The app's icon. Falls back to the default app icon when none is uploaded.
      - **url** `string` _requerido_ — Icon image URL. Always present — the default app icon when none is uploaded.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — App ID, prefixed `app_`.
    - **name** `string` _requerido_ — Display name shown on the app store and in experience navigation.
    - **openapi_path** `string | null` _requerido_ — URL path to the app's OpenAPI spec file, or `null` when not configured.
    - **origin** `string | null` _requerido_ — Full origin URL of the app's proxied domain, for example https://ab1c2d3e4f.apps.whop.com.
    - **route** `string | null` _requerido_ — Claimed subdomain route where hosted web builds are served (`myapp` for myapp.whop.site), or `null` if no route is claimed.
    - **skills_path** `string | null` _requerido_ — URL path to the app's skills directory, or `null` when not configured.
    - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Visibility on the Whop app store: `live` is publicly discoverable, `unlisted` is accessible only via direct link, `hidden` is not visible anywhere. · valores: `live`, `unlisted`, `hidden`
    - **verified** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the app has been verified by Whop and is eligible for the featured apps section.
- **page_info** `object` _requerido_
  - **end_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_
  - **has_next_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **has_previous_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **start_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_

**`400`** — Invalid Parameters

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.

## `POST /apps`

**Create App**

Registers a new app on the Whop developer platform. Apps provide custom experiences that can be added to products.

`operationId`: `createApp` · tags: `Apps` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
