### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **account_id** `string` — The account to create the app for (`biz_` tag). Defaults to the account behind the presented credential.
- **app_type** `string` — The type of app to create. Defaults to `b2c_app`. · valores: `b2b_app`, `b2c_app`, `company_app`, `component`, `website` · default: `b2c_app`
- **base_url** `string | null` — The base production URL where the app is hosted, such as `https://myapp.example.com`.
- **icon** `object` — The icon image for the app in PNG, JPEG, or GIF format, referencing an uploaded file: `{ id }` for an existing attachment or `{ direct_upload_id }` for a new direct upload.
  - **direct_upload_id** `string` — The signed id of a completed direct upload.
  - **id** `string` — The tag of an already-uploaded attachment.
- **name** `string` _requerido_ — The display name for the app, shown to users on the app store and product pages.
- **redirect_uris** `string[]` — The whitelisted OAuth callback URLs that users are redirected to after authorizing the app.
  - `array` de:
- **route** `string | null` — The subdomain route where the app's hosted web builds are served, such as `myapp` for myapp.whop.site.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — app created

- **account** `AccountParent` _requerido_ — The account that owns the app.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.
  - **logo_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Account logo image URL.
  - **route** `string` _requerido_ — Account public route identifier.
  - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Account display name.
- **api_key** `AppApiKey | null` _requerido_ — Legacy app API key used to authenticate requests on the app's behalf. `null` when no key exists or the caller lacks the `developer:manage_api_key` permission.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AppApiKey**
      - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the key was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
      - **token** `string` _requerido_ — The key's secret token, sent as a bearer token to authenticate requests on the app's behalf.
    - **null**
- **app_store_description** `string | null` _requerido_ — Detailed description shown on the app store's in-depth app page, or `null` when none has been set.
- **app_type** `string` _requerido_ — The type of end-user the app is built for. · valores: `b2b_app`, `b2c_app`, `company_app`, `component`, `website`
- **banner_image** `AppBannerImage | null` _requerido_ — Banner image from the app's product listing, or `null` when none is uploaded.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AppBannerImage**
      - **url** `string` _requerido_ — Banner image URL, taken from the app's product listing.
    - **null**
- **base_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — The production base URL where the app is hosted. `null` if no base URL is configured, if the caller lacks the `developer:basic:read` permission on the app's account, or on list responses, which never expose it.
- **businesses_created_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Website businesses created from this app as a template.
- **businesses_created_logo_urls** `string[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - Up to three logo image URLs from businesses created from this app as a template.
- **creator** `AppCreator` _requerido_ — The user who owns the publishing account.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — User ID, prefixed `user_`.
  - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display name.
  - **username** `string` _requerido_ — Public username.
- **dashboard_path** `string | null` _requerido_ — URL path for the account dashboard view, or `null` when not configured.
- **default_api_key** `AppDefaultApiKey | null` _requerido_ — The app's default API key. `null` when the app has no default key or the caller lacks the `developer:manage_api_key` permission; `secret_key` is additionally `null` unless the caller could have created the key themselves.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AppDefaultApiKey**
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — API key ID, prefixed `apik_`.
      - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Human-readable name identifying the API key, or `null` when none was set.
      - **obfuscated_secret_key** `string` _requerido_ — Masked version of the secret key, so the key can be recognized without revealing the full secret.
      - **secret_key** `string | null` _requerido_ — The full secret used to authenticate requests. `null` unless the caller could have created the key themselves.
    - **null**
- **deployment** `AppDeployment | null` _requerido_ — What the app has left to publish, and how a publish in flight is going — `status` is only ever `unpublished`, `publishing`, or `failed` here. `null` means there is nothing to report: the app is fully published, there is no working copy to publish from, or the caller cannot deploy this app. Tell those apart from the app's own `production_web_build`.

## `DELETE /apps/{id}`

**Delete App**

Deletes an app. The app stops resolving within seconds — a website's site stops serving, and any claimed subdomain is reserved for a month before it can be claimed again.

`operationId`: `deleteApp` · tags: `Apps` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — App ID (prefixed `app_`), the app's claimed route, or its proxy domain id.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — app deleted

- **deleted** `boolean` _requerido_ — Always true.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — ID of the deleted app.

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`403`** — Forbidden

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`404`** — Resource not found

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

## `GET /apps/{id}`

**Retrieve App**

Retrieves an app by ID, claimed route, or proxy domain id. Credential fields (api_key, default_api_key, secrets) render `null` unless the caller has the corresponding developer permission on the owning account.

`operationId`: `retrieveApp` · tags: `Apps` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.

  - **logo_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Account logo image URL.
  - **route** `string` _requerido_ — Account public route identifier.
  - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Account display name.
- **api_key** `AppApiKey | null` _requerido_ — Legacy app API key used to authenticate requests on the app's behalf. `null` when no key exists or the caller lacks the `developer:manage_api_key` permission.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AppApiKey**
      - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the key was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **app_store_description** `string | null` _requerido_ — Detailed description shown on the app store's in-depth app page, or `null` when none has been set.

## `PATCH /apps/{id}`

**Update App**

Updates the settings, metadata, or status of an app. Fields that are omitted keep their current value.

`operationId`: `updateApp` · tags: `Apps` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — App ID (prefixed `app_`), the app's claimed route, or its proxy domain id.

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **app_store_description** `string` — The detailed description shown on the app store's in-depth app view page.
- **app_type** `string` — The type of end-user the app is built for. Cannot be changed on an app whose type is already `website`. · valores: `b2b_app`, `b2c_app`, `company_app`, `component`, `website`
- **base_url** `string | null` — The base production URL where the app is hosted. Set to `null` to take the app proxy offline.
- **dashboard_path** `string | null` — The URL path for the account dashboard view.
- **description** `string` — A short description of the app shown in listings and search results.
- **discover_path** `string | null` — The URL path for the discover view.
- **experience_path** `string | null` — The URL path for the member-facing hub view, such as `/experiences/[experienceId]`.

  - **direct_upload_id** `string` — The signed id of a completed direct upload.
  - **id** `string` — The tag of an already-uploaded attachment.

- **openapi_path** `string | null` — The URL path to the app's OpenAPI spec file (requires the ai_chat capability).
- **production_android_build_id** `string | null` — The app build (`abld_` tag) to serve as the Android production build, or `null` to unassign it. Same rules as `production_web_build_id`.
- **production_ios_build_id** `string | null` — The app build (`abld_` tag) to serve as the iOS production build, or `null` to unassign it. Same rules as `production_web_build_id`.
- **production_web_build_id** `string | null` — The app build (`abld_` tag) to serve as the web production build, or `null` to unassign it. The build must belong to this app, target web, and be in the draft or approved status; a draft build is queued for approval and takes over once approved. Requires the `developer:manage_builds` scope.

- **required_scopes** `string[]` — The OAuth scopes the app requests from users when they install it.

- **route** `string` — The subdomain route where the app's hosted web builds are served.
- **secrets** `object` — Secrets to add or overwrite on the app, as an object of string values. Keys not included are left untouched; pass null or an empty string as the value to delete a secret. Encrypted at rest and injected into the app's hosted server runtime.
- **skills_path** `string | null` — The URL path to the app's skills directory (requires the ai_chat capability).
- **status** `string` — Controls whether the app is published on Whop discovery or accessible only through its direct link. Publishing requires a name, icon, and description. · valores: `live`, `unlisted`, `hidden`

## `POST /apps/{id}/deploy`

**Deploy App**

Builds the app's current source and ships it. Returns the run it started, so the caller can render progress from this response and then follow it on the app's `deployment` field. Only one deployment runs per app at a time — calling this while one is in flight reports that run rather than starting a second, and calling it with nothing to publish reports that instead of starting one.

`operationId`: `deployApp` · tags: `Apps` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The app to deploy, prefixed `app_`.
- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

### Request body — `application/json`

- **draft** `boolean` — Upload the build without making it live. Defaults to `false`, which deploys and promotes in one step.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — deployment started

- **app_id** `string` _requerido_ — The app being deployed, prefixed `app_`.
- **build_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — The build the deployment produced, prefixed `abld_`, or `null` until it succeeds.
- **draft** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the running or last deployment uploaded a build without making it live.
- **error** `string | null` _requerido_ — Why the deployment failed, or `null` when it did not.
- **estimated_duration_ms** `integer | null` _requerido_ — How long this deployment is expected to take in total, estimated from previous runs.
- **estimated_remaining_ms** `integer | null` _requerido_ — How much longer the deployment is expected to take. Held above zero until it actually finishes.
- **finished_at** `integer | null` _requerido_ — When the deployment ended, in milliseconds since the epoch, or `null` while it is still running.
- **phase** `string | null` _requerido_ — The stage a running deployment has reached, or `null` when none is running. Later phases dominate the wall clock: `process_archive` waits on the upload pipeline and `promote` waits for the build to go live. · valores: `install`, `build`, `typecheck`, `upload_build`, `upload_source`, `process_archive`, `create_build`, `promote`, `None`
- **progress** `number | null` _requerido_ — Fraction of the deployment estimated to be complete, from 0 to 1. Stops just short of 1 until the run ends.
- **started_at** `integer | null` _requerido_ — When the deployment began, in milliseconds since the epoch, or `null` when none has run.
- **status** `string` _requerido_ — Whether the app has anything to publish, and what a publish in flight is doing. `unpublished` means publishing would ship something new; `no_source` means the sandbox holds no copy of this app, so there is nothing to publish from. · valores: `published`, `unpublished`, `publishing`, `failed`, `no_source`
- **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Where the deployed site is served, or `null` unless the deployment went live.

**`404`** — Resource not found

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`409`** — Conflict

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

## `GET /apps/{id}/logs`

**List App Logs**

Lists a hosted app's server runtime logs, most recent first: console output, uncaught exceptions, and failed-request summaries captured on whop.site hosting. Logs are retained for 7 days.

`operationId`: `listAppLogs` · tags: `Apps` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The ID of the app, which will look like app_*************.
- **app_build_id** (`query`) `string` — Only return logs from this build.
- **level** (`query`) `string` — Only return console lines of this level. · valores: `log`, `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`
- **query** (`query`) `string` — Only return logs whose message contains this text (case-insensitive).
- **created_after** (`query`) `string` — Start of the time window as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to 7 days before created_before.
- **created_before** (`query`) `string` — End of the time window as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to now.
- **first** (`query`) `integer` — The number of log lines to return (max 500).
- **after** (`query`) `string` — A cursor for fetching logs after a previous page.
- **before** (`query`) `string` — A cursor for fetching logs before a later page.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — logs listed

- **data** `object[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **app_build_id** `string` _requerido_
    - **app_id** `string` _requerido_
    - **cpu_time_ms** `integer`
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ · formato: `date-time`
    - **level** `string` _requerido_ · valores: `log`, `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`
    - **message** `string` _requerido_
    - **outcome** `string | null`
    - **request_id** `string` _requerido_
    - **request_method** `string | null`
    - **request_path** `string | null`
    - **response_status** `integer | null`
    - **source** `string` _requerido_ · valores: `console`, `exception`, `request`
    - **stack** `string | null`
    - **truncated** `boolean`
    - **wall_time_ms** `integer`
- **page_info** `object` _requerido_
  - **end_cursor** `string | null`
  - **has_next_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **has_previous_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **start_cursor** `string | null`

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`403`** — Forbidden

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`404`** — Resource not found

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.

## `GET /audiences`

**List Audiences**

Lists uploaded customer-list audiences for an account. Pass `audience_id` to return a specific audience.

`operationId`: `listAudiences` · tags: `Audiences` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **account_id** (`query`) `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.
- **audience_id** (`query`) `string` — Audience ID, prefixed `adaud_`, used to filter the response to one audience.
- **audience_type** (`query`) `string` — Filter by audience type: `custom` (uploaded lists) or `lookalike`. · valores: `custom`, `lookalike`
- **source_type** (`query`) `string` — Filter by member source: `csv_upload` (uploaded lists) or `people_filter` (automatic audiences built from saved People filters). · valores: `csv_upload`, `people_filter`
- **first** (`query`) `integer` — Number of audiences to return. Defaults to 20; maximum 100.
- **after** (`query`) `string` — Cursor for the next page of audiences.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — Audiences listed.

- **data** `Audience[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **audience_type** `string` _requerido_ — `custom` = a customer list (uploaded, or built from saved People filters); `lookalike` = Meta lookalike built from a custom audience. · valores: `custom`, `lookalike`
    - **auto_refresh** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether membership keeps updating. `true` rebuilds it from the saved filters twice a day, so people join and leave as they start and stop matching. `false` keeps whoever matched when it was built and never rebuilds. Always `false` for uploaded lists and lookalikes.
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the audience was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **error_message** `string | null` _requerido_ — Processing error message. `null` unless processing is partial or failed.
    - **filters** `object | null` _requerido_ — For audiences built from People filters: the filters that define membership, keyed exactly as `GET /people` accepts them — for example `{"os": "iOS", "country": "US"}`. `null` for uploaded lists and lookalikes.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Audience ID, prefixed `adaud_`.
    - **last_refreshed_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the audience membership was last rebuilt, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` until the first build completes.
    - **lookalike_ratio** `number | null` _requerido_ — For lookalikes: the upper bound of the similarity band as a fraction (0.02 = top 2%). `null` for custom audiences.
    - **lookalike_starting_ratio** `number | null` _requerido_ — For lookalikes: the lower bound of the similarity band as a fraction. `null` for custom audiences and first-tier lookalikes.
    - **match_rates** `AudienceMatchRate[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - **lower_bound** `number | null` _requerido_ — Lower bound of the estimated match rate percentage. `null` until available.
        - **platform** `string` _requerido_ — The ad platform that provided the match-rate estimate. · valores: `meta`
        - **status** `string | null` _requerido_ — Availability of the estimated match rate. · valores: `calculating`, `available`, `unavailable`, `None`
        - **upper_bound** `number | null` _requerido_ — Upper bound of the estimated match rate percentage. `null` until available.
    - **matched_rows** `number` _requerido_ — Members successfully uploaded to connected ad accounts. Always 0 for lookalikes.
    - **name** `string` _requerido_ — Audience display name.
    - **platform_audience_ids** `string[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - External audience IDs created on connected ad platforms, such as Meta.
    - **processed_rows** `number` _requerido_ — Members processed from the source so far. Always 0 for lookalikes.
    - **progress_percent** `number` _requerido_ — Processing progress from 0 to 100.
    - **source_audience_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — For lookalikes: the audience this lookalike was built from. `null` for custom audiences.
    - **source_type** `string` _requerido_ — Where members come from. `csv_upload` = an uploaded customer list; `people_filter` = built from saved People filters. See `auto_refresh` for whether a `people_filter` audience keeps updating. · valores: `csv_upload`, `people_filter`
    - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Current state of the audience import. `syncing` means Whop is sending matched rows to connected ad accounts. When status is `partial` or `failed`, `error_message` explains what went wrong. · valores: `pending`, `processing`, `syncing`, `ready`, `partial`, `failed`
    - **total_rows** `number` _requerido_ — Total members detected in the source — CSV rows for uploaded lists, matching people for automatic audiences. Always 0 for lookalikes.
    - **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the audience was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **page_info** `object` _requerido_
  - **end_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_
  - **has_next_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **has_previous_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **start_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

## `POST /audiences`

**Create Audience**

Creates an audience. Default (`audience_type` omitted or `custom`): creates one audience from an uploaded customer identity CSV file (`name`, `column_mapping`, and `file_id` required) and starts processing it; responds with the audience object. With `filters`: creates an audience from saved People filters (`name` required) — membership is built from the account's People data, and `auto_refresh` decides whether it keeps tracking the filters or keeps whoever matched at creation. With `audience_type: lookalike`: creates a ladder of Meta lookalike audiences from an existing ready custom audience (`source_audience_id`, `count`, and `percentage` required) — `count` equal similarity bands slicing the top `percentage`% (3 audiences at 6% = 0–2%, 2–4%, 4–6%), each returned as its own audience in a `{ data: [...] }` envelope.

`operationId`: `createAudience` · tags: `Audiences` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **account_id** `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.
- **audience_type** `string` — What to create. Defaults to `custom` (CSV upload). · valores: `custom`, `lookalike`
- **auto_refresh** `boolean` — Filter audiences only, and set only at creation. `true` (the default) rebuilds membership from the filters twice a day. `false` keeps whoever matched at creation and never rebuilds.
- **column_mapping** `object` — Custom audiences only. Maps supported identity fields to CSV column headers. Map at least one of `email` or `phone`.
  - **country** `string` — CSV header for ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, such as `US`.
  - **email** `string` — CSV header for email addresses.
  - **first_name** `string` — CSV header for first names.
  - **last_name** `string` — CSV header for last names.
  - **ltv** `string` — CSV header for each customer's lifetime value — a non-negative number, currency symbols allowed. When mapped, Meta creates the audience as value-based, so lookalikes built from it favor people similar to the highest-value customers.
  - **phone** `string` — CSV header for phone numbers.
- **count** `integer` — Lookalikes only. Number of lookalike audiences to create (1–6).
- **file_id** `string` — Custom audiences only. The uploaded customer CSV — a file id (`file_...`) returned by `POST /files`.
- **filters** `object` — Filter audiences only. The People filters that define membership, keyed exactly as `GET /people` accepts them — for example `{"os": "iOS", "country": "US"}`. Date filters must be rolling windows — `first_seen_within_days` or `last_seen_within_days` — so the audience re-anchors on every refresh; fixed dates such as `first_seen_after` are rejected. Source values are canonical source paths (`whop:<campaign>:<group>:<ad>`, `ext:<platform>:...`, `referrer:<domain>`, `direct`), exact or with a trailing `:*` wildcard.
- **name** `string` — Audience display name. Required for custom audiences; lookalike names are generated from the source audience.
- **percentage** `integer` — Lookalikes only. Total similarity reach as a whole percent (1–20), sliced evenly across `count` — must be divisible by `count`.
- **source_audience_id** `string` — Lookalikes only. The ready custom audience (`adaud_`) to build from; it needs at least 100 matched people.

### Respuestas

**`201`** — Audience created — the audience object for custom audiences, or `{ data: [...] }` for lookalike ladders.

## `PATCH /audiences/{id}`

**Update Audience**

Renames an audience. For an audience built from People filters that keeps itself up to date, pass `filters` to replace them, which rebuilds membership immediately. Whether an audience auto refreshes is set when it is created.

`operationId`: `updateAudience` · tags: `Audiences` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — Audience ID, prefixed `adaud_`.

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **filters** `object` — Replaces the People filters that define membership. The whole definition is replaced rather than merged, so send every filter you want to keep — a filter you leave out stops applying. Keys and values are the ones `GET /people` accepts, such as an `os` of `iOS` or a `country` of `US`, and at least one filter is required. Date filters must be rolling windows — `first_seen_within_days` or `last_seen_within_days` — so the audience re-anchors every time it rebuilds; fixed dates such as `first_seen_after` are rejected, as is `audience_id`. An array value holds at most 500 items, and each value at most 10 KB. Only an audience with a `source_type` of `people_filter` and `auto_refresh` of `true` accepts filters: an uploaded list has no filters to replace, and with auto refresh off the audience keeps the people it matched when it was built, so create a new audience instead.
- **name** `string` — New audience display name. A blank value is ignored rather than clearing the name.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — Audience updated.

- **audience_type** `string` _requerido_ — `custom` = a customer list (uploaded, or built from saved People filters); `lookalike` = Meta lookalike built from a custom audience. · valores: `custom`, `lookalike`
- **auto_refresh** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether membership keeps updating. `true` rebuilds it from the saved filters twice a day, so people join and leave as they start and stop matching. `false` keeps whoever matched when it was built and never rebuilds. Always `false` for uploaded lists and lookalikes.
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the audience was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **error_message** `string | null` _requerido_ — Processing error message. `null` unless processing is partial or failed.
- **filters** `object | null` _requerido_ — For audiences built from People filters: the filters that define membership, keyed exactly as `GET /people` accepts them — for example `{"os": "iOS", "country": "US"}`. `null` for uploaded lists and lookalikes.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — Audience ID, prefixed `adaud_`.
- **last_refreshed_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the audience membership was last rebuilt, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` until the first build completes.
- **lookalike_ratio** `number | null` _requerido_ — For lookalikes: the upper bound of the similarity band as a fraction (0.02 = top 2%). `null` for custom audiences.
- **lookalike_starting_ratio** `number | null` _requerido_ — For lookalikes: the lower bound of the similarity band as a fraction. `null` for custom audiences and first-tier lookalikes.
- **match_rates** `AudienceMatchRate[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **lower_bound** `number | null` _requerido_ — Lower bound of the estimated match rate percentage. `null` until available.
    - **platform** `string` _requerido_ — The ad platform that provided the match-rate estimate. · valores: `meta`
    - **status** `string | null` _requerido_ — Availability of the estimated match rate. · valores: `calculating`, `available`, `unavailable`, `None`
    - **upper_bound** `number | null` _requerido_ — Upper bound of the estimated match rate percentage. `null` until available.
- **matched_rows** `number` _requerido_ — Members successfully uploaded to connected ad accounts. Always 0 for lookalikes.
- **name** `string` _requerido_ — Audience display name.
- **platform_audience_ids** `string[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - External audience IDs created on connected ad platforms, such as Meta.
- **processed_rows** `number` _requerido_ — Members processed from the source so far. Always 0 for lookalikes.
- **progress_percent** `number` _requerido_ — Processing progress from 0 to 100.
- **source_audience_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — For lookalikes: the audience this lookalike was built from. `null` for custom audiences.
- **source_type** `string` _requerido_ — Where members come from. `csv_upload` = an uploaded customer list; `people_filter` = built from saved People filters. See `auto_refresh` for whether a `people_filter` audience keeps updating. · valores: `csv_upload`, `people_filter`
- **status** `string` _requerido_ — Current state of the audience import. `syncing` means Whop is sending matched rows to connected ad accounts. When status is `partial` or `failed`, `error_message` explains what went wrong. · valores: `pending`, `processing`, `syncing`, `ready`, `partial`, `failed`
- **total_rows** `number` _requerido_ — Total members detected in the source — CSV rows for uploaded lists, matching people for automatic audiences. Always 0 for lookalikes.
- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the audience was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

## `GET /bounties`

**List Bounties**

Lists bounties visible to the credential — for an account API key, the account's bounties including scheduled drafts; for a user token, the bounties the user can see and work.

`operationId`: `listBounties` · tags: `Bounties` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **account_id** (`query`) `string` — Scope the list to this account (`biz_` tag). Requires read access to the account; account API keys may pass their own account or a connected account.
- **user_id** (`query`) `string` — List the bounties this user participated in (`user_` tag). Must be the authenticated user.
- **status** (`query`) `string` — Filter by lifecycle state. · valores: `scheduled`, `open`, `closed`, `completed`, `canceled`
- **business_goal_type** (`query`) `string` — Filter by the poster's declared goal. Bounties created before the goal taxonomy carry no goal and never match this filter. · valores: `clipping`, `post_engagement`, `owned_account_growth`, `ugc_content`, `local_activation`, `data_capture`, `other`
- **country** (`query`) `string` — Only bounties workable from this country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Bounties with no country targeting are workable worldwide and always match.
- **experience_id** (`query`) `string` — Only bounties posted to this forum experience, prefixed `exp_`. An unknown experience, or one outside the caller's scope, matches nothing.
- **query** (`query`) `string` — Substring match on the bounty title or ID.
- **created_after** (`query`) `string` — Only bounties created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **created_before** (`query`) `string` — Only bounties created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **order** (`query`) `string` — Sort field. · valores: `created_at`, `gross_paid_out_amount`, `gross_reward_amount` · default: `created_at`
- **direction** (`query`) `string` — Sort direction. · valores: `asc`, `desc` · default: `desc`
- **first** (`query`) `integer` — Number of bounties to return from the start of the window. · default: `20`
- **after** (`query`) `string` — Cursor to paginate forwards from.
- **last** (`query`) `integer` — Number of bounties to return from the end of the window.
- **before** (`query`) `string` — Cursor to paginate backwards from.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — bounties listed

- **data** `BountyListItem[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **accepted_deliverable_types** `string[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - The deliverable shapes this bounty accepts. Every bounty accepts any combination of `content_url` (posted links) and `media` (uploaded files), except `data_capture` bounties, whose proof is clips recorded in the Whop app that accumulate on the attempt.
    - **accepted_submissions_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Submissions accepted so far.
    - **accepted_submissions_limit** `integer` _requerido_ — Number of submissions that can be accepted (winner slots).
    - **accepted_submissions_per_user_limit** `integer` _requerido_ — How many winner slots one worker can win. Defaults to `1`. Wins plus proofs awaiting review never exceed this number, and a worker runs one attempt at a time. Cannot exceed `accepted_submissions_limit`.
    - **affiliate_share_amount** `number` _requerido_ — What a referrer earns per accepted submission when the worker arrived through their affiliate link, in whole currency units, at the standard platform fee rate. Taken out of the worker's post-fee reward rather than added on top. `0` when the bounty pays no affiliate share, including bounties tied to no account, which cannot record a referral.
    - **allowed_country_codes** `string[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - Countries whose residents can work the bounty, as ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes. Empty means worldwide.
    - **budget_amount** `number` _requerido_ — Total gross budget committed to the bounty: `gross_reward_amount` times `accepted_submissions_limit`.
    - **business_goal_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — What the poster wants the work to achieve, declared once at create. `null` for bounties created before the taxonomy rolled out. · valores: `clipping`, `post_engagement`, `owned_account_growth`, `ugc_content`, `local_activation`, `data_capture`, `other`, `None`
    - **cancel_requested_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When cancellation was requested, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. On a `closed` bounty this means the cancel is pending: submissions are stopped and the bounty cancels once in-flight submissions resolve. On a `canceled` bounty it records when the cancellation was requested. `null` when no cancellation was ever requested.
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the bounty was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **currency** `string` _requerido_ — Currency for all amounts on the bounty, as a lowercase ISO 4217 code.
    - **description** `string` _requerido_ — Full task instructions shown to workers.
    - **discussion_experience_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Experience the bounty's discussion thread lives in, prefixed `exp_`. Read this — not `experience_id` — to open the thread: a platform-wide bounty has no hosting experience of its own but its discussion still lives in one.
    - **discussion_feed_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Forum feed containing the bounty's discussion thread. `null` for a bounty with no forum post.
    - **discussion_post_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Forum post anchoring the bounty's discussion thread. Read together with `discussion_experience_id` to address the thread. `null` for a bounty with no forum post.
    - **experience_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Experience the bounty is hosted in, prefixed `exp_`. `null` for platform-wide bounties; may belong to a different account than the funder.
    - **funding_account** `AccountSummary | null` _requerido_ — Account whose balance funds the bounty pool, or `null` when a user funds it personally. May differ from the account hosting `experience_id`.
      - _uno de:_
        - **AccountSummary**
          - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.
          - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Account display name.
        - **null**
    - **gross_paid_out_amount** `number` _requerido_ — Gross amount paid out from the bounty pool across accepted submissions — worker payouts, platform fees, and affiliate shares together. Tips and reviewer rewards are excluded.
    - **gross_reward_amount** `number` _requerido_ — Gross bounty-pool amount allocated per accepted submission, in whole currency units.
    - **hosting_account** `StorefrontAccount | null` _requerido_ — Account hosting the bounty's forum — the one whose `route` and `experience_id` address its discussion thread, and where its submissions dashboard lives. `null` for a platform-wide bounty with no host. May differ from `funding_account`.
      - _uno de:_
        - **StorefrontAccount**
          - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.
          - **logo_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Account logo image URL. `null` when the account has not set one.
          - **route** `string` _requerido_ — Account public route identifier — the `whop.com/{route}` storefront path.
          - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Account display name.
        - **null**
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Bounty ID, prefixed `bnty_`.
    - **min_total_verified_duration_seconds** `integer | null` _requerido_ — Total verified footage a submission must accumulate before it can be submitted, in seconds. Always a whole number of hours. Present only on `data_capture` bounties — it is what `net_reward_amount` pays for, so rate displays divide by it. `null` for every other goal type.
    - **net_reward_amount** `number` _requerido_ — What a worker is quoted per accepted submission after the platform fee, in whole currency units. The exact post-fee figure, at the standard platform fee rate — a worker who locked a different rate, or who arrived through an affiliate link, is paid a different amount.
    - **poster** `UserSummary` _requerido_ — User who posted the bounty — the account owner when created with an account API key.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — User ID, prefixed `user_`.
      - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display name.
      - **profile_picture** `UserProfilePicture` _requerido_ — Avatar wrapper; its `url` is always present, using a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
        - **url** `string` _requerido_ — Avatar image URL. Always present — a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
      - **username** `string` _requerido_ — Public username.
    - **scheduled_frequency** `string | null` _requerido_ — How often the schedule creates a new bounty. Each occurrence is a separate bounty; the original is not republished. · valores: `once`, `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `None`
    - **scheduled_publish_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When a scheduled bounty will publish, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` once published, for bounties that were never scheduled, and for terminally failed drafts parked for manual rescheduling.
    - **spots_remaining** `integer` _requerido_ — Unfilled winner capacity: `accepted_submissions_limit` minus `accepted_submissions_count`, clamped to zero. Not on its own a signal that the bounty accepts new claims — read `status` for that: only an `open` bounty takes new submissions.
    - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Lifecycle state. `scheduled` bounties are unpublished drafts, visible to their poster and the account's authorized managers; `open` bounties accept new submissions; `closed` bounties are live but no longer accept new submissions; `completed` bounties paid out every winner slot; `canceled` bounties ended before filling their slots. · valores: `scheduled`, `open`, `closed`, `completed`, `canceled`
    - **submissions_closed_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When new submissions stopped being accepted, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Set when a cancellation is requested on a bounty with work in flight, so in-flight submissions can resolve before the bounty cancels. `null` when submissions were never stopped — including completed bounties that simply filled every winner slot.
    - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Short name of the task shown to workers.
    - **unresolved_submissions_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Submissions still awaiting an outcome: in progress or pending review.
    - **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the bounty was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **viewer_accepted_submissions_count** `integer` _requerido_ — How many winner slots the authenticated user has already won on this bounty. Read against `accepted_submissions_per_user_limit` to show a worker their remaining allowance. `0` when the request has no authenticated user.
- **page_info** `object` _requerido_
  - **end_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_
  - **has_next_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **has_previous_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **start_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_

**`400`** — Invalid Parameters

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`403`** — Forbidden

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.

## `POST /bounties`

**Create Bounty**

Creates a bounty and escrows its reward pool. Publishes immediately, or as a scheduled draft when you set `publish_at`.

`operationId`: `createBounty` · tags: `Bounties` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

### Request body — `application/json`

- **accepted_submissions_limit** `integer | null` — Number of submissions that can be accepted (winner slots). Defaults to 1. The escrowed total is `gross_reward_amount` times this limit and must be at least $5.
- **accepted_submissions_per_user_limit** `integer | null` — How many winner slots one worker can win. Defaults to `1`. Wins plus proofs awaiting review never exceed this number, and a worker runs one attempt at a time. Cannot exceed `accepted_submissions_limit`.
- **account_id** `string | null` — Account whose balance funds the bounty pool (`biz_` tag). Defaults to the caller's personal balance. Requires permission to move the account's funds.
- **allowed_country_codes** `array | null` — Countries whose residents can work the bounty, as ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes. Empty means worldwide.
  - `array` de:
- **business_goal_type** `string` — What the poster wants the work to achieve, declared once here. · valores: `clipping`, `post_engagement`, `owned_account_growth`, `ugc_content`, `local_activation`, `data_capture`, `other`
- **capture_spec** `object` — Per-bounty overrides of the served capture contract. Only accepted when `business_goal_type` is `data_capture`; omitted fields keep the platform defaults, and the resulting contract is echoed back as `capture_spec` on the bounty.
  - **bitrate_target_mbps** `integer` — Average bitrate the recorder encodes at, in megabits per second. Must sit within the served floor and ceiling.
  - **embed_camera_metadata** `boolean` — Whether the recorder also writes camera make and model into the video container's metadata.
  - **frame_gap_tolerance_ms** `integer` — Longest stall between consecutive frames a clip may contain before the client rejects it, in milliseconds. Unlike the recording fields this one can also be tuned after the bounty is created, since it bounds what is accepted rather than how footage is captured.
  - **min_clip_duration_seconds** `integer` — Minimum length of a single clip, in seconds.
  - **min_total_verified_duration_seconds** `integer` — Total verified footage a submission must accumulate across all its clips before it can be submitted, in seconds. Must be a whole number of hours between 1 and 12. Editable after create, until someone starts an attempt.
  - **stabilization_mode** `string` — How the recorder configures video stabilization. `off` preserves raw motion for pose extraction. · valores: `off`, `on`, `any`
- **description** `string` _requerido_ — Full task instructions shown to workers.
- **experience_id** `string | null` — Experience to host the bounty in (`exp_` tag). Any visibility — public for an open bounty, private for an invited one. Required unless account_id is set, in which case the bounty anchors in that account's public forum.
- **frequency** `string` — How often the schedule creates a new bounty. Each occurrence is a separate bounty. Defaults to `once`; only applies with `publish_at`. · valores: `once`, `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`
- **gross_reward_amount** `number` _requerido_ — Gross bounty-pool amount (USD) escrowed per accepted submission, in whole dollars. Platform fees and affiliate shares are paid from this amount.
- **publish_at** `string | null` — ISO 8601 time to publish the bounty. When set, the bounty is created as a hidden draft and funded + published at this time instead of immediately.
- **publish_at_timezone** `string | null` — IANA timezone for recurring occurrences. Required when publish_at is set.
- **title** `string` _requerido_ — Short name of the task shown to workers.

### Respuestas

**`201`** — bounty created

- **accepted_deliverable_types** `string[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - The deliverable shapes this bounty accepts. Every bounty accepts any combination of `content_url` (posted links) and `media` (uploaded files), except `data_capture` bounties, whose proof is clips recorded in the Whop app that accumulate on the attempt.
- **accepted_submissions_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Submissions accepted so far.
- **accepted_submissions_limit** `integer` _requerido_ — Number of submissions that can be accepted (winner slots).
- **accepted_submissions_per_user_limit** `integer` _requerido_ — How many winner slots one worker can win. Defaults to `1`. Wins plus proofs awaiting review never exceed this number, and a worker runs one attempt at a time. Cannot exceed `accepted_submissions_limit`.
- **active_proof_livestream_feeds** `BountyActiveLivestreamFeed[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **host** `UserSummary | null` _requerido_ — User hosting the proof livestream — the worker streaming their attempt. `null` if the host account no longer exists.
      - _uno de:_
        - **UserSummary**
          - **id** `string` _requerido_ — User ID, prefixed `user_`.
          - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display name.
          - **profile_picture** `UserProfilePicture` _requerido_ — Avatar wrapper; its `url` is always present, using a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
            - **url** `string` _requerido_ — Avatar image URL. Always present — a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
          - **username** `string` _requerido_ — Public username.
        - **null**
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Livestream feed ID.
    - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Display title for the proof livestream.
- **affiliate_share_amount** `number` _requerido_ — What a referrer earns per accepted submission when the worker arrived through their affiliate link, in whole currency units, at the standard platform fee rate. Taken out of the worker's post-fee reward rather than added on top. `0` when the bounty pays no affiliate share, including bounties tied to no account, which cannot record a referral.
- **allowed_country_codes** `string[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - Countries whose residents can work the bounty, as ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes. Empty means worldwide.
- **awaiting_review_submissions_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Submissions delivered and waiting on review. A subset of `unresolved_submissions_count`, which also counts attempts still in progress.
- **budget_amount** `number` _requerido_ — Total gross budget committed to the bounty: `gross_reward_amount` times `accepted_submissions_limit`.
- **business_goal_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — What the poster wants the work to achieve, declared once at create. `null` for bounties created before the taxonomy rolled out. · valores: `clipping`, `post_engagement`, `owned_account_growth`, `ugc_content`, `local_activation`, `data_capture`, `other`, `None`
- **cancel_requested_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When cancellation was requested, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. On a `closed` bounty this means the cancel is pending: submissions are stopped and the bounty cancels once in-flight submissions resolve. On a `canceled` bounty it records when the cancellation was requested. `null` when no cancellation was ever requested.
- **capture_spec** `CaptureSpec | null` _requerido_ — The technical contract footage must be recorded against. Present only on `data_capture` bounties; `null` for every other goal type.
  - _uno de:_
    - **CaptureSpec**
      - **filename_pattern** `string` _requerido_ — The naming convention for uploaded files, built from the required metadata fields.
      - **imu** `CaptureSpecImu` _requerido_ — Inertial measurement unit (IMU) recording requirements.
        - **device_motion_units** `string` _requerido_ — Units for the device-motion channels, as a compact key=unit string.
        - **magnetometer_units** `string` _requerido_ — Units for the magnetometer channel.
        - **min_rate_hz** `number` _requerido_ — Minimum sustained IMU sample rate in hertz for a clip to pass validation.
        - **target_rate_hz** `integer` _requerido_ — Target IMU sample rate in hertz.
        - **warmup_min_rate_hz** `number` _requerido_ — Minimum IMU sample rate in hertz tolerated during the warmup window.
        - **warmup_ns** `integer` _requerido_ — Startup window, in nanoseconds, during which the relaxed warmup rate applies.
      - **manifest_schema_version** `integer` _requerido_ — Schema version the client must stamp on the capture manifest it uploads.
      - **min_clip_duration_seconds** `integer` _requerido_ — Minimum length of a single clip, in seconds.
      - **min_total_verified_duration_seconds** `integer` _requerido_ — Total verified footage a submission must accumulate across all its clips before it can be submitted, in seconds. Always a whole number of hours.
      - **required_metadata_fields** `string[]` _requerido_
        - `array` de:
          - Metadata fields a submission must provide, matching the `metadata` object on the submissions API.
      - **single_continuous_take** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether each clip must be one uninterrupted recording rather than stitched segments.
      - **video** `CaptureSpecVideo` _requerido_ — Video recording requirements.
        - **bitrate_ceiling_mbps** `integer` _requerido_ — Maximum acceptable average bitrate, in megabits per second.
        - **bitrate_floor_mbps** `integer` _requerido_ — Minimum acceptable average bitrate, in megabits per second.
        - **bitrate_target_mbps** `integer` _requerido_ — Recommended average bitrate to encode at, in megabits per second.
        - **camera_lens** `string` _requerido_ — Which physical lens to record with.
        - **codecs** `string[]` _requerido_
          - `array` de:
            - Accepted video codecs, in preference order.
        - **embed_camera_metadata** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the client must also write the camera make and model into the video container's metadata. When `false`, the capture manifest and export CSV are the metadata carrier.
        - **fps** `integer` _requerido_ — Target capture frame rate.
        - **frame_gap_tolerance_ms** `integer` _requerido_ — Longest stall between consecutive frames a clip may contain before the client rejects it, in milliseconds. Every frame is timestamped in the frame log, so a stall stays alignable downstream — this bounds how broken a capture may be, not how evenly it must be paced.
        - **height** `integer` _requerido_ — Required frame height in pixels — recorded footage must match exactly.
        - **min_fov_degrees** `integer` _requerido_ — Minimum acceptable horizontal field of view, in degrees.
        - **orientation** `string` _requerido_ — Device orientation to record in.
        - **preferred_fov_degrees** `integer` _requerido_ — Preferred horizontal field of view, in degrees.
        - **stabilization_mode** `string` _requerido_ — How the client must configure video stabilization: `off` disables EIS so raw motion is preserved for pose extraction, `on` requires it, `any` leaves the device default. · valores: `off`, `on`, `any`
        - **stabilization_required** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether hardware/software stabilization must be enabled. True exactly when stabilization_mode is `on`.
        - **width** `integer` _requerido_ — Required frame width in pixels — recorded footage must match exactly.
    - **null**
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the bounty was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **currency** `string` _requerido_ — Currency for all amounts on the bounty, as a lowercase ISO 4217 code. · valores: `usd`, `sgd`, `inr`, `aud`, `brl`, `cad`, `dkk`, `eur`, `nok`, `gbp`, `sek`, `chf`, `hkd`, `huf`, `jpy`, `mxn`, `myr`, `pln`, `czk`, `nzd`, `aed`, `cop`, `ron`, `thb` …
- **denied_submissions_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Submissions reviewed and turned down.
- **description** `string` _requerido_ — Full task instructions shown to workers.
- **discussion_experience_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Experience the bounty's discussion thread lives in, prefixed `exp_`. Read this — not `experience_id` — to open the thread: a platform-wide bounty has no hosting experience of its own but its discussion still lives in one.
- **discussion_feed_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Forum feed containing the bounty's discussion thread. `null` for a bounty with no forum post.
- **discussion_post_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Forum post anchoring the bounty's discussion thread. Read together with `discussion_experience_id` to address the thread. `null` for a bounty with no forum post.
- **experience_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Experience the bounty is hosted in, prefixed `exp_`. `null` for platform-wide bounties; may belong to a different account than the funder.
- **funding_account** `AccountSummary | null` _requerido_ — Account whose balance funds the bounty pool, or `null` when a user funds it personally. May differ from the account hosting `experience_id`.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AccountSummary**
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.
      - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Account display name.
    - **null**
- **gross_paid_out_amount** `number` _requerido_ — Gross amount paid out from the bounty pool across accepted submissions — worker payouts, platform fees, and affiliate shares together. Tips and reviewer rewards are excluded.
- **gross_reward_amount** `number` _requerido_ — Gross bounty-pool amount allocated per accepted submission, in whole currency units.
- **hosting_account** `StorefrontAccount | null` _requerido_ — Account hosting the bounty's forum — the one whose `route` and `experience_id` address its discussion thread, and where its submissions dashboard lives. `null` for a platform-wide bounty with no host. May differ from `funding_account`.
  - _uno de:_
    - **StorefrontAccount**
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.
      - **logo_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Account logo image URL. `null` when the account has not set one.
      - **route** `string` _requerido_ — Account public route identifier — the `whop.com/{route}` storefront path.
      - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Account display name.
    - **null**
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — Bounty ID, prefixed `bnty_`.
- **min_total_verified_duration_seconds** `integer | null` _requerido_ — Total verified footage a submission must accumulate before it can be submitted, in seconds. Always a whole number of hours. Present only on `data_capture` bounties — it is what `net_reward_amount` pays for, so rate displays divide by it. `null` for every other goal type.
- **net_reward_amount** `number` _requerido_ — What a worker is quoted per accepted submission after the platform fee, in whole currency units. The exact post-fee figure, at the standard platform fee rate — a worker who locked a different rate, or who arrived through an affiliate link, is paid a different amount.
- **poster** `UserSummary` _requerido_ — User who posted the bounty — the account owner when created with an account API key.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — User ID, prefixed `user_`.
  - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display name.
  - **profile_picture** `UserProfilePicture` _requerido_ — Avatar wrapper; its `url` is always present, using a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
    - **url** `string` _requerido_ — Avatar image URL. Always present — a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
  - **username** `string` _requerido_ — Public username.
- **scheduled_frequency** `string | null` _requerido_ — How often the schedule creates a new bounty. Each occurrence is a separate bounty; the original is not republished. · valores: `once`, `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `None`
- **scheduled_publish_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When a scheduled bounty will publish, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` once published, for bounties that were never scheduled, and for terminally failed drafts parked for manual rescheduling.
- **spots_remaining** `integer` _requerido_ — Unfilled winner capacity: `accepted_submissions_limit` minus `accepted_submissions_count`, clamped to zero. Not on its own a signal that the bounty accepts new claims — read `status` for that: only an `open` bounty takes new submissions.
- **status** `string` _requerido_ — Lifecycle state. `scheduled` bounties are unpublished drafts, visible to their poster and the account's authorized managers; `open` bounties accept new submissions; `closed` bounties are live but no longer accept new submissions; `completed` bounties paid out every winner slot; `canceled` bounties ended before filling their slots. · valores: `scheduled`, `open`, `closed`, `completed`, `canceled`
- **submissions_closed_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When new submissions stopped being accepted, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Set when a cancellation is requested on a bounty with work in flight, so in-flight submissions can resolve before the bounty cancels. `null` when submissions were never stopped — including completed bounties that simply filled every winner slot.
- **title** `string` _requerido_ — Short name of the task shown to workers.
- **unresolved_submissions_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Submissions still awaiting an outcome: in progress or pending review.
- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the bounty was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **viewer_accepted_submissions_count** `integer` _requerido_ — How many winner slots the authenticated user has already won on this bounty. Read against `accepted_submissions_per_user_limit` to show a worker their remaining allowance. `0` when the request has no authenticated user.

## `GET /bounties/{bounty_id}/submissions`

**List Public Submissions**

Lists a bounty's publicly visible work — submitted, approved, and denied submissions in the reduced public shape. Authentication is optional; a bounty that is not publicly visible returns `404`.

`operationId`: `listPublicBountySubmissions` · tags: `Bounties` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **bounty_id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The bounty whose public submissions to list (`bnty_` tag).
- **status** (`query`) `string` — Filter by lifecycle state. · valores: `submitted`, `approved`, `denied`
- **created_after** (`query`) `string` — Only submissions created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **created_before** (`query`) `string` — Only submissions created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **order** (`query`) `string` — Sort field. · valores: `created_at`, `updated_at` · default: `created_at`
- **direction** (`query`) `string` — Sort direction. · valores: `asc`, `desc` · default: `desc`
- **first** (`query`) `integer` — Number of submissions to return from the start of the window. · default: `20`
- **after** (`query`) `string` — Cursor to paginate forwards from.
- **last** (`query`) `integer` — Number of submissions to return from the end of the window.
- **before** (`query`) `string` — Cursor to paginate backwards from.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — public bounty submissions listed

- **data** `PublicBountySubmission[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **bounty_id** `string` _requerido_ — The bounty the work was submitted to, prefixed `bnty_`.
    - **claimed_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the worker claimed the submission, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the submission was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **denial_reason** `string | null` _requerido_ — Why the submission was denied, when a presentable reason exists. Always `null` unless `status` is `denied`.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Submission ID, prefixed `btys_`.
    - **latest_proof_livestream_feed** `BountySubmissionLivestreamFeed | null` _requerido_ — Latest public proof livestream attached to the submission.
      - _uno de:_
        - **BountySubmissionLivestreamFeed**
          - **ended_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the proof livestream ended, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` while it is still live — a feed with a `started_at` and no `ended_at` is streaming right now.
          - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Livestream feed ID.
          - **recording_status** `string | null` _requerido_ — Recording lifecycle state. · valores: `recording`, `processing`, `completed`, `failed`, `None`
          - **recording_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Playback URL for a completed proof recording, when available.
          - **started_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the proof livestream went live, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` before it starts.
          - **thumbnail_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Current proof thumbnail URL, when available.
          - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Display title for the proof livestream.
        - **null**
    - **resolved_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the submission was approved or denied, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` until then.
    - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Lifecycle state. `submitted` submissions await review; `approved` submissions were accepted and paid; `denied` submissions were rejected. In-progress attempts never appear on the public list. · valores: `submitted`, `approved`, `denied`
    - **submitted_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When proof was submitted for review, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the submission was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **worker** `UserSummary` _requerido_ — User who submitted the work.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — User ID, prefixed `user_`.
      - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display name.
      - **profile_picture** `UserProfilePicture` _requerido_ — Avatar wrapper; its `url` is always present, using a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
        - **url** `string` _requerido_ — Avatar image URL. Always present — a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
      - **username** `string` _requerido_ — Public username.
- **page_info** `object` _requerido_
  - **end_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_
  - **has_next_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **has_previous_page** `boolean` _requerido_

The exact post-fee figure, at the standard platform fee rate — a worker who locked a different rate, or who arrived through an affiliate link, is paid a different amount.

- **submissions_closed_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When new submissions stopped being accepted, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. - **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the bounty was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

## `PATCH /bounties/{id}`

**Update Bounty**

Updates a bounty. A published bounty accepts title, description, and country targeting while it is still open with nothing under review. A scheduled (not-yet-published) draft additionally accepts the reward, winner slots, and schedule.

`operationId`: `updateBounty` · tags: `Bounties` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — Bounty ID (`bnty_` tag).

### Request body — `application/json`

- **accepted_submissions_limit** `integer | null` — Scheduled drafts only. Number of submissions that can be accepted (winner slots).
- **accepted_submissions_per_user_limit** `integer | null` — How many winner slots one worker can win. Defaults to `1`. Wins plus proofs awaiting review never exceed this number, and a worker runs one attempt at a time. Cannot exceed `accepted_submissions_limit`. Editable while the bounty is still open with nothing under review.
- **allowed_country_codes** `array | null` — Replace the countries whose residents can work the bounty, as ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes. Empty means worldwide.
  - `array` de:
- **business_goal_type** `string` — What the poster wants the work to achieve, declared once here. · valores: `clipping`, `post_engagement`, `owned_account_growth`, `ugc_content`, `local_activation`, `data_capture`, `other`
- **description** `string` — New full task instructions.
- **frequency** `string` — Scheduled drafts only. How often the schedule creates a new bounty. · valores: `once`, `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`
- **gross_reward_amount** `number | null` — Scheduled drafts only. Gross bounty-pool amount (USD) escrowed per accepted submission. The escrowed total (this times accepted_submissions_limit) must stay at least $5.
- **publish_at** `string | null` — Scheduled drafts only. New ISO 8601 time to publish the draft. Must be in the future.
- **publish_at_timezone** `string | null` — Scheduled drafts only. IANA timezone for recurring occurrences.
- **title** `string` — New short name of the task.
