## `POST /bounties/{id}/cancel`

**Cancel**

Cancels a bounty. With no in-flight work, it cancels immediately and refunds the funder. Otherwise it stops new submissions and cancels once the in-flight work resolves and pays out. Repeating the request is a no-op. A bounty that already paid out every slot returns `400`.

`operationId`: `cancelBounty` · tags: `Bounties` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — Bounty ID (`bnty_` tag).
- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

### Respuestas

**`200`** — cancellation requested

- **accepted_deliverable_types** `string[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - The deliverable shapes this bounty accepts. Every bounty accepts any combination of `content_url` (posted links) and `media` (uploaded files), except `data_capture` bounties, whose proof is clips recorded in the Whop app that accumulate on the attempt.
- **accepted_submissions_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Submissions accepted so far.
- **accepted_submissions_limit** `integer` _requerido_ — Number of submissions that can be accepted (winner slots).
- **accepted_submissions_per_user_limit** `integer` _requerido_ — How many winner slots one worker can win. Defaults to `1`. Wins plus proofs awaiting review never exceed this number, and a worker runs one attempt at a time. Cannot exceed `accepted_submissions_limit`.
- **active_proof_livestream_feeds** `BountyActiveLivestreamFeed[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **host** `UserSummary | null` _requerido_ — User hosting the proof livestream — the worker streaming their attempt. `null` if the host account no longer exists.
      - _uno de:_
        - **UserSummary**
          - **id** `string` _requerido_ — User ID, prefixed `user_`.
          - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display name.
          - **profile_picture** `UserProfilePicture` _requerido_ — Avatar wrapper; its `url` is always present, using a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
            - **url** `string` _requerido_ — Avatar image URL. Always present — a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
          - **username** `string` _requerido_ — Public username.
        - **null**
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Livestream feed ID.
    - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Display title for the proof livestream.
- **affiliate_share_amount** `number` _requerido_ — What a referrer earns per accepted submission when the worker arrived through their affiliate link, in whole currency units, at the standard platform fee rate. Taken out of the worker's post-fee reward rather than added on top. `0` when the bounty pays no affiliate share, including bounties tied to no account, which cannot record a referral.
- **allowed_country_codes** `string[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - Countries whose residents can work the bounty, as ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes. Empty means worldwide.
- **awaiting_review_submissions_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Submissions delivered and waiting on review. A subset of `unresolved_submissions_count`, which also counts attempts still in progress.
- **budget_amount** `number` _requerido_ — Total gross budget committed to the bounty: `gross_reward_amount` times `accepted_submissions_limit`.
- **business_goal_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — What the poster wants the work to achieve, declared once at create. `null` for bounties created before the taxonomy rolled out. · valores: `clipping`, `post_engagement`, `owned_account_growth`, `ugc_content`, `local_activation`, `data_capture`, `other`, `None`
- **cancel_requested_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When cancellation was requested, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. On a `closed` bounty this means the cancel is pending: submissions are stopped and the bounty cancels once in-flight submissions resolve. On a `canceled` bounty it records when the cancellation was requested. `null` when no cancellation was ever requested.
- **capture_spec** `CaptureSpec | null` _requerido_ — The technical contract footage must be recorded against. Present only on `data_capture` bounties; `null` for every other goal type.
  - _uno de:_
    - **CaptureSpec**
      - **filename_pattern** `string` _requerido_ — The naming convention for uploaded files, built from the required metadata fields.
      - **imu** `CaptureSpecImu` _requerido_ — Inertial measurement unit (IMU) recording requirements.
        - **device_motion_units** `string` _requerido_ — Units for the device-motion channels, as a compact key=unit string.
        - **magnetometer_units** `string` _requerido_ — Units for the magnetometer channel.
        - **min_rate_hz** `number` _requerido_ — Minimum sustained IMU sample rate in hertz for a clip to pass validation.
        - **target_rate_hz** `integer` _requerido_ — Target IMU sample rate in hertz.
        - **warmup_min_rate_hz** `number` _requerido_ — Minimum IMU sample rate in hertz tolerated during the warmup window.
        - **warmup_ns** `integer` _requerido_ — Startup window, in nanoseconds, during which the relaxed warmup rate applies.
      - **manifest_schema_version** `integer` _requerido_ — Schema version the client must stamp on the capture manifest it uploads.
      - **min_clip_duration_seconds** `integer` _requerido_ — Minimum length of a single clip, in seconds.
      - **min_total_verified_duration_seconds** `integer` _requerido_ — Total verified footage a submission must accumulate across all its clips before it can be submitted, in seconds. Always a whole number of hours.
      - **required_metadata_fields** `string[]` _requerido_
        - `array` de:
          - Metadata fields a submission must provide, matching the `metadata` object on the submissions API.
      - **single_continuous_take** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether each clip must be one uninterrupted recording rather than stitched segments.
      - **video** `CaptureSpecVideo` _requerido_ — Video recording requirements.
        - **bitrate_ceiling_mbps** `integer` _requerido_ — Maximum acceptable average bitrate, in megabits per second.
        - **bitrate_floor_mbps** `integer` _requerido_ — Minimum acceptable average bitrate, in megabits per second.
        - **bitrate_target_mbps** `integer` _requerido_ — Recommended average bitrate to encode at, in megabits per second.
        - **camera_lens** `string` _requerido_ — Which physical lens to record with.
        - **codecs** `string[]` _requerido_
          - `array` de:
            - Accepted video codecs, in preference order.
        - **embed_camera_metadata** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether the client must also write the camera make and model into the video container's metadata. When `false`, the capture manifest and export CSV are the metadata carrier.
        - **fps** `integer` _requerido_ — Target capture frame rate.
        - **frame_gap_tolerance_ms** `integer` _requerido_ — Longest stall between consecutive frames a clip may contain before the client rejects it, in milliseconds. Every frame is timestamped in the frame log, so a stall stays alignable downstream — this bounds how broken a capture may be, not how evenly it must be paced.
        - **height** `integer` _requerido_ — Required frame height in pixels — recorded footage must match exactly.
        - **min_fov_degrees** `integer` _requerido_ — Minimum acceptable horizontal field of view, in degrees.
        - **orientation** `string` _requerido_ — Device orientation to record in.
        - **preferred_fov_degrees** `integer` _requerido_ — Preferred horizontal field of view, in degrees.
        - **stabilization_mode** `string` _requerido_ — How the client must configure video stabilization: `off` disables EIS so raw motion is preserved for pose extraction, `on` requires it, `any` leaves the device default. · valores: `off`, `on`, `any`
        - **stabilization_required** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether hardware/software stabilization must be enabled. True exactly when stabilization_mode is `on`.
        - **width** `integer` _requerido_ — Required frame width in pixels — recorded footage must match exactly.
    - **null**
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the bounty was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **currency** `string` _requerido_ — Currency for all amounts on the bounty, as a lowercase ISO 4217 code. · valores: `usd`, `sgd`, `inr`, `aud`, `brl`, `cad`, `dkk`, `eur`, `nok`, `gbp`, `sek`, `chf`, `hkd`, `huf`, `jpy`, `mxn`, `myr`, `pln`, `czk`, `nzd`, `aed`, `cop`, `ron`, `thb` …
- **denied_submissions_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Submissions reviewed and turned down.
- **description** `string` _requerido_ — Full task instructions shown to workers.
- **discussion_experience_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Experience the bounty's discussion thread lives in, prefixed `exp_`. Read this — not `experience_id` — to open the thread: a platform-wide bounty has no hosting experience of its own but its discussion still lives in one.
- **discussion_feed_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Forum feed containing the bounty's discussion thread. `null` for a bounty with no forum post.
- **discussion_post_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Forum post anchoring the bounty's discussion thread. Read together with `discussion_experience_id` to address the thread. `null` for a bounty with no forum post.
- **experience_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Experience the bounty is hosted in, prefixed `exp_`. `null` for platform-wide bounties; may belong to a different account than the funder.
- **funding_account** `AccountSummary | null` _requerido_ — Account whose balance funds the bounty pool, or `null` when a user funds it personally. May differ from the account hosting `experience_id`.
  - _uno de:_
    - **AccountSummary**
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.
      - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Account display name.
    - **null**
- **gross_paid_out_amount** `number` _requerido_ — Gross amount paid out from the bounty pool across accepted submissions — worker payouts, platform fees, and affiliate shares together. Tips and reviewer rewards are excluded.
- **gross_reward_amount** `number` _requerido_ — Gross bounty-pool amount allocated per accepted submission, in whole currency units.
- **hosting_account** `StorefrontAccount | null` _requerido_ — Account hosting the bounty's forum — the one whose `route` and `experience_id` address its discussion thread, and where its submissions dashboard lives. `null` for a platform-wide bounty with no host. May differ from `funding_account`.
  - _uno de:_
    - **StorefrontAccount**
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.
      - **logo_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Account logo image URL. `null` when the account has not set one.
      - **route** `string` _requerido_ — Account public route identifier — the `whop.com/{route}` storefront path.
      - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Account display name.
    - **null**
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — Bounty ID, prefixed `bnty_`.
- **min_total_verified_duration_seconds** `integer | null` _requerido_ — Total verified footage a submission must accumulate before it can be submitted, in seconds. Always a whole number of hours. Present only on `data_capture` bounties — it is what `net_reward_amount` pays for, so rate displays divide by it. `null` for every other goal type.
- **net_reward_amount** `number` _requerido_ — What a worker is quoted per accepted submission after the platform fee, in whole currency units. The exact post-fee figure, at the standard platform fee rate — a worker who locked a different rate, or who arrived through an affiliate link, is paid a different amount.
- **poster** `UserSummary` _requerido_ — User who posted the bounty — the account owner when created with an account API key.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — User ID, prefixed `user_`.
  - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display name.
  - **profile_picture** `UserProfilePicture` _requerido_ — Avatar wrapper; its `url` is always present, using a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
    - **url** `string` _requerido_ — Avatar image URL. Always present — a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
  - **username** `string` _requerido_ — Public username.
- **scheduled_frequency** `string | null` _requerido_ — How often the schedule creates a new bounty. Each occurrence is a separate bounty; the original is not republished. · valores: `once`, `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `None`
- **scheduled_publish_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When a scheduled bounty will publish, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` once published, for bounties that were never scheduled, and for terminally failed drafts parked for manual rescheduling.
- **spots_remaining** `integer` _requerido_ — Unfilled winner capacity: `accepted_submissions_limit` minus `accepted_submissions_count`, clamped to zero. Not on its own a signal that the bounty accepts new claims — read `status` for that: only an `open` bounty takes new submissions.
- **status** `string` _requerido_ — Lifecycle state. `scheduled` bounties are unpublished drafts, visible to their poster and the account's authorized managers; `open` bounties accept new submissions; `closed` bounties are live but no longer accept new submissions; `completed` bounties paid out every winner slot; `canceled` bounties ended before filling their slots. · valores: `scheduled`, `open`, `closed`, `completed`, `canceled`
- **submissions_closed_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When new submissions stopped being accepted, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Set when a cancellation is requested on a bounty with work in flight, so in-flight submissions can resolve before the bounty cancels. `null` when submissions were never stopped — including completed bounties that simply filled every winner slot.
- **title** `string` _requerido_ — Short name of the task shown to workers.
- **unresolved_submissions_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Submissions still awaiting an outcome: in progress or pending review.
- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the bounty was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **viewer_accepted_submissions_count** `integer` _requerido_ — How many winner slots the authenticated user has already won on this bounty. Read against `accepted_submissions_per_user_limit` to show a worker their remaining allowance. `0` when the request has no authenticated user.

## `GET /bounty_submissions`

**List Bounty Submissions**

Lists bounty submissions visible to the credential — for a user token, the submissions they authored plus those on bounties they posted; for an account API key, the submissions on the account's bounties. For the anonymous view of one bounty's reviewed work, use the submissions list under the bounty instead.

`operationId`: `listBountySubmissions` · tags: `Bounty Submissions` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **account_id** (`query`) `string` — Scope the list to submissions on this account's bounties (`biz_` tag). Requires read access to the account.
- **bounty_id** (`query`) `string` — Only submissions on this bounty (`bnty_` tag).
- **status** (`query`) `string` — Filter by lifecycle state. · valores: `in_progress`, `submitted`, `approved`, `denied`
- **created_after** (`query`) `string` — Only submissions created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **created_before** (`query`) `string` — Only submissions created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **order** (`query`) `string` — Sort field. · valores: `created_at`, `updated_at` · default: `created_at`
- **direction** (`query`) `string` — Sort direction. · valores: `asc`, `desc` · default: `desc`
- **first** (`query`) `integer` — Number of submissions to return from the start of the window. · default: `20`
- **after** (`query`) `string` — Cursor to paginate forwards from.
- **last** (`query`) `integer` — Number of submissions to return from the end of the window.
- **before** (`query`) `string` — Cursor to paginate backwards from.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — bounty submissions listed

- **data** `BountySubmission[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **bounty_id** `string` _requerido_ — The bounty the work was submitted to, prefixed `bnty_`.
    - **capture_clips** `array | null` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - **bounty_submission_id** `string` _requerido_ — The bounty submission (attempt) this clip belongs to, prefixed `btys_`.
        - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the clip was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
        - **duration_seconds** `integer | null` _requerido_ — Server-validated clip duration in whole seconds. `null` until validation completes.
        - **failure_code** `string | null` _requerido_ — Stable validation failure code. `null` unless `status` is `failed`.
        - **failure_message** `string | null` _requerido_ — Human-readable validation failure reason. `null` unless `status` is `failed`.
        - **frames_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Temporary signed URL for the video frame timestamp log. Returned only on single-clip reads for an authorized viewer; `null` on list responses or until the artifact is attached.
        - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Capture clip ID, prefixed `bclip_`.
        - **imu_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Temporary signed URL for the IMU (accelerometer + gyroscope) log. Returned only on single-clip reads for an authorized viewer; `null` on list responses or until the artifact is attached.
        - **manifest_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Temporary signed URL for the capture manifest. Returned only on single-clip reads for an authorized viewer; `null` on list responses or until the artifact is attached.
        - **ready_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When server-side validation completed successfully, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` until then.
        - **sequence** `integer` _requerido_ — The clip's stable order within the attempt, starting at 1.
        - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Recording and validation state. `recording` is still capturing; `verifying` is running server-side validation; `ready` passed validation and counts toward the verified-duration payout gate; `failed` did not validate. · valores: `recording`, `verifying`, `ready`, `failed`
        - **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the clip was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
        - **video_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Temporary signed URL for the synchronized MP4 video. Returned only on single-clip reads for an authorized viewer; `null` on list responses or until the artifact is attached.
    - **capture_filename** `string | null` _requerido_ — The vendor filename stem `Country_City_Site_Station_Operator`, derived from the capture metadata. `null` until every component is present.
    - **captured_clip_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Number of verified capture clips accepted for this submission so far. `0` for submissions whose deliverable doesn't accumulate clips.
    - **captured_duration_seconds** `integer` _requerido_ — Total verified duration of accepted capture clips, in whole seconds. `0` for submissions whose deliverable doesn't accumulate clips.
    - **city** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: city the footage was recorded in. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
    - **claimed_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the worker claimed the submission, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **content** `string | null` _requerido_ — Written proof the worker submitted with their work.
    - **country** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: country the footage was recorded in. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the submission was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **deliverable_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — How the work arrived when it came in through the API in one shot, informational only — read the work from `deliverable_urls`, `files`, and `capture_clips` directly. `null` for submissions whose proof is a livestream recording, including ones that attached links or files on submit. · valores: `content_url`, `media`, `data_capture`, `None`
    - **deliverable_urls** `array | null` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - Links submitted as work, followed by temporary download URLs for the uploaded files. `null` when the submission carries neither.
    - **denial_reason** `string | null` _requerido_ — Why the submission was denied, when a presentable reason exists. Always `null` unless `status` is `denied`.
    - **device** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: device the footage was recorded on. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
    - **files** `BountySubmissionFile[]` _requerido_
      - `array` de:
        - **attachment_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — Broad kind of file. · valores: `image`, `video`, `audio`, `other`, `None`
        - **content_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — MIME type of the file.
        - **filename** `string | null` _requerido_ — Name the file was uploaded with.
        - **id** `string` _requerido_ — File ID, prefixed `file_`.
        - **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Temporary download URL for the file.
    - **fov** `integer | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: horizontal field of view in degrees. `null` when not reported.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Submission ID, prefixed `btys_`.
    - **latest_proof_livestream_feed** `BountySubmissionLivestreamFeed | null` _requerido_ — Latest public proof livestream attached to the submission.
      - _uno de:_
        - **BountySubmissionLivestreamFeed**
          - **ended_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the proof livestream ended, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` while it is still live — a feed with a `started_at` and no `ended_at` is streaming right now.
          - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Livestream feed ID.
          - **recording_status** `string | null` _requerido_ — Recording lifecycle state. · valores: `recording`, `processing`, `completed`, `failed`, `None`
          - **recording_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Playback URL for a completed proof recording, when available.
          - **started_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the proof livestream went live, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` before it starts.
          - **thumbnail_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Current proof thumbnail URL, when available.
          - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Display title for the proof livestream.
        - **null**
    - **operator** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: identifier of the person who recorded the footage. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
    - **resolved_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the submission was approved or denied, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` until then.
    - **site** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: site or venue the footage was recorded at. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
    - **station** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: station or position within the site. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
    - **status** `string | null` _requerido_ — Lifecycle state. `in_progress` submissions are active attempts that have not submitted proof yet; `submitted` submissions await review; `approved` submissions were accepted and paid; `denied` submissions were rejected. `null` when the attempt ended without proof, taking it out of the public lifecycle — those attempts are absent from every public list and read. · valores: `in_progress`, `submitted`, `approved`, `denied`, `None`
    - **submitted_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When proof was submitted for review, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` while the attempt is in progress.
    - **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the submission was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **worker** `UserSummary` _requerido_ — User who submitted the work.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — User ID, prefixed `user_`.
      - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display name.
      - **profile_picture** `UserProfilePicture` _requerido_ — Avatar wrapper; its `url` is always present, using a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
        - **url** `string` _requerido_ — Avatar image URL. Always present — a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
      - **username** `string` _requerido_ — Public username.
- **page_info** `object` _requerido_
  - **end_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_
  - **has_next_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **has_previous_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **start_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_

**`400`** — Invalid Parameters

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`403`** — Forbidden

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.

## `POST /bounty_submissions`

**Create Bounty Submission**

Creates a submission on a workforce bounty. Include a `deliverable` payload — any combination of links and uploaded files, with at least one of the two — and the submission goes straight to review; create is the only step. For `data_capture` bounties, omit the deliverable: this starts a claimed attempt whose proof accumulates server-side, and the separate submit endpoint sends it to review once complete. Requires a user credential — account API keys cannot author submissions.

`operationId`: `createBountySubmission` · tags: `Bounty Submissions` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

### Request body — `application/json`

- **affiliate_code** `string | null` — Affiliate code crediting the referrer, when the worker arrived through one.
- **bounty_id** `string` _requerido_ — The bounty to submit to (`bnty_` tag).
- **deliverable** `object | null` — The submitted work. Combine `urls`, `file_ids`, and `caption` freely; at least one link or file is required.
  - **caption** `string | null` — Written context shown to reviewers alongside the work.
  - **file_ids** `string[]` — IDs of uploaded files attached as work, up to 10, each prefixed `file_`. Combinable with `urls` and `caption`.
    - `array` de:
  - **type** `string | null` — Legacy shape selector; no longer selects anything. When present it must name an inline shape (`content_url` or `media`). · valores: `content_url`, `media`, `None`
  - **urls** `string[]` — Links to the posted work, up to 10. Combinable with `file_ids` and `caption`.
    - `array` de:
- **metadata** `object | null` — Optional capture metadata describing where and how the footage was recorded. Persisted on the submission. On a `data_capture` bounty every field except `fov` is required whenever metadata is provided.
  - **city** `string | null` — City the footage was recorded in.
  - **country** `string | null` — Country the footage was recorded in.
  - **device** `string | null` — Device the footage was recorded on.
  - **fov** `integer | null` — Horizontal field of view in degrees.
  - **operator** `string | null` — Identifier of the person who recorded the footage.
  - **site** `string | null` — Site or venue the footage was recorded at.
  - **station** `string | null` — Station or position within the site.

### Respuestas

**`201`** — submission created with an inline deliverable

- **bounty_id** `string` _requerido_ — The bounty the work was submitted to, prefixed `bnty_`.
- **capture_clips** `array | null` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **bounty_submission_id** `string` _requerido_ — The bounty submission (attempt) this clip belongs to, prefixed `btys_`.
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the clip was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **duration_seconds** `integer | null` _requerido_ — Server-validated clip duration in whole seconds. `null` until validation completes.
    - **failure_code** `string | null` _requerido_ — Stable validation failure code. `null` unless `status` is `failed`.
    - **failure_message** `string | null` _requerido_ — Human-readable validation failure reason. `null` unless `status` is `failed`.
    - **frames_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Temporary signed URL for the video frame timestamp log. Returned only on single-clip reads for an authorized viewer; `null` on list responses or until the artifact is attached.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Capture clip ID, prefixed `bclip_`.
    - **imu_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Temporary signed URL for the IMU (accelerometer + gyroscope) log. Returned only on single-clip reads for an authorized viewer; `null` on list responses or until the artifact is attached.
    - **manifest_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Temporary signed URL for the capture manifest. Returned only on single-clip reads for an authorized viewer; `null` on list responses or until the artifact is attached.
    - **ready_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When server-side validation completed successfully, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` until then.
    - **sequence** `integer` _requerido_ — The clip's stable order within the attempt, starting at 1.
    - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Recording and validation state. `recording` is still capturing; `verifying` is running server-side validation; `ready` passed validation and counts toward the verified-duration payout gate; `failed` did not validate. · valores: `recording`, `verifying`, `ready`, `failed`
    - **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the clip was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **video_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Temporary signed URL for the synchronized MP4 video. Returned only on single-clip reads for an authorized viewer; `null` on list responses or until the artifact is attached.
- **capture_filename** `string | null` _requerido_ — The vendor filename stem `Country_City_Site_Station_Operator`, derived from the capture metadata. `null` until every component is present.
- **captured_clip_count** `integer` _requerido_ — Number of verified capture clips accepted for this submission so far. `0` for submissions whose deliverable doesn't accumulate clips.
- **captured_duration_seconds** `integer` _requerido_ — Total verified duration of accepted capture clips, in whole seconds. `0` for submissions whose deliverable doesn't accumulate clips.
- **city** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: city the footage was recorded in. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
- **claimed_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the worker claimed the submission, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **content** `string | null` _requerido_ — Written proof the worker submitted with their work.
- **country** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: country the footage was recorded in. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the submission was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **deliverable_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — How the work arrived when it came in through the API in one shot, informational only — read the work from `deliverable_urls`, `files`, and `capture_clips` directly. `null` for submissions whose proof is a livestream recording, including ones that attached links or files on submit. · valores: `content_url`, `media`, `data_capture`, `None`
- **deliverable_urls** `array | null` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - Links submitted as work, followed by temporary download URLs for the uploaded files. `null` when the submission carries neither.
- **denial_reason** `string | null` _requerido_ — Why the submission was denied, when a presentable reason exists. Always `null` unless `status` is `denied`.
- **device** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: device the footage was recorded on. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
- **files** `BountySubmissionFile[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **attachment_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — Broad kind of file. · valores: `image`, `video`, `audio`, `other`, `None`
    - **content_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — MIME type of the file.
    - **filename** `string | null` _requerido_ — Name the file was uploaded with.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — File ID, prefixed `file_`.
    - **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Temporary download URL for the file.
- **fov** `integer | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: horizontal field of view in degrees. `null` when not reported.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — Submission ID, prefixed `btys_`.
- **latest_proof_livestream_feed** `BountySubmissionLivestreamFeed | null` _requerido_ — Latest public proof livestream attached to the submission.
  - _uno de:_
    - **BountySubmissionLivestreamFeed**
      - **ended_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the proof livestream ended, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` while it is still live — a feed with a `started_at` and no `ended_at` is streaming right now.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Livestream feed ID.
      - **recording_status** `string | null` _requerido_ — Recording lifecycle state. · valores: `recording`, `processing`, `completed`, `failed`, `None`
      - **recording_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Playback URL for a completed proof recording, when available.
      - **started_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the proof livestream went live, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` before it starts.
      - **thumbnail_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Current proof thumbnail URL, when available.
      - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Display title for the proof livestream.
    - **null**
- **operator** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: identifier of the person who recorded the footage. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
- **resolved_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the submission was approved or denied, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` until then.
- **site** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: site or venue the footage was recorded at. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
- **station** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: station or position within the site. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
- **status** `string | null` _requerido_ — Lifecycle state. `in_progress` submissions are active attempts that have not submitted proof yet; `submitted` submissions await review; `approved` submissions were accepted and paid; `denied` submissions were rejected. `null` when the attempt ended without proof, taking it out of the public lifecycle — those attempts are absent from every public list and read. · valores: `in_progress`, `submitted`, `approved`, `denied`, `None`
- **submitted_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When proof was submitted for review, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` while the attempt is in progress.
- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the submission was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **worker** `UserSummary` _requerido_ — User who submitted the work.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — User ID, prefixed `user_`.
  - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display name.
  - **profile_picture** `UserProfilePicture` _requerido_ — Avatar wrapper; its `url` is always present, using a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
    - **url** `string` _requerido_ — Avatar image URL. Always present — a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
  - **username** `string` _requerido_ — Public username.

## `DELETE /bounty_submissions/{id}`

**Cancel Bounty Submission**

Cancels the caller's own active attempt on a bounty and discards any accumulated capture clips. Only the worker who started the attempt can cancel it — account API keys cannot.

`operationId`: `cancelBountySubmission` · tags: `Bounty Submissions` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The bounty submission to act on (`btys_` tag).

### Respuestas

**`200`** — attempt cancelled

- **deleted** `boolean` _requerido_ — Always true.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — ID of the cancelled submission.

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`403`** — Forbidden

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`404`** — Resource not found

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.

**Retrieve Bounty Submission**

Retrieves one bounty submission the credential can see — one the caller authored, or one on a bounty they posted or their account owns. Reading another member's work on an account's bounty takes `account_id`, the same way the list does.

`operationId`: `retrieveBountySubmission` · tags: `Bounty Submissions` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

## `POST /bounty_submissions/{id}/submit`

Submits a claimed attempt for review. A livestream attempt needs an ended proof stream and can attach an optional `deliverable` — links, files, and a caption in any combination; if the attempt already went to review when its stream ended, the payload attaches to it once, until reviewers start voting. A data capture attempt instead needs enough validated clip time and takes no payload. Only the worker who started the attempt can submit it — account API keys cannot.

  - **urls** `string[]` — Links to the posted work, up to 10. Combinable with `file_ids` and `caption`.

- **city** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: city the footage was recorded in. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
- **claimed_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the worker claimed the submission, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **content** `string | null` _requerido_ — Written proof the worker submitted with their work.
- **country** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: country the footage was recorded in. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the submission was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **deliverable_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — How the work arrived when it came in through the API in one shot, informational only — read the work from `deliverable_urls`, `files`, and `capture_clips` directly. `null` for submissions whose proof is a livestream recording, including ones that attached links or files on submit. · valores: `content_url`, `media`, `data_capture`, `None`
- **deliverable_urls** `array | null` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - Links submitted as work, followed by temporary download URLs for the uploaded files. `null` when the submission carries neither.
- **denial_reason** `string | null` _requerido_ — Why the submission was denied, when a presentable reason exists. Always `null` unless `status` is `denied`.
- **device** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: device the footage was recorded on. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
- **files** `BountySubmissionFile[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **attachment_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — Broad kind of file. · valores: `image`, `video`, `audio`, `other`, `None`
    - **content_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — MIME type of the file.
    - **filename** `string | null` _requerido_ — Name the file was uploaded with.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — File ID, prefixed `file_`.
    - **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Temporary download URL for the file.
- **fov** `integer | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: horizontal field of view in degrees. `null` when not reported.
- **id** `string` _requerido_ — Submission ID, prefixed `btys_`.
- **latest_proof_livestream_feed** `BountySubmissionLivestreamFeed | null` _requerido_ — Latest public proof livestream attached to the submission.
  - _uno de:_
    - **BountySubmissionLivestreamFeed**
      - **ended_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the proof livestream ended, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` while it is still live — a feed with a `started_at` and no `ended_at` is streaming right now.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Livestream feed ID.
      - **recording_status** `string | null` _requerido_ — Recording lifecycle state. · valores: `recording`, `processing`, `completed`, `failed`, `None`
      - **recording_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Playback URL for a completed proof recording, when available.
      - **started_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the proof livestream went live, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` before it starts.
      - **thumbnail_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — Current proof thumbnail URL, when available.
      - **title** `string` _requerido_ — Display title for the proof livestream.
    - **null**
- **operator** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: identifier of the person who recorded the footage. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
- **resolved_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the submission was approved or denied, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` until then.
- **site** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: site or venue the footage was recorded at. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
- **station** `string | null` _requerido_ — Capture metadata: station or position within the site. `null` unless capture metadata was provided.
- **status** `string | null` _requerido_ — Lifecycle state. `in_progress` submissions are active attempts that have not submitted proof yet; `submitted` submissions await review; `approved` submissions were accepted and paid; `denied` submissions were rejected. `null` when the attempt ended without proof, taking it out of the public lifecycle — those attempts are absent from every public list and read. · valores: `in_progress`, `submitted`, `approved`, `denied`, `None`
- **submitted_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When proof was submitted for review, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` while the attempt is in progress.
- **updated_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the submission was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **worker** `UserSummary` _requerido_ — User who submitted the work.
  - **id** `string` _requerido_ — User ID, prefixed `user_`.
  - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Display name.
  - **profile_picture** `UserProfilePicture` _requerido_ — Avatar wrapper; its `url` is always present, using a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
    - **url** `string` _requerido_ — Avatar image URL. Always present — a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
  - **username** `string` _requerido_ — Public username.

## `GET /card_transactions`

**List Card Transactions**

Lists an account's card transactions, newest first. Defaults to the account the credential belongs to. Covers every card the owner has ever had, including canceled cards and spend that predates a re-application, and team members only see transactions on the cards assigned to them. Pass `transaction_ids` to fetch specific transactions instead of paging for them.

`operationId`: `listCardTransactions` · tags: `Cards` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **account_id** (`query`) `string` — The account whose card transactions to list, prefixed `biz_`. Defaults to the credential's account.
- **transaction_ids** (`query`) `string[]` — Return only these card transactions, each prefixed `citx_`. Repeat the parameter, or pass one comma-separated value.
- **card_id** (`query`) `string[]` — Return only transactions charged to these cards, each prefixed `icrd_`.
- **cardholder_id** (`query`) `string[]` — Return only transactions on cards assigned to these users, each prefixed `user_`.
- **status** (`query`) `string` — Return only transactions with this status. · valores: `pending`, `completed`, `reversed`, `declined`
- **created_after** (`query`) `string` — Return only transactions authorized at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **created_before** (`query`) `string` — Return only transactions authorized at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **order** (`query`) `string` — The field to sort by. Defaults to `created_at`. · valores: `created_at`
- **direction** (`query`) `string` — The sort direction. Defaults to `desc`. · valores: `asc`, `desc`
- **first** (`query`) `integer` — The number of card transactions to return.
- **after** (`query`) `string` — A cursor; returns card transactions after this position.
- **last** (`query`) `integer` — The number of card transactions to return, counting back from the end.
- **before** (`query`) `string` — A cursor; returns card transactions before this position.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — no owner passed falls back to the credential's account

- **data** `CardTransaction[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **card_id** `string` _requerido_ — The card this transaction was charged to, prefixed `icrd_`.
    - **cardholder_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — The user the card is assigned to, prefixed `user_`. Null when the card has no assigned cardholder.
    - **cashback_usd_amount** `number | null` _requerido_ — Cashback earned on this transaction as a USD amount. Zero for declined or ineligible transactions, and null when cashback has not been computed yet.
    - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the transaction was authorized, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
    - **currency** `string | null` _requerido_ — ISO 4217 currency code the merchant charged in.
    - **declined_reason** `string | null` _requerido_ — Why the transaction was declined. Null unless `status` is `declined`.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Card transaction ID, prefixed `citx_`.
    - **international** `boolean` _requerido_ — True when the merchant is outside the card's home country.
    - **local_amount** `number | null` _requerido_ — Amount the merchant charged in their own currency. Pair with `currency`.
    - **merchant_category** `string | null` _requerido_ — Merchant category label, enriched where available and otherwise as the card network reported it.
    - **merchant_category_code** `string | null` _requerido_ — Four-digit ISO 18245 merchant category code (MCC).
    - **merchant_icon_url** `string | null` _requerido_ — URL of the enriched merchant logo. Null when no logo was matched.
    - **merchant_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Merchant name, enriched where available and otherwise as the card network reported it.
    - **posted_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the card network settled the transaction, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Null until it settles.
    - **status** `string` _requerido_ — Current status of the transaction. · valores: `pending`, `completed`, `reversed`, `declined`
    - **transaction_type** `string` _requerido_ — The kind of card transaction. Always `spend` today. · valores: `spend`
    - **usd_amount** `number | null` _requerido_ — Amount charged in USD. Negative when the merchant refunded the card.
- **page_info** `object` _requerido_
  - **end_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_
  - **has_next_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **has_previous_page** `boolean` _requerido_
  - **start_cursor** `string | null` _requerido_

**`400`** — Invalid Parameters

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`403`** — Forbidden

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

## `GET /cards`

**List Cards**

Lists the Whop cards of an account or user, including ones still being set up. Team members only see the cards assigned to them.

`operationId`: `listCards` · tags: `Cards` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **account_id** (`query`) `string` — The owning account ID (a biz_ identifier). Provide this or user_id.
- **user_id** (`query`) `string` — The owning user ID (a user_ identifier). Provide this or account_id.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — cards listed for an assigned cardholder without the ledger scope

- **data** `object[]` _requerido_
  - `array` de:
    - **billing** `object | null` _requerido_ — The billing address.
      - **city** `string | null` _requerido_ — Billing city.
      - **country_code** `string | null` _requerido_ — Billing country code.
      - **line1** `string | null` _requerido_ — Street address line 1.
      - **line2** `string | null` _requerido_ — Street address line 2.
      - **postal_code** `string | null` _requerido_ — Billing postal code.
      - **region** `string | null` _requerido_ — Billing region or state.
    - **canceled_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the card was canceled. · formato: `date-time`
    - **created_at** `string | null` _requerido_ — When the card was created. · formato: `date-time`
    - **expiration_month** `string | null` _requerido_ — Card expiration month.
    - **expiration_year** `string | null` _requerido_ — Card expiration year.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — Card ID, prefixed `icrd_`.
    - **last4** `string | null` _requerido_ — Last four digits of the card number. `null` for pending invitation cards.
    - **limit** `object | null` _requerido_ — The spending limit configuration.
      - **amount** `number` _requerido_ — The limit amount in dollars.
      - **frequency** `string` _requerido_ — The window the limit amount applies to. `per_transaction` caps each individual authorization and is what a limit set with `transaction_limit` reports. · valores: `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `one_time`, `per_transaction`
    - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Card display name.
    - **object** `string` _requerido_ · valores: `card`
    - **secrets** `object | null` — Sensitive card details. Present only on `GET /cards/:id` for active cards; `null` when the card is inactive or details cannot be retrieved.
      - **card_number** `string` _requerido_ — Full card number.
      - **cvc** `string` _requerido_ — Card verification code.
      - **name_on_card** `string | null` _requerido_ — Cardholder name printed on the card.
      - **pin** `string | null` _requerido_ — The card PIN. Only returned when the request is authenticated as the user the card is assigned to; `null` for all other callers, including account API keys.
    - **spent_last_month** `integer | null` _requerido_ — Total spend in the last 30 days, in cents.
    - **status** `string | null` _requerido_ — The card status. `denied` means the issuer declined the cardholder, so the card will never be issued. · valores: `None`, `active`, `frozen`, `canceled`, `invited`, `denied`
    - **type** `string | null` _requerido_ — The card type. · valores: `None`, `virtual`, `physical`
    - **user_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Cardholder user ID, prefixed `user_`, when assigned.

## `POST /cards`

**Create Card**

Issue a virtual card, or apply for card issuing. An account with no application files one here and gets back a `202`; call again to issue the card once it is approved.

`operationId`: `createCard` · tags: `Cards` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **account_id** `string` — The owning account ID (a biz_ identifier). Provide this or user_id.
- **assigned_user_id** `string` — The account member (a user_ identifier) to assign the card to. Required for business card issuing accounts, and whenever a company API key files an account's first card application.
- **name** `string` — A display name for the card.
- **spend_limit** `number` — Spending limit amount, in dollars.
- **spend_limit_frequency** `string` — The window the spend limit applies to. · valores: `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `one_time`
- **transaction_limit** `number` — Per-transaction limit amount, in dollars.
- **user_id** `string` — The owning user ID (a user_ identifier). Provide this or account_id.

### Respuestas

**`201`** — card created

- **billing** `object | null` _requerido_ — The billing address.
  - **city** `string | null` _requerido_ — Billing city.
  - **country_code** `string | null` _requerido_ — Billing country code.

  - **line2** `string | null` _requerido_ — Street address line 2.

  - **region** `string | null` _requerido_ — Billing region or state.

- **expiration_year** `string | null` _requerido_ — Card expiration year.

- **last4** `string | null` _requerido_ — Last four digits of the card number. `null` for pending invitation cards.
- **limit** `object | null` _requerido_ — The spending limit configuration.
  - **amount** `number` _requerido_ — The limit amount in dollars.
  - **frequency** `string` _requerido_ — The window the limit amount applies to. `per_transaction` caps each individual authorization and is what a limit set with `transaction_limit` reports. · valores: `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `one_time`, `per_transaction`
- **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Card display name.
- **object** `string` _requerido_ · valores: `card`
- **secrets** `object | null` — Sensitive card details. Present only on `GET /cards/:id` for active cards; `null` when the card is inactive or details cannot be retrieved.
  - **card_number** `string` _requerido_ — Full card number.
  - **cvc** `string` _requerido_ — Card verification code.
  - **name_on_card** `string | null` _requerido_ — Cardholder name printed on the card.
  - **pin** `string | null` _requerido_ — The card PIN. Only returned when the request is authenticated as the user the card is assigned to; `null` for all other callers, including account API keys.
- **spent_last_month** `integer | null` _requerido_ — Total spend in the last 30 days, in cents.
- **status** `string | null` _requerido_ — The card status. `denied` means the issuer declined the cardholder, so the card will never be issued. · valores: `None`, `active`, `frozen`, `canceled`, `invited`, `denied`
- **type** `string | null` _requerido_ — The card type. · valores: `None`, `virtual`, `physical`
- **user_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — Cardholder user ID, prefixed `user_`, when assigned.

## `PATCH /cards/{id}`

**Update Card**

Update, freeze, or cancel a card. Updating the card's name, billing address, or limits requires both `payout:account:update` and `company:balance:read`; a card's assigned holder may update their own card's pin and frozen state with any user token.

`operationId`: `updateCard` · tags: `Cards` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — Card ID to retrieve, prefixed `icrd_`.

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **account_id** `string` — The owning account ID (a biz_ identifier). Provide this or user_id.
- **billing** `object` — New billing address. Requires line1, city, region, postal_code, and country_code. On an invited card, passing billing alone (as the invited user) completes onboarding and starts card provisioning.
  - **city** `string` _requerido_ — Billing city.
  - **country_code** `string` _requerido_ — Billing country code, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
  - **line1** `string` _requerido_ — Street address line 1.
  - **line2** `string` — Street address line 2.
  - **postal_code** `string` _requerido_ — Billing postal code.
  - **region** `string` _requerido_ — Billing region or state.
- **canceled** `boolean` — Pass `true` to permanently cancel the card. A canceled card cannot be uncanceled. Cannot be combined with other fields.
- **frozen** `boolean` — Pass `true` to freeze the card, `false` to unfreeze it. The assigned cardholder may freeze their own card without the payout:account:update scope.
- **name** `string` — A display name for the card.
- **pin** `string` — New 4-digit PIN. Can only be set on a card assigned to the acting user, who may set it without the payout:account:update scope.
- **remove_limit** `boolean` — Pass `true` to remove the spending limit (make the card unlimited).
- **spend_limit** `number` — Spending limit amount, in dollars.
- **spend_limit_frequency** `string` — The window the spend limit applies to. · valores: `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `one_time`
- **transaction_limit** `number` — Per-transaction limit amount, in dollars.
- **user_id** `string` — The owning user ID (a user_ identifier). Provide this or account_id.

**`200`** — invited card onboarding completed: card provisioning started

- **billing** `object | null` _requerido_ — The billing address.

## `POST /confirmation_tokens`

**Create Confirmation Token**

Mints a single-use, short-lived confirmation token from what the buyer entered on your collection surface: the payment method payload, billing details, and attested save consent. Public and rate-limited — the account_id in the body scopes the token but does not authenticate. Confirm it with POST /payments from your server.

`operationId`: `createConfirmationToken` · tags: `Confirmation Tokens` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

### Request body — `application/json` (requerido)

- **account_id** `string` _requerido_ — The account (biz_) this token is scoped to — the publishable identity.
- **billing_details** `object` — Billing details collected with the method. `email` is always required; cards additionally require `name` and an address with `line1` and `country`.
  - **address** `object | null`
  - **email** `string` _requerido_
  - **name** `string | null`
- **browser_info** `object | null` — Screen/runtime facts from the buyer's browser (platform, screen dimensions, language, ...) used for authentication ceremonies. Header-derived fields are captured server-side.
- **payment_method** `object` _requerido_ — The collected method: `type` names the payment method, `category` names the payload shape, and the category-keyed object carries the payload. Wallets are the exception: their payload rides the type key (`apple_pay` / `google_pay`). Send exactly the one payload arm the category selects — extra arms are rejected. Redirect-flow methods (category `redirect`, `bank_transfer`, `voucher`, and redirect wallets like `cashapp`) collect nothing and send no payload arm.
  - **apple_pay** `object` — Type `apple_pay` (category `wallet`) only.
    - **merchant_identifier** `string | null` — The merchant identifier the Apple Pay sheet validated with — the same hostname-matched value from the type's `merchants` list the session ceremony used. Apple encrypts the wallet token for the certificate attached to this exact identifier, so the charge needs it to decrypt. Omit it when the ceremony omitted it; must be one the account has registered.
    - **token_intent** `string` _requerido_ — The Basis Theory token intent the Apple Pay sheet flow vaulted the raw wallet token into.
  - **balance** `object` — Category `balance` only. Names one of the buyer's spendable platform balances. Requires a buyer credential — whether the caller may spend the wallet is checked against their own grants, so another user's id reads as not found.
    - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The balance to spend — a balance id (ldgr_) from GET /balances.
  - **bank_debit** `object` — Category `bank_debit` only. A type that declares a secure field (`sepa_debit`) sends the element's tokenized credential as `token`. `us_bank_account` sends nothing here — the buyer links the account after confirm, through the hosted bank-connection flow the payment parks behind.
    - **token** `string` — The Basis Theory token the element vaulted the account details into. Required for types declaring a secure field; rejected for types that collect after confirm.
  - **card** `object` — Category `card` only. Exactly one of `token` or `token_intent`; display fields ride alongside.
    - **brand** `string | null` — Display-safe card brand from the collection surface, e.g. `visa`.
    - **last4** `string | null` — Display-safe last four digits from the collection surface.
    - **token** `string` — An element-assembled, expiring Basis Theory token. Provide this or token_intent.
    - **token_intent** `string` — A Basis Theory token intent. Provide this or token.
  - **category** `string` _requerido_ — The payload shape the surface collected. Must be the category the type resolves to — it is derived server-side and a mismatch is rejected. `saved` and `balance` are the exceptions: they name a method already on file or a spendable balance rather than one collected here. · valores: `card`, `wallet`, `bank_debit`, `bank_transfer`, `voucher`, `redirect`, `crypto`, `balance`, `in_app_purchase`, `saved`
  - **google_pay** `object` — Type `google_pay` (category `wallet`) only.
    - **token_intent** `string` _requerido_ — The Basis Theory token intent the Google Pay sheet flow vaulted the raw wallet token into.
  - **payer_document** `object` — The buyer's identity document when the charge currency has a payer_document_requirements entry for this method, such as ARS card, MODO, or Rapipago. This is independent of the method category.
    - **token** `string` _requerido_ — The Basis Theory token containing the identity-document number.
    - **type** `string` _requerido_ — The selected identity-document type from the method's payer_document_requirements entry. · valores: `dni`, `cuil`, `cuit`, `passport`, `cc`, `ci`, `rut`, `curp`, `rfc`
  - **saved** `object` — Category `saved` only. Names one of the buyer's own stored payment methods. Requires a buyer credential — the wallet read is scoped to that account, so another user's id reads as not found.
    - **payment_method** `string` _requerido_ — The stored payment method to charge — a payment method id from GET /payment_methods.
  - **type** `string` — The payment method type, for example `card` or `ideal`. Required for every category except `saved` and `balance`, where it is read from the referenced method.
- **return_url** `string | null` — Where redirect flows send the buyer, carried onto the confirm that consumes this token.
- **setup_future_usage** `string | null` — The save-consent state your surface displayed when the buyer confirmed. Confirm may vault only if attested here. · valores: `off_session`, `on_session`, `None`

### Respuestas

**`201`** — confirmation token created from a card token intent

- **billing_details** `PaymentBillingDetailsPreview | null` _requerido_ — Enough of the billing details to raise a customer record and recognise the method — email, name, country and postal code. The street address is collected for the charge but never returned; this endpoint is a display-safe preview.
  - _uno de:_
    - **PaymentBillingDetailsPreview**
      - **country** `string | null` _requerido_ — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
      - **email** `string | null` _requerido_ — Email supplied when the method was collected.
      - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — Name on the payment method.
      - **postal_code** `string | null` _requerido_ — Postal or ZIP code.
    - **null**
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the token was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **expires_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the token expires, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Tokens are single-use and short-lived.
- **id** `string` _requerido_
- **object** `string` _requerido_ — Always `confirmation_token`.
- **payment_method_preview** `PaymentMethodDisplay` _requerido_ — Display-only preview of the collected method — never the underlying token.
  - **bank_debit** `PaymentMethodDisplayPreview` — Present when the category is `bank_debit`. Carries the account's last four when the linking provider surfaced it.
    - **brand** `string` — Lowercase card brand, e.g. `visa`. Absent when the method carries no brand.
    - **last4** `string` — Last four digits of the instrument. Absent when the method carries none.
  - **card** `PaymentMethodDisplayPreview` — Present when the category is `card`. What the collection surface displayed — the token has not been charged, so this is the buyer's claim, not the vault's record.
    - **brand** `string` — Lowercase card brand, e.g. `visa`. Absent when the method carries no brand.
    - **last4** `string` — Last four digits of the instrument. Absent when the method carries none.
  - **category** `string` _requerido_ — The family the type belongs to. · valores: `card`, `wallet`, `bank_debit`, `bank_transfer`, `voucher`, `redirect`, `crypto`, `balance`, `in_app_purchase`, `saved`
  - **display_name** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable label for the method, e.g. `Visa •••• 4242`.
  - **id** `string | null` _requerido_ — The saved payment method this preview came from, or `null` when the buyer supplied a new one.
  - **saved** `PaymentMethodDisplayPreview` — Present when the category is `saved` and the stored method is a card. Unlike the other previews this is the vault's own record, not a claim from the collection surface. Absent for a balance, which has no instrument.
    - **brand** `string` — Lowercase card brand, e.g. `visa`. Absent when the method carries no brand.
    - **last4** `string` — Last four digits of the instrument. Absent when the method carries none.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — The payment method type, e.g. `card`, `apple_pay`, `klarna`.
  - **wallet** `PaymentMethodDisplayPreview` — Present when the category is `wallet`. Carries the backing card's brand and last four when the wallet surfaced them.
    - **brand** `string` — Lowercase card brand, e.g. `visa`. Absent when the method carries no brand.
    - **last4** `string` — Last four digits of the instrument. Absent when the method carries none.
- **setup_future_usage** `string | null` _requerido_ — Save-consent state the element displayed at collection: `off_session`, `on_session`, or `null`. Confirm may vault only if attested here.
- **status** `string` _requerido_ — `pending` until it is used, then `consumed`; `expired` once its short lifetime elapses. Only a `pending` token can be charged. · valores: `pending`, `consumed`, `expired`

**`400`** — Invalid Parameters

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`403`** — Forbidden

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`404`** — Resource not found

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`409`** — Conflict

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.

- **amount** `number` — Amount to prefill on hosted deposit page.

- **metadata** `object` — Metadata to include with the deposit response.

### Respuestas

        - **swift_bic** `string | null` _requerido_ — SWIFT/BIC code for international wires, when available.

## `GET /dispute_alerts`

**List Dispute Alerts**

Lists the dispute alerts and early fraud warnings across the accounts you can read.

`operationId`: `listDisputeAlerts` · tags: `Dispute alerts` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **account_id** (`query`) `string` — Only alerts on this account's payments (`biz_` tag). Omit it to cover every account you can read.
- **payment_id** (`query`) `string` — Only alerts on this payment (`pay_` tag). A payment can carry several.
- **type** (`query`) `string` — Only alerts of this kind. `early_fraud_warning` for issuer fraud reports, `dispute_alert` for pre-dispute notices, `rapid_dispute_resolution` for Visa RDR cases the network already closed. · valores: `early_fraud_warning`, `dispute_alert`, `rapid_dispute_resolution`
- **first** (`query`) `integer` — The number of alerts to return (default 20, max 100).
- **after** (`query`) `string` — A cursor; returns alerts after this position.
- **last** (`query`) `integer` — The number of alerts to return from the end of the range.
- **before** (`query`) `string` — A cursor; returns alerts before this position.
- **order** (`query`) `string` — The field to sort alerts by. · valores: `created_at`, `reported_at`, `amount` · default: `created_at`

A `needs_response` dispute whose evidence deadline has passed reports and filters as `under_review` instead.

## `GET /disputes/summary`

**Retrieve Dispute Summary**

Totals up the same disputes the list returns, so you can build status tabs and totals without paging through them.

`operationId`: `retrieveDisputeSummary` · tags: `Disputes` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **groups** (`query`) `string[]` — Which breakdowns to return, keyed by these names under `groups`. Repeat the parameter to ask for several; omit it for all of them.
- **account_id** (`query`) `string` — Only disputes filed against this account (`biz_` tag). Omit it to cover every account you can read.
- **status** (`query`) `string[]` — Only disputes in these statuses. Repeat the parameter to pass several. A `needs_response` dispute whose evidence deadline has passed reports and filters as `under_review` instead.
- **currency** (`query`) `string` — Only disputes in this three-letter ISO currency.
- **created_before** (`query`) `string` — Only disputes opened before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **created_after** (`query`) `string` — Only disputes opened after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

### Respuestas

**`200`** — summary returned

- **groups** `object` _requerido_ — One entry per requested breakdown, keyed by the field it groups on. A field you did not ask for is absent.
  - **currency** `object` — How many of the matching disputes are in each currency, keyed by three-letter ISO code. Only currencies with at least one dispute are present.
  - **status** `object` — How many of the matching disputes are in each status. Every status is present, including those with a count of zero.
    - **closed** `integer` _requerido_
    - **lost** `integer` _requerido_
    - **needs_response** `integer` _requerido_
    - **under_review** `integer` _requerido_
    - **won** `integer` _requerido_
- **total** `integer` _requerido_ — How many disputes match the filters.

**`400`** — Invalid Parameters

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

**`401`** — Unauthorized

- **error** `object` _requerido_
  - **code** `string` — Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.
  - **message** `string` _requerido_ — Human-readable error message.
  - **type** `string` _requerido_ — Machine-readable error code.

## `POST /disputes/{id}/submit`

**Submit Dispute**

Sends a dispute's evidence to the payment processor. This is final — it cannot be edited or sent again.

`operationId`: `submitDispute` · tags: `Disputes` · seguridad: `bearerAuth`

### Parámetros

- **id** (`path`) `string` _requerido_ — The dispute ID (`dspt_` tag).
- **Api-Version-Date** (`header`) `string` — Pins the request to a dated API version.
- **Idempotency-Key** (`header`) `string` — A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).

### Respuestas

**`200`** — dispute submitted

- **account_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — The account the dispute was filed against, prefixed `biz_`.
- **amount** `number` _requerido_ — The disputed amount, in whole units of `currency`.
- **buyer** `DisputeBuyer | null` _requerido_ — The customer who filed the dispute.
  - _uno de:_
    - **DisputeBuyer**
      - **email** `string | null` _requerido_ — The customer's email address. Requires the `member:email:read` scope; `null` without it.
      - **member_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — The customer's member row on the account, prefixed `mem_`.
      - **name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The customer's display name.
      - **user_id** `string | null` _requerido_ — The customer's user ID, prefixed `user_`. `null` for a guest checkout.
      - **username** `string | null` _requerido_ — The customer's Whop username.
    - **null**
- **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the dispute was opened, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
- **currency** `string` _requerido_ — Three-letter ISO currency code of the disputed amount.
- **evidence** `DisputeEvidence` _requerido_ — The evidence packet sent to the processor to contest the dispute.
  - **access_activity_log** `string | null` _requerido_ — Log of the customer's access to the product, such as sign-in or download activity.
  - **billing_address** `string | null` _requerido_ — The billing address the customer provided at checkout.
  - **cancellation_policy_attachment** `DisputeAttachment | null` _requerido_ — The cancellation policy document. Falls back to Whop's platform policy when the seller has not uploaded their own.
    - _uno de:_
      - **DisputeAttachment**
        - **content_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — The uploaded file's MIME type.
        - **filename** `string | null` _requerido_ — The uploaded file's name.
        - **id** `string | null` _requerido_ — The attachment's ID. `null` for a Whop-hosted policy, which is not an uploaded file.
        - **platform** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether this is Whop's own hosted policy, standing in because the seller uploaded none. Sending it back on a PATCH changes nothing.
        - **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — A URL to download the attachment.
      - **null**
  - **cancellation_policy_disclosure** `string | null` _requerido_ — How the cancellation policy was shown to the customer before purchase.
  - **customer_communication_attachment** `DisputeAttachment | null` _requerido_ — Correspondence with the customer, or proof they used the product.

        - **content_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — The uploaded file's MIME type.

        - **platform** `boolean` _requerido_ — Whether this is Whop's own hosted policy, standing in because the seller uploaded none. Sending it back on a PATCH changes nothing.
        - **url** `string | null` _requerido_ — A URL to download the attachment.
      - **null**
  - **customer_email_address** `string | null` _requerido_ — The email address the customer used at checkout.
  - **customer_name** `string | null` _requerido_ — The customer's name as given at checkout.
  - **documents** `DisputeEvidenceDocument[]` _requerido_
    - `array` de:
      - **content_type** `string | null` _requerido_ — The uploaded file's MIME type. Uploads are restricted to the types the processor accepts. · valores: `application/pdf`, `application/json`, `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`, `None`
      - **created_at** `string` _requerido_ — When the file was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **filename** `string | null` _requerido_ — The original filename, including its extension.
      - **id** `string` _requerido_ — The file's ID, prefixed `file_`.
      - **multipart_chunk_size** `integer | null` — The byte size each part (except the last) must be. Present only on create, and only for multipart uploads.
      - **multipart_upload_id** `string | null` — The ID of the multipart upload, passed back to `complete`. Present only on create, and only for multipart uploads.
